units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|description|17|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> to meet up with Alondo, who will explain more.
units.italian: Va' su <planet> per incontrarti con Alondo, che ti spiegherà di più.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|As you are landing, you receive a message from JJ, on behalf of the Council. The message reads:|32|0
units.english: As you are landing, you receive a message from JJ, on behalf of the Council. The message reads:
units.italian: Mentre atterri, ricevi un messaggio da JJ, a nome del Consiglio. Il messaggio dice:

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|	Captain <last>, sorry that we have been out of contact. We need your help once again, to assist in a diplomatic mission. Please meet up with Alondo on <planet> as soon as possible. He will give you more information.|37|0
units.english: Captain <last>, sorry that we have been out of contact. We need your help once again, to assist in a diplomatic mission. Please meet up with Alondo on <planet> as soon as possible. He will give you more information.
units.italian: Capitano <last>, scusa se siamo stati irraggiungibili. Abbiamo di nuovo bisogno del tuo aiuto, per una missione diplomatica. Incontra Alondo su <planet> il prima possibile. Ti darà più informazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|	Captain <last>. Your suspension from the Free Worlds has just ended. The Senate is still not happy with what you did, and has therefore not reinstated your pay, but they have allowed you to continue working for us. Don't cause any more issues and you'll regain your pay. Please meet up with Alondo on <planet> as soon as possible. He will give you more information.|41|0
units.english: Captain <last>. Your suspension from the Free Worlds has just ended. The Senate is still not happy with what you did, and has therefore not reinstated your pay, but they have allowed you to continue working for us. Don't cause any more issues and you'll regain your pay. Please meet up with Alondo on <planet> as soon as possible. He will give you more information.
units.italian: Capitano <last>. La tua sospensione dalle Free Worlds è appena terminata. Il Senato non è ancora contento di quello che hai fatto, e quindi non ha reintegrato il tuo stipendio, ma ti ha permesso di continuare a lavorare per noi. Non causare altri problemi e riavrai la paga. Incontra Alondo su <planet> il prima possibile. Ti darà più informazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|			Sincerely,|43|0
units.english: Sincerely,
units.italian: Cordiali saluti,

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|				Jean-Jacques and Freya|44|0
units.english: Jean-Jacques and Freya
units.italian: Jean-Jacques e Freya

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1|dialog|48|0
units.english: As you are landing, Alondo contacts you and asks you to meet him in the spaceport as soon as you have a bunk prepared for him.
units.italian: Mentre atterri, Alondo ti contatta e ti chiede di incontrarlo allo spazioporto appena avrai preparato una cuccetta per lui.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|name|53|0
units.english: Free Worlds Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|description|54|0
units.english: Bring Alondo to <planet> to meet with Parliament. Your guarantee of safe passage will expire on <day>.
units.italian: Porta Alondo su <planet> per incontrare il Parlamento. Il tuo salvacondotto scadrà il <day>.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|blocked|62|0
units.english: You do not have a bunk free for Alondo. Return here when you do.
units.italian: Non hai una cuccetta libera per Alondo. Torna qui quando ne avrai una.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|You meet up with Alondo, who insists on not telling you anything until you are safely back aboard your own ship. Once you have brought him to his room, he says, "Here's the deal. The Senate has been secretly reaching out to other worlds, and four of them have decided to join us: Harmony, New Portland, Dancer, and New India."|68|0
units.english: You meet up with Alondo, who insists on not telling you anything until you are safely back aboard your own ship. Once you have brought him to his room, he says, "Here's the deal. The Senate has been secretly reaching out to other worlds, and four of them have decided to join us: Harmony, New Portland, Dancer, and New India."
units.italian: Incontri Alondo, che insiste per non dirti nulla finché non siete al sicuro sulla tua nave. Dopo che l'hai portato nella sua cabina, dice: "Il punto è questo. Il Senato ha contattato in segreto altri mondi, e quattro hanno deciso di unirsi a noi: Harmony, New Portland, Dancer e New India."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"That's great news!"|70|0
units.english: "That's great news!"
units.italian: "È un'ottima notizia!"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Why haven't I heard of this yet?"|71|0
units.english: "Why haven't I heard of this yet?"
units.italian: "Perché non ne ho saputo niente?"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Indeed it is," says Alondo. "Any worlds joining us would be reason to celebrate, but these four are particularly important because they are on the trade route to Tarazed. If we control those systems, our supply convoys will be much safer."|73|0
units.english: "Indeed it is," says Alondo. "Any worlds joining us would be reason to celebrate, but these four are particularly important because they are on the trade route to Tarazed. If we control those systems, our supply convoys will be much safer."
units.italian: "Lo è davvero," dice Alondo. "Qualsiasi mondo si unisse a noi sarebbe motivo di festa, ma questi quattro sono particolarmente importanti perché sono sulla rotta commerciale per Tarazed. Se controlliamo quei sistemi, i nostri convogli di rifornimento saranno molto più al sicuro."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Why isn't this public knowledge yet?" you ask.|74|0
units.english: "Why isn't this public knowledge yet?" you ask.
units.italian: "Perché non è ancora di pubblico dominio?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Well," says Alondo, "apparently the Senate was not being as secretive as they thought. Somehow word leaked out to the Republic that those worlds were defecting, and a massive Navy fleet moved to occupy those systems. Which means we're on the brink of another bloody battle."|76|0
units.english: "Well," says Alondo, "apparently the Senate was not being as secretive as they thought. Somehow word leaked out to the Republic that those worlds were defecting, and a massive Navy fleet moved to occupy those systems. Which means we're on the brink of another bloody battle."
units.italian: "Beh," dice Alondo, "a quanto pare il Senato non era così riservato come credeva. In qualche modo la voce è arrivata alla Repubblica, che quei mondi stavano defezionando, e una grande flotta della Marina si è mossa per occupare quei sistemi. Il che significa che siamo sull'orlo di un'altra sanguinosa battaglia."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Don't worry, I'm sure we can defeat them."|78|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm sure we can defeat them."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sono sicuro che possiamo sconfiggerli."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Is there any way to avoid a fight?"|80|0
units.english: "Is there any way to avoid a fight?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo per evitare uno scontro?"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"I'm sure we can," says Alondo, "but with heavy loss of life on both sides. We want to avoid that if at all possible. That's where you come in."|83|0
units.english: "I'm sure we can," says Alondo, "but with heavy loss of life on both sides. We want to avoid that if at all possible. That's where you come in."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che possiamo," dice Alondo, "ma con gravi perdite da entrambe le parti. Vogliamo evitarlo se è minimamente possibile. Ed è qui che entri in gioco tu."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"That's what we're hoping," he says, "and that's where you come in."|86|0
units.english: "That's what we're hoping," he says, "and that's where you come in."
units.italian: "È quello che speriamo," dice, "ed è qui che entri in gioco tu."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"How so?" you ask.|89|0
units.english: "How so?" you ask.
units.italian: "In che senso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	He says, "We've arranged for you to be granted safe passage through Republic space for the next three weeks. That's enough time to bring me to Earth and back. If I can meet with Parliament in person, maybe I will be able to work something out."|90|0
units.english: He says, "We've arranged for you to be granted safe passage through Republic space for the next three weeks. That's enough time to bring me to Earth and back. If I can meet with Parliament in person, maybe I will be able to work something out."
units.italian: Dice: "Abbiamo fatto in modo che ti fosse concesso un salvacondotto attraverso lo spazio della Repubblica per le prossime tre settimane. È il tempo sufficiente per portarmi sulla Terra e tornare. Se riesco a incontrare il Parlamento di persona, forse riuscirò a trovare un accordo."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"Okay, let's go to Earth!"|92|0
units.english: "Okay, let's go to Earth!"
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo sulla Terra!"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"How do we know this isn't a trap? You're willing to risk your life for this?"|94|0
units.english: "How do we know this isn't a trap? You're willing to risk your life for this?"
units.italian: "Come facciamo a sapere che non è una trappola? Sei disposto a rischiare la vita per questo?"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|	"If we can save thousands of lives from being lost in a needless battle, it's worth the risk," he says. "Now come on, the clock is ticking. We need to be safely back in Free space before your safe passage expires."|95|0
units.english: "If we can save thousands of lives from being lost in a needless battle, it's worth the risk," he says. "Now come on, the clock is ticking. We need to be safely back in Free space before your safe passage expires."
units.italian: "Se possiamo salvare migliaia di vite da una battaglia inutile, vale la pena rischiare," dice. "Ora andiamo, il tempo stringe. Dobbiamo essere al sicuro nello spazio delle Free Worlds prima che scada il tuo salvacondotto."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1B|dialog|102|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|name|108|0
units.english: Free Worlds Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|description|109|0
units.english: Bring Alondo to <planet> to meet with the senior Navy officers. Take as direct a route as possible, because your safe passage expires soon.
units.italian: Porta Alondo su <planet> per incontrare gli alti ufficiali della Marina. Prendi la rotta più diretta possibile, perché il tuo salvacondotto sta per scadere.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|log|120|0
units.english: Stopped on Earth with Alondo to talk to Parliament and try to head off another bloody battle. Unfortunately, they were not willing to negotiate.
units.italian: Ti sei fermato sulla Terra con Alondo per parlare al Parlamento e cercare di scongiurare un'altra sanguinosa battaglia. Purtroppo non erano disposti a negoziare.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|You drop off Alondo and wish him luck. Hours pass, and you begin to worry that he has been taken prisoner or killed. But finally he returns, looking very discouraged. "It makes no sense," he says. "The tax revenue they get from those four worlds doesn't come close to covering the cost of defending them. They should be glad to let them go."|122|0
units.english: You drop off Alondo and wish him luck. Hours pass, and you begin to worry that he has been taken prisoner or killed. But finally he returns, looking very discouraged. "It makes no sense," he says. "The tax revenue they get from those four worlds doesn't come close to covering the cost of defending them. They should be glad to let them go."
units.italian: Lasci scendere Alondo e gli auguri buona fortuna. Passano le ore, e cominci a temere che sia stato preso prigioniero o ucciso. Ma alla fine torna, molto scoraggiato. "Non ha alcun senso," dice. "Le entrate fiscali che ricavano da quei quattro mondi non si avvicinano nemmeno a coprire il costo di difenderli. Dovrebbero essere contenti di lasciarli andare."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"So, Parliament won't give up those worlds without a fight?"|124|0
units.english: "So, Parliament won't give up those worlds without a fight?"
units.italian: "Quindi il Parlamento non cederà quei mondi senza combattere?"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Maybe they're afraid of the precedent it would set if they give in to us."|126|0
units.english: "Maybe they're afraid of the precedent it would set if they give in to us."
units.italian: "Forse temono il precedente che creerebbe se cedessero a noi."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"That's right," he says. "Amazing how heedless they can be, sitting in their comfy Parliament house deciding the fates of others."|129|0
units.english: "That's right," he says. "Amazing how heedless they can be, sitting in their comfy Parliament house deciding the fates of others."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "Sorprendente quanto possano essere sconsiderati, seduti nella loro comoda sede del Parlamento a decidere il destino degli altri."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Yes, that seems to be what's at stake," he says. "But by now they should see the writing on the wall. Amazing how callous they can be about the lives of the Navy crews who are following their orders."|132|0
units.english: "Yes, that seems to be what's at stake," he says. "But by now they should see the writing on the wall. Amazing how callous they can be about the lives of the Navy crews who are following their orders."
units.italian: "Sì, sembra che sia questo in gioco," dice. "Ma ormai dovrebbero vedere la scritta sul muro. Sorprendente quanto possano essere insensibili alla vita degli equipaggi della Marina che seguono i loro ordini."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"So, we just head home in defeat?" you ask.|134|0
units.english: "So, we just head home in defeat?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quindi torniamo a casa sconfitti?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Not quite," he says. "While we have the chance, I want to talk with the Navy leadership directly. Landing near the secret base on New Austria would be way too provocative, so I've arranged to meet with them on their base on <planet> instead."|135|0
units.english: "Not quite," he says. "While we have the chance, I want to talk with the Navy leadership directly. Landing near the secret base on New Austria would be way too provocative, so I've arranged to meet with them on their base on <planet> instead."
units.italian: "Non proprio," dice. "Finché ne abbiamo la possibilità, voglio parlare direttamente con il comando della Marina. Atterrare vicino alla base segreta su New Austria sarebbe troppo provocatorio, quindi ho preso accordi per incontrarli sulla loro base su <planet>."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Okay, if that's what it takes to avoid another bloody battle, I'll take you there."|137|0
units.english: "Okay, if that's what it takes to avoid another bloody battle, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, se è questo che serve per evitare un'altra sanguinosa battaglia, ti ci porto."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Are you insane? Flying straight into the largest Navy base in the sector?"|139|0
units.english: "Are you insane? Flying straight into the largest Navy base in the sector?"
units.italian: "Sei pazzo? Volare dritto nella più grande base della Marina del settore?"

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|	"Don't worry," he says. "The Navy takes honor very seriously. If they promise our safety, we'll be safe. At least until that grant of safe passage expires, that is." You have serious doubts, but you have no choice but to obey him.|140|0
units.english: "Don't worry," he says. "The Navy takes honor very seriously. If they promise our safety, we'll be safe. At least until that grant of safe passage expires, that is." You have serious doubts, but you have no choice but to obey him.
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice. "La Marina prende l'onore molto sul serio. Se promettono la nostra sicurezza, saremo al sicuro. Almeno finché non scade il salvacondotto." Hai seri dubbi, ma non hai altra scelta che obbedirgli.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1C|dialog|143|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|name|149|0
units.english: Free Worlds Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|description|150|0
units.english: Bring Alondo back to <destination>. Take as direct a route as possible, because your safe passage expires soon.
units.italian: Riporta Alondo a <destination>. Prendi la rotta più diretta possibile, perché il tuo salvacondotto sta per scadere.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|When you land on <origin>, Alondo says, "You should join me for this meeting. You may find it eye-opening."|161|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, Alondo says, "You should join me for this meeting. You may find it eye-opening."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, Alondo dice: "Dovresti unirti a me per questo incontro. Potrebbe aprirti gli occhi."

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|	Four of the Navy admirals who are stationed here have agreed to meet with you. You discover that one of them is from the Dirt Belt. Another grew up in the Rim, and admits to you that if he were not serving the Navy, he would be fighting for the Free Worlds. All four of them seem sympathetic to your cause, and express genuine regret not just for the Navy lives that have been lost, but for the Free Worlds losses as well.|162|0
units.english: Four of the Navy admirals who are stationed here have agreed to meet with you. You discover that one of them is from the Dirt Belt. Another grew up in the Rim, and admits to you that if he were not serving the Navy, he would be fighting for the Free Worlds. All four of them seem sympathetic to your cause, and express genuine regret not just for the Navy lives that have been lost, but for the Free Worlds losses as well.
units.italian: Quattro degli ammiragli della Marina di stanza qui hanno accettato di incontrarvi. Scopri che uno di loro viene dalla Fascia di Terra. Un altro è cresciuto nel Bordo, e ti ammette che, se non servisse la Marina, combatterebbe per le Free Worlds. Tutti e quattro sembrano solidali con la vostra causa, ed esprimono un sincero rammarico non solo per le vite della Marina perdute, ma anche per le perdite delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|	And all four of them state, without any hesitation or equivocation, that if Parliament orders them to continue to fight the Free Worlds, they will fight until all possibility of victory is gone.|163|0
units.english: And all four of them state, without any hesitation or equivocation, that if Parliament orders them to continue to fight the Free Worlds, they will fight until all possibility of victory is gone.
units.italian: E tutti e quattro dichiarano, senza esitazione né ambiguità, che se il Parlamento ordinerà loro di continuare a combattere le Free Worlds, combatteranno finché ogni possibilità di vittoria non sarà svanita.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|	Alondo thanks them for their time and their honesty, and you return to your ship. "Well, it was worth a try. Now we just have to get home safely," he says.|164|0
units.english: Alondo thanks them for their time and their honesty, and you return to your ship. "Well, it was worth a try. Now we just have to get home safely," he says.
units.italian: Alondo li ringrazia per il tempo e per l'onestà, e tornate alla vostra nave. "Beh, valeva la pena provare. Ora dobbiamo solo tornare a casa sani e salvi," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|dialog|168|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Diplomacy 1D|dialog|170|0
units.english: You are still finding it hard to believe that you made it to Earth and back in one piece. Alondo thanks you for transporting him and says, "Now I just have to break the bad news to the Senate. JJ and I will meet you in the spaceport bar in a few hours, once we've decided what our next steps will be."
units.italian: Fatichi ancora a credere di essere andato sulla Terra e tornato tutto intero. Alondo ti ringrazia per il trasporto e dice: "Ora devo solo dare la brutta notizia al Senato. JJ e io ti incontreremo al bar dello spazioporto fra qualche ora, quando avremo deciso i prossimi passi."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1|name|176|0
units.english: Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1|description|177|0
units.english: Fly through <waypoints> to get a sense of the Navy's strength in those systems, then report to <destination>.
units.italian: Sorvola <waypoints> per farti un'idea della forza della Marina in quei sistemi, poi riferisci a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1|Alondo and JJ are in a somber mood when you meet up with them in the bar. You can't help remembering that Tomek always used to be a part of these gatherings, before he turned against the Senate. And now it looks like your next major battle will be fought without Tomek's expert guidance.|192|0
units.english: Alondo and JJ are in a somber mood when you meet up with them in the bar. You can't help remembering that Tomek always used to be a part of these gatherings, before he turned against the Senate. And now it looks like your next major battle will be fought without Tomek's expert guidance.
units.italian: Alondo e JJ sono di umore cupo quando li incontri al bar. Non puoi fare a meno di ricordare che Tomek faceva sempre parte di questi incontri, prima di schierarsi contro il Senato. E ora sembra che la vostra prossima grande battaglia sarà combattuta senza la sua guida esperta.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1|	JJ says, "We've done all we can. Sooner or later we will have to fight the Navy for those star systems. So to start with, <first>, we'd like you to scout them out and report back to us on the Navy's presence there. Freya is on Trinket, gathering a fleet. Report to her there when you're done."|193|0
units.english: JJ says, "We've done all we can. Sooner or later we will have to fight the Navy for those star systems. So to start with, <first>, we'd like you to scout them out and report back to us on the Navy's presence there. Freya is on Trinket, gathering a fleet. Report to her there when you're done."
units.italian: JJ dice: "Abbiamo fatto tutto il possibile. Prima o poi dovremo combattere la Marina per quei sistemi stellari. Quindi, per cominciare, <first>, vorremmo che li esplorassi e ci riferissi sulla presenza della Marina. Freya è su Trinket, a radunare una flotta. Riferisci a lei quando hai finito."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|name|202|0
units.english: Electron Beam
units.italian: Fascio di elettroni

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|description|203|0
units.english: Steal an Electron Beam from a Navy Gunboat and return it to <planet> for Freya to look at. She thought your best bet for finding lone Gunboats might be the Wei or Alnasl systems.
units.italian: Ruba un fascio di elettroni da una cannoniera della Marina e riportalo su <planet> perché Freya lo esamini. Pensava che il posto migliore per trovare cannoniere isolate fossero i sistemi Wei o Alnasl.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|log|213|0
units.english: It looks like the Navy has begun using some more powerful beam weapons and torpedoes. Tasked with plundering one of the electron beam weapons so Freya can get a closer look at it.
units.italian: Sembra che la Marina abbia cominciato a usare armi a fascio e siluri più potenti. Ti è stato affidato il compito di saccheggiare una di quelle armi a fascio di elettroni perché Freya possa esaminarla più da vicino.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|Freya thanks you for performing the scouting mission, and you give her a copy of your ship's logs to analyze. As she looks through them, almost immediately something catches her eye. "Looks like the Navy is fielding some new weapons," she says. "Some higher-yield torpedoes, and a beam weapon even more powerful than Heavy Lasers. Those beam weapons in particular worry me."|215|0
units.english: Freya thanks you for performing the scouting mission, and you give her a copy of your ship's logs to analyze. As she looks through them, almost immediately something catches her eye. "Looks like the Navy is fielding some new weapons," she says. "Some higher-yield torpedoes, and a beam weapon even more powerful than Heavy Lasers. Those beam weapons in particular worry me."
units.italian: Freya ti ringrazia per la missione di ricognizione, e tu le dai una copia dei registri della nave da analizzare. Mentre li scorre, quasi subito qualcosa le salta all'occhio. "Sembra che la Marina stia schierando nuove armi," dice. "Alcuni siluri a resa più alta, e un'arma a fascio ancora più potente dei laser pesanti. Quelle armi a fascio in particolare mi preoccupano."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"Yes, that kind of negates the advantage I was hoping we'd have due to our new plasma turrets."|217|0
units.english: "Yes, that kind of negates the advantage I was hoping we'd have due to our new plasma turrets."
units.italian: "Sì, questo annulla in un colpo il vantaggio che speravamo di avere con le nostre nuove torrette al plasma."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"Does that mean we're not going to attack them after all?"|218|0
units.english: "Does that mean we're not going to attack them after all?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che non li attaccheremo dopo tutto?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"Well," she says, "the Plasma Turrets weren't the only ace up our sleeve, but still, it's frustrating that the Navy still has such an advantage over us technologically."|220|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "the Plasma Turrets weren't the only ace up our sleeve, but still, it's frustrating that the Navy still has such an advantage over us technologically."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "le torrette al plasma non erano il nostro unico asso nella manica, ma resta frustrante che la Marina abbia ancora un vantaggio tecnologico così netto su di noi."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"What should we do?" you ask.|221|0
units.english: "What should we do?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa dovremmo fare?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"We're going to have to fight them eventually, but first we need as much information as we can get on their new weapon systems. I'd like you to find one of their Gunboats that has the new electron beams installed, steal one of them, and bring it back here. I imagine one of them can't be much bigger than twenty or thirty tons, so you ought to be able to find space for it. Think you can do that?"|223|0
units.english: "We're going to have to fight them eventually, but first we need as much information as we can get on their new weapon systems. I'd like you to find one of their Gunboats that has the new electron beams installed, steal one of them, and bring it back here. I imagine one of them can't be much bigger than twenty or thirty tons, so you ought to be able to find space for it. Think you can do that?"
units.italian: "Dovremo combatterli prima o poi, ma prima ci serve più informazione possibile sui loro nuovi sistemi d'arma. Vorrei che trovassi una delle loro cannoniere con i nuovi fasci di elettroni installati, ne rubassi uno e lo portassi qui. Immagino che non possa essere molto più grande di venti o trenta tonnellate, quindi dovresti riuscire a trovargli spazio. Pensi di poterlo fare?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"How can I find a Gunboat that's all by itself? They're usually a part of a bigger fleet."|225|0
units.english: "How can I find a Gunboat that's all by itself? They're usually a part of a bigger fleet."
units.italian: "Come faccio a trovare una cannoniera tutta sola? Di solito fanno parte di una flotta più grande."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"I already plundered one of these new guns previously. I can give it to you now."|226|0
units.english: "I already plundered one of these new guns previously. I can give it to you now."
units.italian: "Ho già saccheggiato una di queste nuove armi in passato. Posso dartela adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"I already plundered one of these new turrets previously. I can give it to you now."|230|0
units.english: "I already plundered one of these new turrets previously. I can give it to you now."
units.italian: "Ho già saccheggiato una di queste nuove torrette in passato. Posso dartela adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"I know how to get one. I'll get you a spare."|234|0
units.english: "I know how to get one. I'll get you a spare."
units.italian: "So come procurarmene una. Te ne prendo un'altra."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	She thinks about that for a moment, then says, "The Navy has shifted most of their capital ships to the defecting systems in the south. That means that some of the systems up north will have lighter defenses. You might try Wei or Alnasl. Good luck, Captain."|241|0
units.english: She thinks about that for a moment, then says, "The Navy has shifted most of their capital ships to the defecting systems in the south. That means that some of the systems up north will have lighter defenses. You might try Wei or Alnasl. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: Ci pensa un momento, poi dice: "La Marina ha spostato la maggior parte delle navi capitali nei sistemi che stanno defezionando, a sud. Questo significa che alcuni sistemi a nord avranno difese più leggere. Potresti provare a Wei o ad Alnasl. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	"Oh! That's great to hear. I'll get my team to take it off your hands right away."|256|0
units.english: "Oh! That's great to hear. I'll get my team to take it off your hands right away."
units.italian: "Oh! È un'ottima notizia. Dirò subito alla mia squadra di prendersene carico."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|	You hand off the weapon to Freya's science team once they arrive. Freya tells you that she'll be waiting for you in a cafe in the spaceport after she's had a chance to look at it more closely.|257|0
units.english: You hand off the weapon to Freya's science team once they arrive. Freya tells you that she'll be waiting for you in a cafe in the spaceport after she's had a chance to look at it more closely.
units.italian: Consegni l'arma alla squadra scientifica di Freya quando arriva. Freya ti dice che ti aspetterà in un caffè dello spazioporto dopo aver avuto modo di esaminarla più da vicino.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|dialog|278|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you don't have an Electron Beam. Try finding lone Navy ships in Wei or Alnasl to disable and plunder from.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai un fascio di elettroni. Prova a trovare navi della Marina isolate a Wei o ad Alnasl, mettile fuori uso e saccheggiale.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B|dialog|283|0
units.english: You hand off the Electron Beam to Freya's science team. They tell you that she's waiting for you in a cafe in the spaceport.
units.italian: Consegni il fascio di elettroni alla squadra scientifica di Freya. Ti dicono che ti aspetta in un caffè dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B (Turret)|dialog|303|0
units.english: You hand off the Electron Turret to Freya's science team. They tell you that she's waiting for you in a cafe in the spaceport.
units.italian: Consegni la torretta a elettroni alla squadra scientifica di Freya. Ti dicono che ti aspetta in un caffè dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|While refueling on <planet>, a Free Worlds captain approaches you. "Captain <last>, I hear you're on the search for one of those new lasers the Navy is using."|316|0
units.english: While refueling on <planet>, a Free Worlds captain approaches you. "Captain <last>, I hear you're on the search for one of those new lasers the Navy is using."
units.italian: Mentre fai rifornimento su <planet>, ti si avvicina un capitano delle Free Worlds. "Capitano <last>, ho sentito che sei a caccia di uno di quei nuovi laser che usa la Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	"Yes, I am."|318|0
units.english: "Yes, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, è vero."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	"Do you have any information on them?"|319|0
units.english: "Do you have any information on them?"
units.italian: "Hai qualche informazione su di loro?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	"Good, because we have some information that could help you.|321|0
units.english: "Good, because we have some information that could help you.
units.italian: "Bene, perché abbiamo qualche informazione che potrebbe aiutarti.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	"We've had to stop all scouting parties into Republic space because of the strength of these new weapons, so we're flying in the dark on where the Navy is, but luckily we have received word from sympathizers in the Dirt Belt. The Navy has gathered forces with these new weapons in Alioth and Seginus, frequently entering the Wei system.|323|0
units.english: "We've had to stop all scouting parties into Republic space because of the strength of these new weapons, so we're flying in the dark on where the Navy is, but luckily we have received word from sympathizers in the Dirt Belt. The Navy has gathered forces with these new weapons in Alioth and Seginus, frequently entering the Wei system.
units.italian: "Abbiamo dovuto fermare tutte le squadre di esplorazione nello spazio della Repubblica per via della potenza di queste nuove armi, quindi voliamo alla cieca su dove sia la Marina, ma per fortuna abbiamo avuto notizie da simpatizzanti nella Fascia di Terra. La Marina ha radunato forze con queste nuove armi ad Alioth e Seginus, ed entra spesso nel sistema Wei.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	"They haven't been coming into Kornephoros, so they're likely just patrolling the area to dissuade us from making any sudden moves. This means that Wei likely isn't your best bet for stealing a weapon given the traffic, but I hear that things aren't much better beyond Lesath. I wish we had some ships to spare to help you, but we just don't have that kind of freedom right now."|324|0
units.english: "They haven't been coming into Kornephoros, so they're likely just patrolling the area to dissuade us from making any sudden moves. This means that Wei likely isn't your best bet for stealing a weapon given the traffic, but I hear that things aren't much better beyond Lesath. I wish we had some ships to spare to help you, but we just don't have that kind of freedom right now."
units.italian: "Non sono entrati a Kornephoros, quindi probabilmente stanno solo pattugliando la zona per dissuaderci da mosse improvvise. Questo significa che Wei, con tutto quel traffico, probabilmente non è il posto migliore per rubare un'arma, ma sento dire che le cose non vanno molto meglio oltre Lesath. Vorrei avere qualche nave da darti, ma al momento non abbiamo questo tipo di libertà."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 1|	You thank the Captain for the information and he wishes you good luck.|325|0
units.english: You thank the Captain for the information and he wishes you good luck.
units.italian: Ringrazi il capitano per le informazioni e lui ti augura buona fortuna.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Recon 1B: Alnasl Hint 2|You decide to scan the Navy ships entering and exiting the system by tapping into the surveillance rigs that you helped Freya set up so long ago. Many of the Navy ships are armed with these new Electron Beams, but they are appearing in fleets too big to take on alone. You notice though that almost all Navy traffic is to and from Alioth and Seginus, while only lone Gunboats are traveling to and from Alnasl. Perhaps you may be able to ambush one of these smaller ships on its own in Alnasl.|337|0
units.english: You decide to scan the Navy ships entering and exiting the system by tapping into the surveillance rigs that you helped Freya set up so long ago. Many of the Navy ships are armed with these new Electron Beams, but they are appearing in fleets too big to take on alone. You notice though that almost all Navy traffic is to and from Alioth and Seginus, while only lone Gunboats are traveling to and from Alnasl. Perhaps you may be able to ambush one of these smaller ships on its own in Alnasl.
units.italian: Decidi di scansionare le navi della Marina che entrano ed escono dal sistema collegandoti agli apparecchi di sorveglianza che avevi aiutato Freya a installare tanto tempo fa. Molte navi della Marina sono armate con questi nuovi fasci di elettroni, ma compaiono in flotte troppo grandi per affrontarle da soli. Noti però che quasi tutto il traffico della Marina va e viene da Alioth e Seginus, mentre solo cannoniere isolate viaggiano da e per Alnasl. Forse potresti tendere un'imboscata a una di queste navi più piccole, da sola, ad Alnasl.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|name|343|0
units.english: Escort Battle Fleet
units.italian: Scorta la flotta da battaglia

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|description|344|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> to gather a fleet of experimental new warships, and escort them back to Trinket.
units.italian: Va' su <planet> per radunare una flotta di nuove navi da guerra sperimentali e scortale fino a Trinket.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|Because this world is a tourist destination, there are innumerable fancy cafes in the spaceport. You meet up with Freya in one of the smaller ones. "Thank you for acquiring that weapon sample for us," she says. "It's typical Republic weaponry: far more efficient than anything we're able to make, and very well designed. My engineers were kind of in awe as they disassembled it."|358|0
units.english: Because this world is a tourist destination, there are innumerable fancy cafes in the spaceport. You meet up with Freya in one of the smaller ones. "Thank you for acquiring that weapon sample for us," she says. "It's typical Republic weaponry: far more efficient than anything we're able to make, and very well designed. My engineers were kind of in awe as they disassembled it."
units.italian: Dato che questo mondo è una meta turistica, nello spazioporto ci sono innumerevoli caffè eleganti. Ti incontri con Freya in uno dei più piccoli. "Grazie per averci procurato quel campione d'arma," dice. "È tipico equipaggiamento della Repubblica: molto più efficiente di qualsiasi cosa sappiamo fare noi, e progettato benissimo. I miei ingegneri sono rimasti quasi a bocca aperta mentre lo smontavano."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Do you have any tactical advice on fighting ships with one of those installed?"|360|0
units.english: "Do you have any tactical advice on fighting ships with one of those installed?"
units.italian: "Hai qualche consiglio tattico per combattere navi che ne montano uno?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Is there any chance we can reverse engineer it and build our own?"|362|0
units.english: "Is there any chance we can reverse engineer it and build our own?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche possibilità di fare ingegneria inversa e costruirne uno nostro?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Well," she says, "its range is very slightly shorter than our Plasma Turrets. You might be able to use that to your advantage if you can position your ship just right so that you can hit an enemy target but they can't hit you. You may find that useful in the upcoming battle."|365|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "its range is very slightly shorter than our Plasma Turrets. You might be able to use that to your advantage if you can position your ship just right so that you can hit an enemy target but they can't hit you. You may find that useful in the upcoming battle."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "la sua gittata è leggermente inferiore a quella delle nostre torrette al plasma. Potresti sfruttarlo, se riesci a posizionare la nave nel punto giusto per colpire un bersaglio nemico senza che lui possa colpirti. Potrebbe esserti utile nella battaglia che ci aspetta."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Maybe, although we haven't even mastered the art of building Heavy Lasers yet," she says. "We certainly won't have time before the upcoming battle."|368|0
units.english: "Maybe, although we haven't even mastered the art of building Heavy Lasers yet," she says. "We certainly won't have time before the upcoming battle."
units.italian: "Forse, anche se non abbiamo ancora imparato a costruire nemmeno i laser pesanti," dice. "Di certo non avremo tempo prima della battaglia che ci aspetta."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"So we're definitely going to attack the Navy?" you ask.|370|0
units.english: "So we're definitely going to attack the Navy?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quindi attaccheremo davvero la Marina?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"We have no choice," she says. "We tried diplomacy. If we don't show a willingness to support new worlds that want to join us, or if we don't seem to have enough strength to defend them, some of those that have joined us already may start to return to the Republic."|371|0
units.english: "We have no choice," she says. "We tried diplomacy. If we don't show a willingness to support new worlds that want to join us, or if we don't seem to have enough strength to defend them, some of those that have joined us already may start to return to the Republic."
units.italian: "Non abbiamo scelta," dice. "Abbiamo provato la diplomazia. Se non mostriamo la volontà di sostenere i nuovi mondi che vogliono unirsi a noi, o se non sembriamo abbastanza forti da difenderli, alcuni di quelli che si sono già uniti potrebbero cominciare a tornare alla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Okay, I'm ready to fight."|373|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm ready to fight."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono pronto a combattere."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"I wish it hadn't come to this, but if you think it's our only option, I'll join the fight."|374|0
units.english: "I wish it hadn't come to this, but if you think it's our only option, I'll join the fight."
units.italian: "Vorrei che non si fosse arrivati a questo, ma se pensi che sia la nostra unica opzione, mi unisco alla battaglia."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1|	"Thank you," she says. "But there's one more thing we must do to prepare for battle. I mentioned before that we have an ace up our sleeve. It's a new warship designed by Southbound Shipyards, intended to be a match for a Cruiser. They've only finished building three of them. I'd like you to travel to Zug and escort them back here. Once you return, we'll prepare for battle."|375|0
units.english: "Thank you," she says. "But there's one more thing we must do to prepare for battle. I mentioned before that we have an ace up our sleeve. It's a new warship designed by Southbound Shipyards, intended to be a match for a Cruiser. They've only finished building three of them. I'd like you to travel to Zug and escort them back here. Once you return, we'll prepare for battle."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Ma c'è ancora una cosa da fare per prepararci alla battaglia. Ti avevo detto che avevamo un asso nella manica. È una nuova nave da guerra progettata dai cantieri Southbound, pensata per essere all'altezza di un incrociatore. Ne hanno finite solo tre. Vorrei che andassi su Zug e le scortassi fino a qui. Quando torni, ci prepareremo alla battaglia."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|name|382|0
units.english: Escort Battle Fleet
units.italian: Scorta la flotta da battaglia

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|description|383|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of experimental warships to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta una flotta di navi da guerra sperimentali fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|When you land on <origin>, a Southbound Shipyards executive leads you to a hangar. The hangar is huge, but it clearly was not meant to hold a ship as large as the one it now contains. There is barely enough space for the cranes and catwalks being used by the construction crews.|395|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, a Southbound Shipyards executive leads you to a hangar. The hangar is huge, but it clearly was not meant to hold a ship as large as the one it now contains. There is barely enough space for the cranes and catwalks being used by the construction crews.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, un dirigente dei cantieri Southbound ti guida in un hangar. L'hangar è enorme, ma chiaramente non era pensato per contenere una nave grande come quella che ora ospita. C'è appena lo spazio per le gru e le passerelle usate dalle squadre di costruzione.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|	"The Dreadnought is a new design, the largest ship we've ever built. Only three of them have been completed so far." The size of the Dreadnought is impressive: as bulky as a Cruiser, it looks like a cross between a Bastion and an Argosy freighter. After giving you a moment to take in the view, he leads you out to a section of the spaceport where three Dreadnoughts are parked. Next to them, and looking tiny by comparison, are five Furies. You ask, "Are those Furies part of the battle fleet, too?"|396|0
units.english: "The Dreadnought is a new design, the largest ship we've ever built. Only three of them have been completed so far." The size of the Dreadnought is impressive: as bulky as a Cruiser, it looks like a cross between a Bastion and an Argosy freighter. After giving you a moment to take in the view, he leads you out to a section of the spaceport where three Dreadnoughts are parked. Next to them, and looking tiny by comparison, are five Furies. You ask, "Are those Furies part of the battle fleet, too?"
units.italian: "Il Dreadnought è un progetto nuovo, la nave più grande che abbiamo mai costruito. Finora ne sono state completate solo tre." La dimensione del Dreadnought è impressionante: massiccio come un incrociatore, sembra un incrocio fra una Bastion e un mercantile Argosy. Dopo averti lasciato un momento per assorbire la vista, ti guida in una sezione dello spazioporto dove sono parcheggiati tre Dreadnought. Accanto a loro, e minuscole in confronto, ci sono cinque Fury. Chiedi: "Anche quei Fury fanno parte della flotta da battaglia?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|	"Yes," he says, "equipped with some fancy new weapons from Barmy Edward up at Kraz Cybernetics that he said you helped test. I haven't seen them in action yet, but he's convinced they'll be useful against the Navy."|399|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "equipped with some fancy new weapons from Barmy Edward up at Kraz Cybernetics that he said you helped test. I haven't seen them in action yet, but he's convinced they'll be useful against the Navy."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "equipaggiati con alcune nuove armi stravaganti di Barmy Edward, lassù alla Kraz Cybernetics, che mi ha detto che le hai aiutate a provare. Non le ho ancora viste in azione, ma lui è convinto che saranno utili contro la Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|	"Yes," he says, "equipped with some fancy new weapons from Barmy Edward up at Kraz Cybernetics that he recently finished working on. He said they should be entering mass production soon. Flamethrowers, the crazy bastard. I haven't seen them in action yet, but he's convinced they'll be useful against the Navy."|402|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "equipped with some fancy new weapons from Barmy Edward up at Kraz Cybernetics that he recently finished working on. He said they should be entering mass production soon. Flamethrowers, the crazy bastard. I haven't seen them in action yet, but he's convinced they'll be useful against the Navy."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "equipaggiati con alcune nuove armi stravaganti di Barmy Edward, lassù alla Kraz Cybernetics, su cui ha appena finito di lavorare. Ha detto che dovrebbero entrare in produzione di massa a breve. Lanciafiamme, il pazzo bastardo. Non le ho ancora viste in azione, ma lui è convinto che saranno utili contro la Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|	You thank him for his time, and meet up with the captains of the battle fleet, arranging for them to follow you back to Trinket.|404|0
units.english: You thank him for his time, and meet up with the captains of the battle fleet, arranging for them to follow you back to Trinket.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per il tempo che ti ha dedicato e ti incontri con i capitani della flotta da battaglia, accordandoti perché ti seguano fino a Trinket.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|dialog|420|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 1B|dialog|423|0
units.english: You land on <planet> with the battle fleet. Time to meet up with Freya in the spaceport.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet> con la flotta da battaglia. È tempo di incontrare Freya allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|name|443|0
units.english: Attack Rastaban
units.italian: Attacca Rastaban

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|description|444|0
units.english: Travel directly to the <system> system, so that you will arrive on <day> and join the battle against the Navy. Disable or destroy all Navy ships in the system.
units.italian: Va' direttamente nel sistema <system>, così da arrivare il <day> e unirti alla battaglia contro la Marina. Metti fuori uso o distruggi tutte le navi della Marina nel sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|log|455|0
units.english: Preparing for another major battle with the Navy, this time in the Rastaban system, which just recently expressed an interest in joining the Free Worlds but has not been able to do so due to the Navy presence. The Free Worlds will be using a new model of warship, the Dreadnought, in this battle.
units.italian: Ti stai preparando a un'altra grande battaglia con la Marina, questa volta nel sistema Rastaban, che proprio di recente ha espresso l'interesse di unirsi alle Free Worlds ma non è riuscito a farlo per la presenza della Marina. In questa battaglia le Free Worlds useranno un nuovo modello di nave da guerra, il Dreadnought.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|When you meet up with Freya in the cafe, she looks like she hasn't slept in several days. "I can't believe we're headed for another major battle," she says. "I keep hoping the Navy will just pull back and not force us to fight them."|458|0
units.english: When you meet up with Freya in the cafe, she looks like she hasn't slept in several days. "I can't believe we're headed for another major battle," she says. "I keep hoping the Navy will just pull back and not force us to fight them."
units.italian: Quando incontri Freya al caffè, sembra che non dorma da diversi giorni. "Non riesco a credere che stiamo andando verso un'altra grande battaglia," dice. "Continuo a sperare che la Marina si ritiri e non ci costringa a combattere."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|	"It doesn't seem likely that Parliament would allow that."|460|0
units.english: "It doesn't seem likely that Parliament would allow that."
units.italian: "Non sembra probabile che il Parlamento lo permetta."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|	"Yes, their sense of honor can be inspiring at times, but right now it's annoying."|461|0
units.english: "Yes, their sense of honor can be inspiring at times, but right now it's annoying."
units.italian: "Sì, il loro senso dell'onore a volte è ammirevole, ma adesso è fastidioso."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|	"Indeed," she says. "Although, based on what Alondo said, the Navy hinted that if we made such a show of force that there was no way they could win the battle, they could honorably choose to retreat. So, if they start trying to retreat, let them go. But I suspect it will be a difficult battle to win."|462|0
units.english: "Indeed," she says. "Although, based on what Alondo said, the Navy hinted that if we made such a show of force that there was no way they could win the battle, they could honorably choose to retreat. So, if they start trying to retreat, let them go. But I suspect it will be a difficult battle to win."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "Anche se, da quanto ha detto Alondo, la Marina ha lasciato intendere che, se mostrassimo una forza tale che non avrebbero alcuna possibilità di vincere, potrebbero scegliere con onore di ritirarsi. Quindi, se cominciano a ritirarsi, lasciali andare. Ma sospetto che sarà una battaglia difficile da vincere."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|	"What's the battle plan?" you ask.|463|0
units.english: "What's the battle plan?" you ask.
units.italian: "Qual è il piano di battaglia?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|	"The fleet from Southbound Shipyards will be traveling with you," she says. "Other fleets with other commanders will be converging on Rastaban separately, at approximately the same time. So, you have no time to lose. You must travel directly to Rastaban from here, or else you will arrive too late to join in the fight. Good luck, captain."|464|0
units.english: "The fleet from Southbound Shipyards will be traveling with you," she says. "Other fleets with other commanders will be converging on Rastaban separately, at approximately the same time. So, you have no time to lose. You must travel directly to Rastaban from here, or else you will arrive too late to join in the fight. Good luck, captain."
units.italian: "La flotta dei cantieri Southbound viaggerà con te," dice. "Altre flotte con altri comandanti convergeranno su Rastaban separatamente, più o meno nello stesso momento. Quindi non hai tempo da perdere. Devi andare dritto a Rastaban da qui, o arriverai troppo tardi per unirti allo scontro. Buona fortuna, capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 2|dialog|551|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|name|559|0
units.english: Sweep for Navy Ships
units.italian: Bonifica dai resti della Marina

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|description|560|0
units.english: Travel through the systems near Rastaban and make sure that the remainder of the Navy occupation fleet is retreating. (If they are fleeing, let them flee.)
units.italian: Attraversa i sistemi vicini a Rastaban e assicurati che il resto della flotta di occupazione della Marina si stia ritirando. (Se stanno fuggendo, lasciali fuggire.)

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|log|572|0
units.english: The Navy has been driven out of the Rastaban system. That will allow the people on Harmony, Dancer, New Portland, and New India to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: La Marina è stata scacciata dal sistema Rastaban. Questo permetterà alla gente di Harmony, Dancer, New Portland e New India di unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|As soon as you land on <origin>, you contact Freya and let her know that the system is yours. "That's great news," she says. "Now we need to make sure they've pulled back from the neighboring systems, too. Take a few ships and sweep through Delta Sagittarii and Albaldah and make sure they're clear. Leave the rest of the fleet on Dancer to handle the prisoners and repairs."|574|0
units.english: As soon as you land on <origin>, you contact Freya and let her know that the system is yours. "That's great news," she says. "Now we need to make sure they've pulled back from the neighboring systems, too. Take a few ships and sweep through Delta Sagittarii and Albaldah and make sure they're clear. Leave the rest of the fleet on Dancer to handle the prisoners and repairs."
units.italian: Appena atterri su <origin>, contatti Freya e le fai sapere che il sistema è nostro. "È un'ottima notizia," dice. "Ora dobbiamo assicurarci che si siano ritirati anche dai sistemi vicini. Prendi qualche nave e setaccia Delta Sagittarii e Albaldah per assicurarti che siano liberi. Lascia il resto della flotta su Dancer a gestire i prigionieri e le riparazioni."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"What should I do if I encounter Navy ships on my patrol?"|576|0
units.english: "What should I do if I encounter Navy ships on my patrol?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare se incontro navi della Marina durante la pattuglia?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"What are we going to do with the prisoners?"|578|0
units.english: "What are we going to do with the prisoners?"
units.italian: "Che cosa faremo con i prigionieri?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"If they're fleeing, let them flee," she says, "but if you discover a strong Navy presence remaining in one of those systems, report back to Dancer before engaging them. Meanwhile, I'll ask Alondo to contact the Navy admirals and see if we can get Katya back in exchange for those prisoners."|581|0
units.english: "If they're fleeing, let them flee," she says, "but if you discover a strong Navy presence remaining in one of those systems, report back to Dancer before engaging them. Meanwhile, I'll ask Alondo to contact the Navy admirals and see if we can get Katya back in exchange for those prisoners."
units.italian: "Se stanno fuggendo, lasciali fuggire," dice, "ma se scopri che in uno di quei sistemi resta una forte presenza della Marina, riferisci su Dancer prima di attaccarli. Nel frattempo chiederò ad Alondo di contattare gli ammiragli della Marina e vedere se possiamo riavere Katya in cambio di quei prigionieri."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"Well," she says, "my hope is that we can trade them for any of our people who have been captured so far in this war. Including Katya."|584|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "my hope is that we can trade them for any of our people who have been captured so far in this war. Including Katya."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "la mia speranza è di scambiarli con qualcuno dei nostri che è stato catturato finora in questa guerra. Compresa Katya."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"You think she's still alive?" you ask.|587|0
units.english: "You think she's still alive?" you ask.
units.italian: "Pensi che sia ancora viva?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|	"Certainly, and having this many Navy prisoners gives us a great bargaining chip for negotiating her freedom. Now, gather your patrol, and by the time you get back, I hope we will have arranged for her release."|588|0
units.english: "Certainly, and having this many Navy prisoners gives us a great bargaining chip for negotiating her freedom. Now, gather your patrol, and by the time you get back, I hope we will have arranged for her release."
units.italian: "Certamente, e avere tutti questi prigionieri della Marina ci dà un'ottima merce di scambio per negoziare la sua libertà. Ora raduna la pattuglia, e quando torni spero che avremo organizzato la sua liberazione."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Battle 3|dialog|610|0
units.english: You've finished patrolling the nearby systems. Now you can meet up with Freya in the spaceport, and hopefully she will have good news about Katya.
units.italian: Hai finito di pattugliare i sistemi vicini. Ora puoi incontrare Freya allo spazioporto, e speriamo che abbia buone notizie su Katya.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|name|615|0
units.english: Return Navy Prisoners
units.italian: Restituisci i prigionieri

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|description|616|0
units.english: As a goodwill gesture, return the Navy prisoners to <destination> rather than imprisoning them on Clink. Your safe passage ends on <day>.
units.italian: Come gesto di buona volontà, restituisci i prigionieri della Marina a <destination> invece di imprigionarli su Clink. Il tuo salvacondotto scade il <day>.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|You find Freya and Alondo watching over a large hangar where several hundred Navy crew and support staff are being kept under guard. Alondo says, "I contacted the Navy admirals. They say Katya is not under their control; she is a prisoner of the Intelligence bureau, and arranging her release could take weeks. But they promised that if we return their prisoners now, they will ensure Katya's release and return her to us soon."|628|0
units.english: You find Freya and Alondo watching over a large hangar where several hundred Navy crew and support staff are being kept under guard. Alondo says, "I contacted the Navy admirals. They say Katya is not under their control; she is a prisoner of the Intelligence bureau, and arranging her release could take weeks. But they promised that if we return their prisoners now, they will ensure Katya's release and return her to us soon."
units.italian: Trovi Freya e Alondo che sorvegliano un grande hangar dove diverse centinaia di membri degli equipaggi e del personale di supporto della Marina sono tenuti sotto scorta. Alondo dice: "Ho contattato gli ammiragli della Marina. Dicono che Katya non è sotto il loro controllo; è prigioniera dell'Ufficio dell'Intelligence, e organizzare la sua liberazione potrebbe richiedere settimane. Ma hanno promesso che, se restituiamo loro i prigionieri adesso, si assicureranno della liberazione di Katya e ce la restituiranno presto."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"How do we know they won't break that promise?"|630|0
units.english: "How do we know they won't break that promise?"
units.italian: "Come facciamo a sapere che non tradiranno quella promessa?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"Why not just keep the prisoners until we have Katya back safely?"|631|0
units.english: "Why not just keep the prisoners until we have Katya back safely?"
units.italian: "Perché non teniamo i prigionieri finché non avremo Katya di nuovo al sicuro?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	Freya sighs. "Alondo claims that the admirals value their honor so highly that we can trust their promise. I am not so sure. Even if the admirals do their best, what if Intelligence refuses to honor the deal we make?"|632|0
units.english: Freya sighs. "Alondo claims that the admirals value their honor so highly that we can trust their promise. I am not so sure. Even if the admirals do their best, what if Intelligence refuses to honor the deal we make?"
units.italian: Freya sospira. "Alondo sostiene che gli ammiragli tengono così tanto al loro onore che possiamo fidarci della loro promessa. Io non ne sono così sicura. Anche se gli ammiragli faranno del loro meglio, e se l'Intelligence rifiutasse di onorare l'accordo che facciamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	Alondo says, "On the other hand, if we release these prisoners on parole as a gesture of good faith, it could bring us much closer to a diplomatic end to this war. Which would be far preferable to another battle as bloody as this one."|633|0
units.english: Alondo says, "On the other hand, if we release these prisoners on parole as a gesture of good faith, it could bring us much closer to a diplomatic end to this war. Which would be far preferable to another battle as bloody as this one."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "D'altra parte, se rilasciamo questi prigionieri sulla parola come gesto di buona fede, potrebbe avvicinarci molto a una fine diplomatica di questa guerra. Il che sarebbe di gran lunga preferibile a un'altra battaglia sanguinosa come questa."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	Freya says, "And meanwhile, JJ is off on a top secret mission. And that means he's not available to consult with, and we need to make this decision now."|634|0
units.english: Freya says, "And meanwhile, JJ is off on a top secret mission. And that means he's not available to consult with, and we need to make this decision now."
units.italian: Freya dice: "E nel frattempo JJ è via in una missione top secret. Il che significa che non è disponibile per un consulto, e dobbiamo prendere questa decisione adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"And since we cannot agree," says Alondo, "we are giving you the deciding vote."|635|0
units.english: "And since we cannot agree," says Alondo, "we are giving you the deciding vote."
units.italian: "E dato che non riusciamo a metterci d'accordo," dice Alondo, "diamo a te il voto decisivo."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"What do you mean?"|637|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"We will be putting you in charge of the prisoner convoy," says Alondo, "and arranging a week of safe passage for you. If you think we should return the prisoners as a gesture of goodwill to improve our chances of a diplomatic end to this war, bring the convoy to <planet>."|638|0
units.english: "We will be putting you in charge of the prisoner convoy," says Alondo, "and arranging a week of safe passage for you. If you think we should return the prisoners as a gesture of goodwill to improve our chances of a diplomatic end to this war, bring the convoy to <planet>."
units.italian: "Ti metteremo a capo del convoglio dei prigionieri," dice Alondo, "e organizzeremo una settimana di salvacondotto per te. Se pensi che dovremmo restituire i prigionieri come gesto di buona volontà per migliorare le nostre possibilità di una fine diplomatica di questa guerra, porta il convoglio su <planet>."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	"But if you think we should hold on to the prisoners until we receive Katya safely back," says Freya, "bring the convoy to Clink. Understand?"|639|0
units.english: "But if you think we should hold on to the prisoners until we receive Katya safely back," says Freya, "bring the convoy to Clink. Understand?"
units.italian: "Ma se pensi che dovremmo tenere i prigionieri finché non avremo Katya di nuovo al sicuro," dice Freya, "porta il convoglio su Clink. Chiaro?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|	It's a serious choice facing you, with no clear right decision. You thank them for trusting you, and begin preparations to escort the prisoners.|640|0
units.english: It's a serious choice facing you, with no clear right decision. You thank them for trusting you, and begin preparations to escort the prisoners.
units.italian: È una scelta seria quella che ti trovi davanti, senza una decisione chiaramente giusta. Li ringrazi per la fiducia e cominci i preparativi per scortare i prigionieri.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|dialog|662|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Release|log|666|0
units.english: Was given the choice of what to do with the Navy prisoners from the battle for Rastaban, and decided to parole and release them rather than imprisoning them. Hopefully that will earn some goodwill from the Navy in the future.
units.italian: Ti è stata data la scelta di che cosa fare dei prigionieri della Marina dalla battaglia per Rastaban, e hai deciso di rilasciarli sulla parola invece di imprigionarli. Speriamo che questo ci guadagni un po' di benevolenza dalla Marina in futuro.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Keep|name|671|0
units.english: Keep Navy Prisoners
units.italian: Trattieni i prigionieri

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Keep|description|672|0
units.english: Rather than releasing the Navy prisoners, deliver them to the mines on Clink, to be held until Katya is returned to you.
units.italian: Invece di rilasciare i prigionieri della Marina, consegnali alle miniere su Clink, perché siano tenuti lì finché Katya non ti sarà restituita.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Keep|log|683|0
units.english: Was given the choice of what to do with the Navy prisoners from the battle for Rastaban, and decided to imprison them on Clink. Hopefully that will weaken the Navy, a little bit.
units.italian: Ti è stata data la scelta di che cosa fare dei prigionieri della Marina dalla battaglia per Rastaban, e hai deciso di imprigionarli su Clink. Speriamo che questo indebolisca la Marina, almeno un po'.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|name|689|0
units.english: Report to Dancer
units.italian: Riferisci a Dancer

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|description|690|0
units.english: Report back to Freya and Alondo on Dancer that you chose to release the prisoners.
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya e Alondo su Dancer che hai scelto di rilasciare i prigionieri.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|<origin> has become the home of a major Navy base almost overnight; the number of ships and people here is almost overwhelming. You return the prisoners, who have all taken an oath of parole to take no further part in the war against the Free Worlds. One of the four Navy admirals who you and Alondo met with earlier is here, and as you are unloading the prisoners, he says, "More volunteers for the 'Oathkeepers,' I see."|700|0
units.english: <origin> has become the home of a major Navy base almost overnight; the number of ships and people here is almost overwhelming. You return the prisoners, who have all taken an oath of parole to take no further part in the war against the Free Worlds. One of the four Navy admirals who you and Alondo met with earlier is here, and as you are unloading the prisoners, he says, "More volunteers for the 'Oathkeepers,' I see."
units.italian: <origin> è diventata la sede di una grande base della Marina quasi da un giorno all'altro; il numero di navi e di persone qui è quasi schiacciante. Restituisci i prigionieri, che hanno tutti prestato giuramento di non prendere più parte alla guerra contro le Free Worlds. Uno dei quattro ammiragli della Marina che tu e Alondo avevate incontrato è qui, e mentre scaricate i prigionieri dice: "Altri volontari per gli 'Oathkeepers', vedo."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|	"Who are the 'Oathkeepers'?"|702|0
units.english: "Who are the 'Oathkeepers'?"
units.italian: "Chi sono gli 'Oathkeepers'?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|	"The officers you granted parole to months ago. We reassigned them all to duty in the north, patrolling for pirates."|703|0
units.english: "The officers you granted parole to months ago. We reassigned them all to duty in the north, patrolling for pirates."
units.italian: "Gli ufficiali a cui avete concesso la parola mesi fa. Li abbiamo riassegnati tutti al servizio a nord, a pattugliare contro i pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|	"You mean they really do honor their promise not to fight us?" you ask.|704|0
units.english: "You mean they really do honor their promise not to fight us?" you ask.
units.italian: "Vuoi dire che onorano davvero la promessa di non combatterci?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|	"Of course. They swore a vow, after all." You suspect it's not quite that simple, but decide that questioning this admiral's word would be pointless. As you are getting ready to leave, he says, "Don't worry, we will be returning Miss Reynolds to you shortly. The ship carrying her should arrive here in a week or two."|705|0
units.english: "Of course. They swore a vow, after all." You suspect it's not quite that simple, but decide that questioning this admiral's word would be pointless. As you are getting ready to leave, he says, "Don't worry, we will be returning Miss Reynolds to you shortly. The ship carrying her should arrive here in a week or two."
units.italian: "Certo. Hanno fatto un giuramento, dopotutto." Sospetti che non sia così semplice, ma decidi che mettere in dubbio la parola di questo ammiraglio sarebbe inutile. Mentre ti prepari a partire, dice: "Non preoccuparti, vi restituiremo la signorina Reynolds a breve. La nave che la porta dovrebbe arrivare qui fra una settimana o due."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|	You hope he is telling the truth. Now, it is time to meet with Freya and Alondo and decide what should be done next.|706|0
units.english: You hope he is telling the truth. Now, it is time to meet with Freya and Alondo and decide what should be done next.
units.italian: Speri che dica la verità. Ora è tempo di incontrare Freya e Alondo e decidere che cosa fare.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Released|dialog|724|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Kept|name|732|0
units.english: Report to Dancer
units.italian: Riferisci a Dancer

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Kept|description|733|0
units.english: Report back to Freya and Alondo on Dancer that you chose to keep the prisoners on Clink.
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya e Alondo su Dancer che hai scelto di tenere i prigionieri su Clink.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Prisoners - Kept|You drop off the prisoners at the mines of Clink, to be held until the Navy returns Katya to you. Now, it's time to meet with Freya and Alondo and decide what should be done next.|743|0
units.english: You drop off the prisoners at the mines of Clink, to be held until the Navy returns Katya to you. Now, it's time to meet with Freya and Alondo and decide what should be done next.
units.italian: Lasci i prigionieri alle miniere di Clink, perché siano tenuti lì finché la Marina non ti restituirà Katya. Ora è tempo di incontrare Freya e Alondo e decidere che cosa fare.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|log|758|0
units.english: Once again there is no immediate work to be done for the Free Worlds. This would be a good time to earn some money for an upgraded ship, if possible.
units.italian: Ancora una volta non c'è lavoro immediato da fare per le Free Worlds. Questo sarebbe un buon momento per guadagnare qualche soldo per una nave migliore, se possibile.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|You land on Dancer and report to Alondo and Freya that the prisoner transfer is complete. "What do we do now?" you ask.|763|0
units.english: You land on Dancer and report to Alondo and Freya that the prisoner transfer is complete. "What do we do now?" you ask.
units.italian: Atterri su Dancer e riferisci ad Alondo e Freya che il trasferimento dei prigionieri è concluso. "Che cosa facciamo adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	Freya says, "Well, I hope we're done with fighting for a while, now. We'll stay here to hold this system against any Navy retaliation. And, we'll keep hoping that Parliament might come to their senses and agree to a diplomatic end to this conflict. In the meantime I suggest you spend some time doing whatever it is you do to earn money on the side - carrying passengers or freight or hunting pirates. We'll contact you when things begin to move forward again."|764|0
units.english: Freya says, "Well, I hope we're done with fighting for a while, now. We'll stay here to hold this system against any Navy retaliation. And, we'll keep hoping that Parliament might come to their senses and agree to a diplomatic end to this conflict. In the meantime I suggest you spend some time doing whatever it is you do to earn money on the side - carrying passengers or freight or hunting pirates. We'll contact you when things begin to move forward again."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Beh, spero che per un po' abbiamo finito di combattere. Resteremo qui a tenere questo sistema contro qualsiasi rappresaglia della Marina. E continueremo a sperare che il Parlamento torni in sé e accetti una fine diplomatica di questo conflitto. Nel frattempo ti suggerisco di passare un po' di tempo a fare quello che fai per guadagnare soldi per conto tuo: trasportare passeggeri o merci, o dare la caccia ai pirati. Ti contatteremo quando le cose ricominceranno a muoversi."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	"Sounds good. I'll hope to hear from you soon."|766|0
units.english: "Sounds good. I'll hope to hear from you soon."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Spero di avere vostre notizie presto."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	"You're sure there's nothing else I can do to help the Free Worlds right now?"|768|0
units.english: "You're sure there's nothing else I can do to help the Free Worlds right now?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che non ci sia altro che posso fare per le Free Worlds adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	Alondo says, "You might hear from some other folks who could use your assistance, but as for the Council, I think it's a waiting game for us right now. Please don't think we aren't grateful for your help, Captain. All we're saying is that hopefully, for a few months at least, we'll all be able to take a break from fighting and go back to actually living our lives."|769|0
units.english: Alondo says, "You might hear from some other folks who could use your assistance, but as for the Council, I think it's a waiting game for us right now. Please don't think we aren't grateful for your help, Captain. All we're saying is that hopefully, for a few months at least, we'll all be able to take a break from fighting and go back to actually living our lives."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Potresti avere notizie da altra gente a cui potrebbe servire il tuo aiuto, ma quanto al Consiglio, credo che per noi sia un momento di attesa. Per favore non pensare che non siamo grati del tuo aiuto, Capitano. Stiamo solo dicendo che speriamo, almeno per qualche mese, di poter tutti prendere una pausa dai combattimenti e tornare a vivere davvero le nostre vite."
