units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	"Before you leave, Captain," Freya says. "The Senate has decided to reinstate your pay after these recent events. You should now have a salary of 2,100 credits, just like before."|775|0
units.english: "Before you leave, Captain," Freya says. "The Senate has decided to reinstate your pay after these recent events. You should now have a salary of 2,100 credits, just like before."
units.italian: "Prima che tu parta, Capitano," dice Freya. "Il Senato ha deciso di reintegrare il tuo stipendio dopo gli eventi recenti. Ora dovresti avere una paga di 2.100 crediti, come prima."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break|	Alondo gives you a nod. "We'll contact you as soon as things get interesting again."|778|0
units.english: Alondo gives you a nod. "We'll contact you as soon as things get interesting again."
units.italian: Alondo ti fa un cenno. "Ti contatteremo appena le cose torneranno interessanti."

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break Ends|name|784|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break Ends|description|785|0
units.english: Travel as quickly as possible to <destination> to rejoin the main Free Worlds fleet.
units.italian: Recati il più in fretta possibile su <destination> per riunirti alla flotta principale delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Southern Break Ends|Soon after you land on <origin>, you receive a message from Freya: "Greetings, Captain <last>! I hope you've made good use of your time off, because we're about to be right in the thick of it once again. As soon as you're able, please come rejoin the fleet on Dancer. We have some urgent and sensitive work to do."|796|0
units.english: Soon after you land on <origin>, you receive a message from Freya: "Greetings, Captain <last>! I hope you've made good use of your time off, because we're about to be right in the thick of it once again. As soon as you're able, please come rejoin the fleet on Dancer. We have some urgent and sensitive work to do."
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri su <origin>, ricevi un messaggio da Freya: "Salve, Capitano <last>! Spero che tu abbia fatto buon uso del tempo libero, perché stiamo per essere di nuovo nel pieno della mischia. Appena puoi, per favore raggiungici alla flotta su Dancer. Abbiamo del lavoro urgente e delicato da fare."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|name|803|0
units.english: Northern Expansion
units.italian: Espansione a nord

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|description|804|0
units.english: Take a fleet to <destination> (visiting <waypoints> along the way), securing those systems to allow them to defect to the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Porta una flotta su <destination> (passando per <waypoints>), mettendo in sicurezza quei sistemi perché possano defezionare a favore delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|blocked|814|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya: "Captain, please meet up with us as soon as you have a bunk free for Alondo." You have no bunks free, so you should return here once you have made one available.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya: "Capitano, per favore raggiungici appena avrai una cuccetta libera per Alondo." Non hai cuccette libere, quindi dovresti tornare qui quando ne avrai resa disponibile una.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|log|819|0
units.english: Three more planets have decided to defect to the Free Worlds: Clark, New Tibet, and New Holland.
units.italian: Altri tre pianeti hanno deciso di defezionare a favore delle Free Worlds: Clark, New Tibet e New Holland.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|When you land on Dancer, the Free Worlds fleet appears to be preparing for another battle: missiles and torpedoes are being loaded onto ships and crew members are running around. You eventually find Freya and Alondo, and ask them what is going on.|821|0
units.english: When you land on Dancer, the Free Worlds fleet appears to be preparing for another battle: missiles and torpedoes are being loaded onto ships and crew members are running around. You eventually find Freya and Alondo, and ask them what is going on.
units.italian: Quando atterri su Dancer, la flotta delle Free Worlds sembra prepararsi a un'altra battaglia: missili e siluri vengono caricati sulle navi e i membri degli equipaggi corrono qua e là. Alla fine trovi Freya e Alondo, e chiedi che cosa succede.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|	"Another three worlds have secretly told us they are ready to defect," says Alondo, "and this time around we want to get there before the Navy does."|822|0
units.english: "Another three worlds have secretly told us they are ready to defect," says Alondo, "and this time around we want to get there before the Navy does."
units.italian: "Altri tre mondi ci hanno detto in segreto che sono pronti a defezionare," dice Alondo, "e questa volta vogliamo arrivarci prima della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|	Freya says, "We need you to take Alondo, along with the ships that we've been able to muster, and fly through the <waypoints> systems, then land on <destination>. If all goes well, you will get through to <planet> before the Republic can muster reinforcements. Drive off any Republic ships you encounter along the way."|823|0
units.english: Freya says, "We need you to take Alondo, along with the ships that we've been able to muster, and fly through the <waypoints> systems, then land on <destination>. If all goes well, you will get through to <planet> before the Republic can muster reinforcements. Drive off any Republic ships you encounter along the way."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Dobbiamo che tu porti Alondo, insieme alle navi che siamo riusciti a radunare, attraverso i sistemi <waypoints>, poi atterri su <destination>. Se tutto va bene, arriverai su <planet> prima che la Repubblica possa radunare rinforzi. Scaccia qualsiasi nave della Repubblica che incontri lungo la strada."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 1|As soon as you land, Alondo rushes out of your ship to meet with the governor of <planet> and "get these papers signed before they change their minds." He tells you to meet him back in the spaceport in an hour.|851|0
units.english: As soon as you land, Alondo rushes out of your ship to meet with the governor of <planet> and "get these papers signed before they change their minds." He tells you to meet him back in the spaceport in an hour.
units.italian: Appena atterri, Alondo si precipita fuori dalla tua nave per incontrare il governatore di <planet> e "far firmare questi documenti prima che cambino idea". Ti dice di rivederlo allo spazioporto fra un'ora.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|name|856|0
units.english: Meet With Freya
units.italian: Incontra Freya

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|description|857|0
units.english: Now that the northern star systems are secured, go back to <planet> to meet with Freya and work with her to remove any surveillance equipment the Navy installed in the Wei system or elsewhere.
units.italian: Ora che i sistemi stellari a nord sono al sicuro, torna su <planet> per incontrare Freya e lavorare con lei per rimuovere le apparecchiature di sorveglianza che la Marina ha installato nel sistema Wei o altrove.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|You wait in the spaceport bar for a while. Your Free Worlds uniform has drawn a good deal of attention from the locals: a few of them waved to you when you came in, or gave other subtle signs of approval, but no one is sitting with you. They probably want to avoid getting into trouble with the Republic if the Free Worlds are not able to hold this planet.|867|0
units.english: You wait in the spaceport bar for a while. Your Free Worlds uniform has drawn a good deal of attention from the locals: a few of them waved to you when you came in, or gave other subtle signs of approval, but no one is sitting with you. They probably want to avoid getting into trouble with the Republic if the Free Worlds are not able to hold this planet.
units.italian: Aspetti un po' nel bar dello spazioporto. La tua uniforme delle Free Worlds ha attirato parecchia attenzione fra la gente del posto: alcuni ti hanno salutato con la mano quando sei entrato, o ti hanno fatto altri segni discreti di approvazione, ma nessuno si siede con te. Probabilmente vogliono evitare guai con la Repubblica, nel caso le Free Worlds non riescano a tenere questo pianeta.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	Finally Alondo arrives. "Come on," he says. "Let's talk outside." He seems tired, but not frightened.|868|0
units.english: Finally Alondo arrives. "Come on," he says. "Let's talk outside." He seems tired, but not frightened.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva Alondo. "Vieni," dice. "Parliamo fuori." Sembra stanco, ma non spaventato.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Is everything okay?"|870|0
units.english: "Is everything okay?"
units.italian: "Va tutto bene?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Did they agree to join us?"|871|0
units.english: "Did they agree to join us?"
units.italian: "Hanno accettato di unirsi a noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Yes, yes, of course," he says. "But taking on six more worlds all of a sudden - I just hope it's not more than we can handle. When the Navy recovers from the battle at Rastaban and strikes back, now we have much less idea where that strike will fall."|872|0
units.english: "Yes, yes, of course," he says. "But taking on six more worlds all of a sudden - I just hope it's not more than we can handle. When the Navy recovers from the battle at Rastaban and strikes back, now we have much less idea where that strike will fall."
units.italian: "Sì, sì, certo," dice. "Ma prendere altri sei mondi tutto d'un colpo... spero solo che non sia più di quanto possiamo gestire. Quando la Marina si riprenderà dalla battaglia di Rastaban e contrattaccherà, ora abbiamo molta meno idea di dove cadrà quel colpo."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"So, what do we do next?" you ask.|873|0
units.english: "So, what do we do next?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa facciamo adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"We need to move more of our fleet up here to the front," he says, "but I'd be willing to bet that the Navy has installed surveillance equipment on Hope, and maybe a few other planets in this sector too. Which I should have thought of before, because in order to be sure we've tracked every last one down, we need Freya's expertise in signals and sensors. So, I'm sending you to meet up with her on Dancer."|874|0
units.english: "We need to move more of our fleet up here to the front," he says, "but I'd be willing to bet that the Navy has installed surveillance equipment on Hope, and maybe a few other planets in this sector too. Which I should have thought of before, because in order to be sure we've tracked every last one down, we need Freya's expertise in signals and sensors. So, I'm sending you to meet up with her on Dancer."
units.italian: "Dobbiamo spostare altre navi della nostra flotta quassù, al fronte," dice, "ma scommetterei che la Marina ha installato apparecchiature di sorveglianza su Hope, e forse su qualche altro pianeta di questo settore. Cosa a cui avrei dovuto pensare prima, perché per essere sicuri di averle trovate tutte quante ci serve l'esperienza di Freya in segnali e sensori. Quindi ti mando a incontrarla su Dancer."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"No problem. Don't worry, we'll be able to handle this just fine."|876|0
units.english: "No problem. Don't worry, we'll be able to handle this just fine."
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Non preoccuparti, sapremo gestirlo benissimo."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Aren't you afraid the Navy will strike while I'm off fetching her?"|878|0
units.english: "Aren't you afraid the Navy will strike while I'm off fetching her?"
units.italian: "Non temi che la Marina attacchi mentre sono via a prenderla?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Of course," he says. "But I talked with JJ, and he thinks they're still recovering from the last battle. And if their sensors all go dark, that will be a big deterrent to keep them from attacking - certainly more of a deterrent than you could add by staying here with our fleet."|879|0
units.english: "Of course," he says. "But I talked with JJ, and he thinks they're still recovering from the last battle. And if their sensors all go dark, that will be a big deterrent to keep them from attacking - certainly more of a deterrent than you could add by staying here with our fleet."
units.italian: "Certo," dice. "Ma ho parlato con JJ, e pensa che si stiano ancora riprendendo dall'ultima battaglia. E se tutti i loro sensori si spengono, sarà un forte deterrente per trattenerli dall'attaccare: di sicuro un deterrente maggiore di quello che potresti aggiungere restando qui con la nostra flotta."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2|	"Understood," you say. "I'll go get Freya."|880|0
units.english: "Understood," you say. "I'll go get Freya."
units.italian: "Capito," dici. "Vado a prendere Freya."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2A|name|887|0
units.english: Sweep Hope
units.italian: Bonifica Hope

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2A|description|888|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet> and destroy any Navy sensor emplacements that she finds there.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet> e distruggi tutte le installazioni di sensori della Marina che trova lì.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2A|blocked|894|0
units.english: To continue this mission, you need a bunk free for Freya. Return here when you have made one available.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Freya. Torna qui quando ne avrai resa disponibile una.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2A|As soon as you land, Freya shows up at your ship with a small suitcase full of clothes. "No time to waste," she says. "Let's get going. Our first target will be <planet>, since we know for a fact that they were installing something there."|900|0
units.english: As soon as you land, Freya shows up at your ship with a small suitcase full of clothes. "No time to waste," she says. "Let's get going. Our first target will be <planet>, since we know for a fact that they were installing something there."
units.italian: Appena atterri, Freya si presenta alla tua nave con una piccola valigia piena di vestiti. "Non c'è tempo da perdere," dice. "Andiamo. Il nostro primo bersaglio sarà <planet>, dato che sappiamo per certo che ci stavano installando qualcosa."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2A|dialog|903|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2B|name|909|0
units.english: Sweep Clark
units.italian: Bonifica Clark

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2B|description|910|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet> per controllare se ci sono stazioni di sorveglianza della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2B|As you approach the planet, Freya sits down at your ship's sensor console and begins fiddling with some settings that you didn't even know existed. She seems entirely focused, and clearly knows what she is doing. You recall being told that she is an engineer, not a politician or a military commander, which makes the fact that she has been able to step up as such a strong leader in the Council very impressive.|921|0
units.english: As you approach the planet, Freya sits down at your ship's sensor console and begins fiddling with some settings that you didn't even know existed. She seems entirely focused, and clearly knows what she is doing. You recall being told that she is an engineer, not a politician or a military commander, which makes the fact that she has been able to step up as such a strong leader in the Council very impressive.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al pianeta, Freya si siede alla consolle dei sensori della tua nave e comincia a smanettare con impostazioni di cui non sapevi nemmeno l'esistenza. Sembra completamente concentrata, e chiaramente sa quello che fa. Ricordi di aver sentito dire che è un'ingegnere, non una politica né una comandante militare, il che rende ancora più notevole il fatto che sia riuscita a diventare una leader così forte nel Consiglio.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2B|	"Yup, eight different stations," she says finally, "including this one that I nearly overlooked, buried ten meters under the ice, that is acting as a relay for them." She points out each station on your map, and you fly by each one and destroy it. "Now," she says, "that was what had me most worried, but for the sake of completeness we should sweep the other new worlds, too. Let's go to <planet> next."|922|0
units.english: "Yup, eight different stations," she says finally, "including this one that I nearly overlooked, buried ten meters under the ice, that is acting as a relay for them." She points out each station on your map, and you fly by each one and destroy it. "Now," she says, "that was what had me most worried, but for the sake of completeness we should sweep the other new worlds, too. Let's go to <planet> next."
units.italian: "Esatto, otto stazioni diverse," dice alla fine, "compresa questa che quasi mi sfuggiva, sepolta dieci metri sotto il ghiaccio, che funge da ripetitore per loro." Ti indica ogni stazione sulla mappa, e tu voli accanto a ciascuna e la distruggi. "Ora," dice, "era questa che mi preoccupava di più, ma per completezza dovremmo passare al setaccio anche gli altri nuovi mondi. Andiamo su <planet> adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2B|dialog|925|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|name|931|0
units.english: Sweep New Holland
units.italian: Bonifica New Holland

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|description|932|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet> per controllare se ci sono stazioni di sorveglianza della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|Once again, Freya works some sort of magic with your ship's sensors and manages to locate another surveillance station. "Right in the middle of the city," she says. "We'll have to go there on foot and disable it."|943|0
units.english: Once again, Freya works some sort of magic with your ship's sensors and manages to locate another surveillance station. "Right in the middle of the city," she says. "We'll have to go there on foot and disable it."
units.italian: Ancora una volta Freya fa una specie di magia con i sensori della tua nave e riesce a localizzare un'altra stazione di sorveglianza. "Proprio in mezzo alla città," dice. "Dovremo andarci a piedi e disattivarla."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|	"Are you worried that it might be guarded?"|945|0
units.english: "Are you worried that it might be guarded?"
units.italian: "Temi che possa essere sorvegliata?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|	"Okay, I'll grab my favorite guns and explosives!"|947|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll grab my favorite guns and explosives!"
units.italian: "Va bene, prendo le mie armi ed esplosivi preferiti!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|	"A little worried," she says. "We should be armed, just in case. But I'm not picking up any human heat signatures from the building, and it wouldn't be like the Navy to leave some of their own behind for us to capture."|950|0
units.english: "A little worried," she says. "We should be armed, just in case. But I'm not picking up any human heat signatures from the building, and it wouldn't be like the Navy to leave some of their own behind for us to capture."
units.italian: "Un po'," dice. "Dovremmo essere armati, per sicurezza. Ma non rilevo nessuna firma termica umana dall'edificio, e non sarebbe da Marina lasciare qualcuno dei suoi lì per farselo catturare."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|	"Now, now," she says, "we just convinced this world to join us, let's not go blowing up their whole factory district. I don't see any human heat signatures, but you can bring your weapons anyway just in case."|953|0
units.english: "Now, now," she says, "we just convinced this world to join us, let's not go blowing up their whole factory district. I don't see any human heat signatures, but you can bring your weapons anyway just in case."
units.italian: "Calma, calma," dice, "abbiamo appena convinto questo mondo a unirsi a noi, non mettiamoci a far saltare in aria tutto il loro distretto industriale. Non vedo firme termiche umane, ma puoi portare le armi comunque, per sicurezza."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|	Warily, you approach the sensor installation, kicking down the door to an old abandoned warehouse. Freya is right - it's not guarded. She shuts down the transmitter, then asks for your help bringing some of the sensors and other equipment back to your ship. "I always love having a chance to look at Navy technology," she says. "Now, let's head to <planet>."|955|0
units.english: Warily, you approach the sensor installation, kicking down the door to an old abandoned warehouse. Freya is right - it's not guarded. She shuts down the transmitter, then asks for your help bringing some of the sensors and other equipment back to your ship. "I always love having a chance to look at Navy technology," she says. "Now, let's head to <planet>."
units.italian: Con cautela ti avvicini all'installazione dei sensori, sfondando la porta di un vecchio magazzino abbandonato. Freya ha ragione: non è sorvegliata. Spegne il trasmettitore, poi ti chiede aiuto per portare sulla tua nave alcuni dei sensori e delle altre attrezzature. "Adoro sempre avere la possibilità di dare un'occhiata alla tecnologia della Marina," dice. "Ora andiamo su <planet>."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2C|dialog|958|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2D|name|964|0
units.english: Sweep New Tibet
units.italian: Bonifica New Tibet

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2D|description|965|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet> per controllare se ci sono stazioni di sorveglianza della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2D|You spend quite a while flying back and forth above the surface of <origin>, but Freya is unable to locate any Navy signals originating from the surface. Finally she gives up. "It's an out-of-the-way planet," she says. "Any fleet coming here would pass through Alioth or Seginus first. So I guess they didn't bother to put anything here. Time to head to New Tibet and meet up with Alondo!"|976|0
units.english: You spend quite a while flying back and forth above the surface of <origin>, but Freya is unable to locate any Navy signals originating from the surface. Finally she gives up. "It's an out-of-the-way planet," she says. "Any fleet coming here would pass through Alioth or Seginus first. So I guess they didn't bother to put anything here. Time to head to New Tibet and meet up with Alondo!"
units.italian: Passi parecchio tempo a volare avanti e indietro sopra la superficie di <origin>, ma Freya non riesce a localizzare nessun segnale della Marina proveniente dalla superficie. Alla fine rinuncia. "È un pianeta fuori mano," dice. "Qualsiasi flotta che venga qui passerebbe prima da Alioth o Seginus. Quindi immagino che non si siano presi la briga di metterci niente. È ora di andare su New Tibet e incontrare Alondo!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 2D|dialog|979|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|name|985|0
units.english: Freya to Zug
units.italian: Freya a Zug

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|description|986|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <destination> to help with ramping up Dreadnought production.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <destination> per aiutare ad accelerare la produzione dei Dreadnought.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|log|996|0
units.english: The shipyard on Zug is still trying to ramp up Dreadnought production. So far only a few ships have been built, but Freya will be helping to speed up the process.
units.italian: Il cantiere su Zug sta ancora cercando di accelerare la produzione dei Dreadnought. Finora sono state costruite solo poche navi, ma Freya aiuterà a velocizzare il processo.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|As you approach <origin>, Freya quickly locates two Navy surveillance stations and contacts Alondo, asking him to send some Free Worlds personnel to destroy them. Then you land, and Alondo comes aboard your ship to discuss your next steps in person.|998|0
units.english: As you approach <origin>, Freya quickly locates two Navy surveillance stations and contacts Alondo, asking him to send some Free Worlds personnel to destroy them. Then you land, and Alondo comes aboard your ship to discuss your next steps in person.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a <origin>, Freya localizza rapidamente due stazioni di sorveglianza della Marina e contatta Alondo, chiedendogli di mandare personale delle Free Worlds a distruggerle. Poi atterri, e Alondo sale sulla tua nave per discutere di persona i prossimi passi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"There's a good chance we've taken care of all the sensors in this sector," says Freya, "so we can start moving our fleets around here without tipping the Navy off. And I just heard from Southbound Shipyards that they've got two more Dreadnoughts ready for service."|999|0
units.english: "There's a good chance we've taken care of all the sensors in this sector," says Freya, "so we can start moving our fleets around here without tipping the Navy off. And I just heard from Southbound Shipyards that they've got two more Dreadnoughts ready for service."
units.italian: "È molto probabile che ci siamo occupati di tutti i sensori di questo settore," dice Freya, "quindi possiamo cominciare a spostare le nostre flotte da queste parti senza allertare la Marina. E ho appena saputo dai cantieri Southbound che hanno altre due Dreadnought pronte al servizio."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Only two? I was hoping to get a Dreadnought of my own soon!"|1001|0
units.english: "Only two? I was hoping to get a Dreadnought of my own soon!"
units.italian: "Solo due? Speravo di averne presto una mia, di Dreadnought!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Don't we need to defend Rastaban and the other systems to the east, as well?"|1003|0
units.english: "Don't we need to defend Rastaban and the other systems to the east, as well?"
units.italian: "Non dobbiamo difendere anche Rastaban e gli altri sistemi a est?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Patience, Captain," says Freya. "Building prototypes is very different from doing mass production."|1006|0
units.english: "Patience, Captain," says Freya. "Building prototypes is very different from doing mass production."
units.italian: "Pazienza, Capitano," dice Freya. "Costruire prototipi è molto diverso dalla produzione di massa."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Yes," says Freya. "Which means our fleets will be stretched thin. We really need them to ramp up Dreadnought production."|1009|0
units.english: "Yes," says Freya. "Which means our fleets will be stretched thin. We really need them to ramp up Dreadnought production."
units.italian: "Sì," dice Freya. "Il che significa che le nostre flotte saranno tirate per la coperta. Abbiamo davvero bisogno che accelerino la produzione dei Dreadnought."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	Alondo asks Freya, "Do you think you could help them in the shipyards? After all, you were a superb fleet supply manager back in the Defense Pact days."|1011|0
units.english: Alondo asks Freya, "Do you think you could help them in the shipyards? After all, you were a superb fleet supply manager back in the Defense Pact days."
units.italian: Alondo chiede a Freya: "Pensi di poterli aiutare nei cantieri? Dopotutto eri una straordinaria responsabile degli approvvigionamenti di flotta, ai tempi del Patto di Difesa."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"I'll do what I can, if you think you're all set here," says Freya.|1012|0
units.english: "I'll do what I can, if you think you're all set here," says Freya.
units.italian: "Farò quello che posso, se pensi che qui siate a posto," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"I'm fine," says Alondo, "and JJ is on Rastaban now, guarding our other flank. So you can take a break from being on the front." He heads back outside, and you and Freya get ready to visit the shipyards on <planet>.|1013|0
units.english: "I'm fine," says Alondo, "and JJ is on Rastaban now, guarding our other flank. So you can take a break from being on the front." He heads back outside, and you and Freya get ready to visit the shipyards on <planet>.
units.italian: "Sto bene," dice Alondo, "e JJ è su Rastaban adesso, a guardare l'altro nostro fianco. Quindi puoi prenderti una pausa dal fronte." Torna fuori, e tu e Freya vi preparate a visitare i cantieri su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|dialog|1017|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|log|1019|0
units.english: Agreed to become a member of the Free Worlds Council, taking Tomek's spot.
units.italian: Hai accettato di diventare membro del Consiglio delle Free Worlds, prendendo il posto di Tomek.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|As you are landing on <planet>, Freya says, "I miss Katya. It's hard being the only woman on the Council."|1022|0
units.english: As you are landing on <planet>, Freya says, "I miss Katya. It's hard being the only woman on the Council."
units.italian: Mentre stai atterrando su <planet>, Freya dice: "Mi manca Katya. È dura essere l'unica donna nel Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Don't worry, the Navy said they're trying to find her and return her to us."|1024|0
units.english: "Don't worry, the Navy said they're trying to find her and return her to us."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, la Marina ha detto che stanno cercando di trovarla e di restituircela."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Do you think the Navy reneged on their promise to free her?"|1025|0
units.english: "Do you think the Navy reneged on their promise to free her?"
units.italian: "Pensi che la Marina abbia rinnegato la promessa di liberarla?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"I don't know," she says. "I hope the Navy will keep their promise. But in the meantime, three people on Council is too few. We didn't want to say anything to you until the Senate cleared it, but we've nominated you to take Tomek's spot on the Council. What do you say?"|1026|0
units.english: "I don't know," she says. "I hope the Navy will keep their promise. But in the meantime, three people on Council is too few. We didn't want to say anything to you until the Senate cleared it, but we've nominated you to take Tomek's spot on the Council. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Non lo so," dice. "Spero che la Marina mantenga la promessa. Ma nel frattempo tre persone nel Consiglio sono troppo poche. Non volevamo dirti niente finché il Senato non avesse approvato, ma ti abbiamo nominato per prendere il posto di Tomek nel Consiglio. Che cosa ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"I'd be honored. Thank you."|1028|0
units.english: "I'd be honored. Thank you."
units.italian: "Sarebbe un onore. Grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	She grins. "Don't mention it. You've been with us since the beginning, and we've all come to trust what you have to say. I wish we could throw you a big dinner or something to celebrate, but... well, we're all busy with the war right now. But Alondo and JJ both said to tell you they're glad to have you on board. And you'll get a salary increase, of course. Which you ought to celebrate by buying us both a few drinks in the spaceport bar before you leave. Okay?"|1029|0
units.english: She grins. "Don't mention it. You've been with us since the beginning, and we've all come to trust what you have to say. I wish we could throw you a big dinner or something to celebrate, but... well, we're all busy with the war right now. But Alondo and JJ both said to tell you they're glad to have you on board. And you'll get a salary increase, of course. Which you ought to celebrate by buying us both a few drinks in the spaceport bar before you leave. Okay?"
units.italian: Sorride. "Non c'è di che. Sei con noi dall'inizio, e abbiamo tutti imparato a fidarci di quello che dici. Vorrei poterti offrire una bella cena o qualcosa del genere per festeggiare, ma... beh, siamo tutti impegnati con la guerra, al momento. Però Alondo e JJ mi hanno detto entrambi di dirti che sono contenti di averti a bordo. E avrai un aumento di stipendio, naturalmente. Cosa che dovresti festeggiare offrendoci da bere a entrambi nel bar dello spazioporto prima di partire. Va bene?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Okay, I'll meet you back at the spaceport in a few hours."|1031|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll meet you back at the spaceport in a few hours."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci vediamo allo spazioporto fra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3|	"Great," she says, smiling. "See you then." She picks up her suitcase, and hurries over to the shipyard.|1032|0
units.english: "Great," she says, smiling. "See you then." She picks up her suitcase, and hurries over to the shipyard.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice, sorridendo. "A dopo." Prende la sua valigia e si affretta verso il cantiere.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|name|1037|0
units.english: Dreadnoughts to <planet>
units.italian: Dreadnought per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|description|1038|0
units.english: Escort two more Dreadnoughts to <destination> to help defend the front against any Navy incursions.
units.italian: Scorta altre due Dreadnought fino a <destination> per aiutare a difendere il fronte da qualsiasi incursione della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|Freya turns out to be a whiskey drinker. By the time she has finished her first drink, she is chattering quite passionately about starship design: load balancing, stress lines, shield matrices, shipboard computers. Rather than dulling her intelligence, alcohol just seems to reduce her ability to explain things in ways a non-specialist can understand. You try to steer the conversation towards something less technical...|1049|0
units.english: Freya turns out to be a whiskey drinker. By the time she has finished her first drink, she is chattering quite passionately about starship design: load balancing, stress lines, shield matrices, shipboard computers. Rather than dulling her intelligence, alcohol just seems to reduce her ability to explain things in ways a non-specialist can understand. You try to steer the conversation towards something less technical...
units.italian: Scopri che Freya beve whisky. Quando ha finito il primo drink, sta già chiacchierando con passione del progetto delle astronavi: bilanciamento dei carichi, linee di stress, matrici degli scudi, computer di bordo. Più che offuscare la sua intelligenza, l'alcol sembra solo ridurre la sua capacità di spiegare le cose in modo comprensibile a un non specialista. Cerchi di portare la conversazione su qualcosa di meno tecnico...

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"So, why did you join the Council, initially?"|1051|0
units.english: "So, why did you join the Council, initially?"
units.italian: "Allora, perché all'inizio sei entrata nel Consiglio?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"Where's your home planet?"|1053|0
units.english: "Where's your home planet?"
units.italian: "Qual è il tuo pianeta natale?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"How long do you think it will be before they're mass-producing Dreadnoughts?"|1055|0
units.english: "How long do you think it will be before they're mass-producing Dreadnoughts?"
units.italian: "Quanto pensi che ci vorrà prima che producano Dreadnought in serie?"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"Well," she says, "you know the Council. Visionaries, big picture people. They needed someone who could take care of the actual concrete details. Data crunching for our 'thousand eyes' program tracking pirate fleet movements. Supply chain management. This was back in the days of the Pact, of course, before we had officially separated from the Republic. And I had worked with JJ in the past, so he asked me to come with him and help out on a larger scale."|1058|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "you know the Council. Visionaries, big picture people. They needed someone who could take care of the actual concrete details. Data crunching for our 'thousand eyes' program tracking pirate fleet movements. Supply chain management. This was back in the days of the Pact, of course, before we had officially separated from the Republic. And I had worked with JJ in the past, so he asked me to come with him and help out on a larger scale."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "conosci il Consiglio. Visionari, gente da quadro generale. Avevano bisogno di qualcuno che si occupasse dei dettagli concreti. Analisi dei dati per il nostro programma dei Mille Occhi, che traccia i movimenti delle flotte pirata. Gestione della catena di approvvigionamento. Questo ai tempi del Patto, naturalmente, prima che ci separassimo ufficialmente dalla Repubblica. E avevo già lavorato con JJ in passato, quindi mi ha chiesto di venire con lui e aiutare su scala più ampia."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"I grew up on Earth," she says, "deep in the bowels of one of the major cities. Even as a kid I hated that dirty old planet and knew my only shot of leaving there was to be smarter than everyone else. It wasn't until years later, when I came back to visit with some money in my pocket and a bit more perspective, that I was able to travel to the few parts of Earth that are still pretty, and realize how precious our home world is."|1061|0
units.english: "I grew up on Earth," she says, "deep in the bowels of one of the major cities. Even as a kid I hated that dirty old planet and knew my only shot of leaving there was to be smarter than everyone else. It wasn't until years later, when I came back to visit with some money in my pocket and a bit more perspective, that I was able to travel to the few parts of Earth that are still pretty, and realize how precious our home world is."
units.italian: "Sono cresciuta sulla Terra," dice, "nel profondo delle viscere di una delle grandi città. Già da bambina odiavo quel vecchio pianeta sporco e sapevo che la mia unica possibilità di andarmene era essere più intelligente di tutti gli altri. Solo anni dopo, quando sono tornata a visitarla con qualche soldo in tasca e un po' più di prospettiva, ho potuto viaggiare nelle poche parti della Terra che sono ancora belle e rendermi conto di quanto sia prezioso il nostro mondo d'origine."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	You tell Freya about your own upbringing on Earth, and the two of you share stories. It turns out you both grew up in North America; Freya along the Pacific coast, while you lived closer to the eastern seaboard.|1062|0
units.english: You tell Freya about your own upbringing on Earth, and the two of you share stories. It turns out you both grew up in North America; Freya along the Pacific coast, while you lived closer to the eastern seaboard.
units.italian: Racconti a Freya della tua infanzia sulla Terra, e condividete le vostre storie. Scoprite che siete cresciuti entrambi nel Nord America: Freya lungo la costa del Pacifico, mentre tu vivevi più vicino alla costa atlantica.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"Ugh," she says, "let's not talk about work while we're busy relaxing." You refrain from commenting that all her talk about starship design sounded a lot more like work than like a fun relaxing topic of conversation.|1067|0
units.english: "Ugh," she says, "let's not talk about work while we're busy relaxing." You refrain from commenting that all her talk about starship design sounded a lot more like work than like a fun relaxing topic of conversation.
units.italian: "Uff," dice, "non parliamo di lavoro mentre ci rilassiamo." Ti astieni dal commentare che tutto il suo discorso sul progetto delle astronavi sembrava molto più lavoro che un argomento di conversazione divertente e rilassante.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	You hang out in the bar for another hour or so, and then she says to the bartender, "Two bottles of champagne to go, please." He gives her an odd look, but the Council is well enough respected that he does not question her.|1070|0
units.english: You hang out in the bar for another hour or so, and then she says to the bartender, "Two bottles of champagne to go, please." He gives her an odd look, but the Council is well enough respected that he does not question her.
units.italian: Restate al bar per un'altra ora circa, poi lei dice al barista: "Due bottiglie di champagne da portare via, per favore." Lui le lancia uno sguardo strano, ma il Consiglio è abbastanza rispettato perché non le faccia domande.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	You walk over to the shipyard, where the two newly completed Dreadnoughts are parked side by side. "Time to christen our new ships," she says, handing you one of the bottles. You each fling a bottle at one of the ships, and shout out...|1071|0
units.english: You walk over to the shipyard, where the two newly completed Dreadnoughts are parked side by side. "Time to christen our new ships," she says, handing you one of the bottles. You each fling a bottle at one of the ships, and shout out...
units.italian: Andate al cantiere, dove le due Dreadnought appena completate sono parcheggiate fianco a fianco. "È ora di battezzare le nostre nuove navi," dice, porgendoti una delle bottiglie. Lanciate ciascuno una bottiglia contro una delle navi, e gridate...

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"For victory!"|1073|0
units.english: "For victory!"
units.italian: "Per la vittoria!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"For peace!"|1074|0
units.english: "For peace!"
units.italian: "Per la pace!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"For justice!"|1075|0
units.english: "For justice!"
units.italian: "Per la giustizia!"

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|	"May it come soon," echoes Freya. "Now, tomorrow morning the crews for these ships will be ready, and we'll need you to escort them to <planet>. I'll stay here and do my best to help manage the equipment supply chain and construction crews." She says goodnight, and wishes you a safe journey tomorrow.|1076|0
units.english: "May it come soon," echoes Freya. "Now, tomorrow morning the crews for these ships will be ready, and we'll need you to escort them to <planet>. I'll stay here and do my best to help manage the equipment supply chain and construction crews." She says goodnight, and wishes you a safe journey tomorrow.
units.italian: "Che arrivi presto," fa eco Freya. "Ora, domani mattina gli equipaggi di queste navi saranno pronti, e avremo bisogno che le scorti fino a <planet>. Io resto qui e faccio del mio meglio per gestire la catena di approvvigionamento delle attrezzature e le squadre di costruzione." Vi date la buonanotte, e ti augura buon viaggio per il giorno dopo.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 3B|dialog|1086|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but without both the Dreadnoughts you were assigned to escort! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma senza entrambe le Dreadnought che dovevi scortare! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4|name|1092|0
units.english: Meet Convoy
units.italian: Incontra la flotta

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4|description|1093|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to escort a convoy of medical supplies. Watch out for Republic attacks.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per scortare un convoglio di forniture mediche. Attento agli attacchi della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4|Waiting for you on <origin> is a message from Alondo: "Hello Captain! We've got another minor crisis: a merchant fleet was supposed to bring us a shipment of medical supplies from up North, since many of our worlds are running short. But, the Republic is threatening to attack the convoy if they try to cross over into our space, so they're waiting on <planet>, just inside of the Republic's territory. Please go meet up with the fleet and bring it back to New Tibet."|1105|0
units.english: Waiting for you on <origin> is a message from Alondo: "Hello Captain! We've got another minor crisis: a merchant fleet was supposed to bring us a shipment of medical supplies from up North, since many of our worlds are running short. But, the Republic is threatening to attack the convoy if they try to cross over into our space, so they're waiting on <planet>, just inside of the Republic's territory. Please go meet up with the fleet and bring it back to New Tibet."
units.italian: Su <origin> ti aspetta un messaggio di Alondo: "Salve, Capitano! Abbiamo un'altra piccola crisi: una flotta mercantile doveva portarci una spedizione di forniture mediche da nord, dato che molti dei nostri mondi ne hanno carenza. Ma la Repubblica minaccia di attaccare il convoglio se prova a entrare nel nostro spazio, quindi stanno aspettando su <planet>, appena dentro il territorio della Repubblica. Per favore raggiungi la flotta e portala su New Tibet."

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.1A|name|1112|0
units.english: Medical Convoy
units.italian: Convoglio medico

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.1A|description|1113|0
units.english: Escort a convoy carrying medical supplies safely to <planet>. Do not fire on the Navy Oathkeeper ship that is in orbit there.
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio che trasporta forniture mediche fino a <planet>, in sicurezza. Non sparare sulla nave Oathkeeper della Marina che è in orbita lì.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.1A|You land on <origin> and meet up with the fleet you will be escorting. A few minutes later, an urgent message comes in from Alondo: "We've got a crazy situation here. Return to New Tibet immediately with the convoy. You will find a Navy Oathkeeper ship in orbit. Do not attack them, just see to it that the convoy lands safely." The Oathkeepers are Navy officers who swore not to fight the Free Worlds, so you can't help wondering what they are doing on <planet>.|1127|0
units.english: You land on <origin> and meet up with the fleet you will be escorting. A few minutes later, an urgent message comes in from Alondo: "We've got a crazy situation here. Return to New Tibet immediately with the convoy. You will find a Navy Oathkeeper ship in orbit. Do not attack them, just see to it that the convoy lands safely." The Oathkeepers are Navy officers who swore not to fight the Free Worlds, so you can't help wondering what they are doing on <planet>.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e incontri la flotta che dovrai scortare. Pochi minuti dopo arriva un messaggio urgente di Alondo: "Abbiamo una situazione assurda qui. Torna subito su New Tibet con il convoglio. Troverai una nave Oathkeeper della Marina in orbita. Non attaccarla, limita a far atterrare il convoglio in sicurezza." Gli Oathkeepers sono ufficiali della Marina che hanno giurato di non combattere le Free Worlds, quindi non puoi fare a meno di chiederti che cosa ci facciano su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.1A|dialog|1140|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.2A|name|1153|0
units.english: Medical Convoy
units.italian: Convoglio medico

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.2A|description|1154|0
units.english: Escort a convoy carrying medical supplies safely to <planet>.
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio che trasporta forniture mediche fino a <planet>, in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.2A|You land on <origin> and meet up with the fleet you will be escorting. A few minutes later, an urgent message comes in from Alondo: "We've got a crazy situation here. Return to New Tibet immediately with the convoy." He provides no further information.|1169|0
units.english: You land on <origin> and meet up with the fleet you will be escorting. A few minutes later, an urgent message comes in from Alondo: "We've got a crazy situation here. Return to New Tibet immediately with the convoy." He provides no further information.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e incontri la flotta che dovrai scortare. Pochi minuti dopo arriva un messaggio urgente di Alondo: "Abbiamo una situazione assurda qui. Torna subito su New Tibet con il convoglio." Non fornisce altre informazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Northern 4.2A|dialog|1187|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of the convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|name|1193|0
units.english: Liberate Poisonwood
units.italian: Libera Poisonwood

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|description|1194|0
units.english: Destroy the pirate ships occupying the <system> system with the help of the Navy Oathkeepers, then land on the planet and let the Navy troops eliminate the Alphas.
units.italian: Distruggi le navi pirata che occupano il sistema <system> con l'aiuto degli Oathkeepers della Marina, poi atterra sul pianeta e lascia che le truppe della Marina eliminino gli Alphas.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|log|1205|0
units.english: The Republic world of Poisonwood in the South has apparently been taken over by Alpha warlords. It is such a dire threat that despite the war, the Navy Oathkeepers have agreed to fight alongside the Free Worlds to liberate the planet.
units.italian: Il mondo della Repubblica di Poisonwood, a sud, è apparentemente stato conquistato da signori della guerra Alpha. La minaccia è così grave che, nonostante la guerra, gli Oathkeepers della Marina hanno accettato di combattere al fianco delle Free Worlds per liberare il pianeta.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|You land the convoy safely on <origin>, but everyone seems to be busy with whatever new crisis it is that Alondo alluded to; no one approaches you to help unload the ships. Eventually you track down Alondo and ask what is going on, and why there is a neutral Navy ship in orbit. "We just received word that Poisonwood has been captured by pirates, while all of our fleets were busy guarding the front," says Alondo. You recall that Poisonwood has remained loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside Free Worlds territory.|1208|0
units.english: You land the convoy safely on <origin>, but everyone seems to be busy with whatever new crisis it is that Alondo alluded to; no one approaches you to help unload the ships. Eventually you track down Alondo and ask what is going on, and why there is a neutral Navy ship in orbit. "We just received word that Poisonwood has been captured by pirates, while all of our fleets were busy guarding the front," says Alondo. You recall that Poisonwood has remained loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside Free Worlds territory.
units.italian: Fai atterrare il convoglio su <origin> in sicurezza, ma tutti sembrano impegnati con qualunque nuova crisi avesse accennato Alondo; nessuno ti si avvicina per aiutare a scaricare le navi. Alla fine trovi Alondo e gli chiedi che cosa succede, e perché in orbita ci sia una nave neutrale della Marina. "Abbiamo appena saputo che Poisonwood è stata conquistata dai pirati, mentre tutte le nostre flotte erano impegnate a difendere il fronte," dice Alondo. Ricordi che Poisonwood è rimasto leale alla Repubblica, anche se si trova nel cuore del territorio delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"If we liberate them, will they switch their loyalty to our side?"|1210|0
units.english: "If we liberate them, will they switch their loyalty to our side?"
units.italian: "Se li liberiamo, passeranno dalla nostra parte?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"If they're not one of our worlds, why should we help them?"|1212|0
units.english: "If they're not one of our worlds, why should we help them?"
units.italian: "Se non è uno dei nostri mondi, perché dovremmo aiutarli?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"Possibly," says Alondo. "But that's not what is important. Before they were overrun by pirate troops, one of the colonists managed to take a photo of the pirate leader."|1215|0
units.english: "Possibly," says Alondo. "But that's not what is important. Before they were overrun by pirate troops, one of the colonists managed to take a photo of the pirate leader."
units.italian: "Forse," dice Alondo. "Ma non è questo l'importante. Prima che venissero travolti dalle truppe pirata, uno dei coloni è riuscito a fotografare il capo dei pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"Because one of the colonists took a picture of the leader of the pirates who attacked them," says Alondo.|1218|0
units.english: "Because one of the colonists took a picture of the leader of the pirates who attacked them," says Alondo.
units.italian: "Perché uno dei coloni ha fatto una foto al capo dei pirati che li hanno attaccati," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	He hands you a small printout of a photograph. It is a somewhat blurry picture of a group of armed pirates running down a street in a desert town. What grabs your attention immediately is that several of the pirates appear to have green skin. You recognize that as the mark of the Alphas, the sociopathic, genetically engineered super-humans who enslaved entire planets during the Alpha Wars, five centuries ago.|1221|0
units.english: He hands you a small printout of a photograph. It is a somewhat blurry picture of a group of armed pirates running down a street in a desert town. What grabs your attention immediately is that several of the pirates appear to have green skin. You recognize that as the mark of the Alphas, the sociopathic, genetically engineered super-humans who enslaved entire planets during the Alpha Wars, five centuries ago.
units.italian: Ti porge una piccola stampa fotografica. È un'immagine un po' sfocata di un gruppo di pirati armati che corre lungo una strada in una città del deserto. Quello che ti colpisce subito è che diversi pirati sembrano avere la pelle verde. Riconosci quel segno: sono gli Alphas, i superuomini sociopatici e geneticamente modificati che cinque secoli fa, durante le Guerre Alpha, ridussero in schiavitù interi pianeti.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"It must be a trick. There can't still be Alphas around. Maybe the pirates dyed their skin green to make people fear them."|1223|0
units.english: "It must be a trick. There can't still be Alphas around. Maybe the pirates dyed their skin green to make people fear them."
units.italian: "Dev'essere un trucco. Non possono esserci ancora degli Alphas in giro. Magari i pirati si sono tinti la pelle di verde per farsi temere."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"How is it possible that some of the Alphas are still alive?"|1224|0
units.english: "How is it possible that some of the Alphas are still alive?"
units.italian: "Come è possibile che alcuni Alphas siano ancora vivi?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Alondo says, "This may be a trick, but we can't afford to take that risk. The Alphas were the greatest threat humanity has ever faced. And before they contacted us for help, Poisonwood reached out to the Navy." As he is speaking, a shadow passes overhead. You look up and see the unmistakable silhouette of a Navy Cruiser, coming in for a landing.|1225|0
units.english: Alondo says, "This may be a trick, but we can't afford to take that risk. The Alphas were the greatest threat humanity has ever faced. And before they contacted us for help, Poisonwood reached out to the Navy." As he is speaking, a shadow passes overhead. You look up and see the unmistakable silhouette of a Navy Cruiser, coming in for a landing.
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Potrebbe essere un trucco, ma non possiamo permetterci quel rischio. Gli Alphas sono stati la più grande minaccia che l'umanità abbia mai affrontato. E prima di contattare noi per chiedere aiuto, Poisonwood si è rivolta alla Marina." Mentre parla, un'ombra passa sopra di voi. Alzi lo sguardo e vedi l'inconfondibile sagoma di un incrociatore della Marina che si prepara ad atterrare.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"Are you insane? You're letting the Navy come here?"|1227|0
units.english: "Are you insane? You're letting the Navy come here?"
units.italian: "Sei impazzito? Lasci atterrare qui la Marina?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"We're going to work side by side with the Navy right after that awful battle?"|1228|0
units.english: "We're going to work side by side with the Navy right after that awful battle?"
units.italian: "Collaboreremo con la Marina subito dopo quella battaglia orribile?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Alondo explains, "It's only one Cruiser, an 'Oathkeeper' ship, sworn to take no part in our war. The Free Worlds have almost no troops trained for ground combat, so without the Navy's help we would be unlikely to be able to eliminate the Alphas."|1229|0
units.english: Alondo explains, "It's only one Cruiser, an 'Oathkeeper' ship, sworn to take no part in our war. The Free Worlds have almost no troops trained for ground combat, so without the Navy's help we would be unlikely to be able to eliminate the Alphas."
units.italian: Alondo spiega: "È solo un incrociatore, una nave 'Oathkeeper', vincolata a non prendere parte alla nostra guerra. Le Free Worlds non hanno quasi nessuna truppa addestrata al combattimento a terra, quindi senza l'aiuto della Marina avremmo poche speranze di eliminare gli Alphas."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	The Navy ship lands, and a man steps off who you recognize immediately: Admiral William Danforth, who is something of a folk hero throughout human space, and who you have heard is the commander of the entire Oathkeeper regiment. With him is a man who he introduces as Commander Aaron Nguyen of the Navy Humanitarian Corps. As Nguyen shakes your hand, you are struck by the fact that although he is your enemy, you see no trace of hostility in his eyes - in fact, his expression is surprisingly warm and affectionate.|1230|0
units.english: The Navy ship lands, and a man steps off who you recognize immediately: Admiral William Danforth, who is something of a folk hero throughout human space, and who you have heard is the commander of the entire Oathkeeper regiment. With him is a man who he introduces as Commander Aaron Nguyen of the Navy Humanitarian Corps. As Nguyen shakes your hand, you are struck by the fact that although he is your enemy, you see no trace of hostility in his eyes - in fact, his expression is surprisingly warm and affectionate.
units.italian: La nave della Marina atterra, e ne scende un uomo che riconosci subito: l'ammiraglio William Danforth, una specie di eroe popolare in tutto lo spazio umano, che hai sentito essere il comandante dell'intero reggimento degli Oathkeeper. Con lui c'è un uomo che ti presenta come comandante Aaron Nguyen del Corpo Umanitario della Marina. Mentre Nguyen ti stringe la mano, ti colpisce il fatto che, pur essendo tuo nemico, non vedi alcuna traccia di ostilità nei suoi occhi: anzi, la sua espressione è sorprendentemente calda e affettuosa.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	"We have no room for error," says Danforth. "These Alphas must be eliminated, and they must not be allowed to escape. On that, at least, we can all agree."|1231|0
units.english: "We have no room for error," says Danforth. "These Alphas must be eliminated, and they must not be allowed to escape. On that, at least, we can all agree."
units.italian: "Non possiamo permetterci errori," dice Danforth. "Questi Alphas vanno eliminati, e non dobbiamo lasciare che scappino. Su questo, almeno, possiamo essere tutti d'accordo."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Alondo says, "Captain <last> will lead the attack." He beckons to two of the Free Worlds captains. "Marco, Emily, you will join them with your Falcons. Destroy any pirate ships in orbit, then land and secure the facility. Understood?" You nod, and prepare to take off for the <system> system.|1232|0
units.english: Alondo says, "Captain <last> will lead the attack." He beckons to two of the Free Worlds captains. "Marco, Emily, you will join them with your Falcons. Destroy any pirate ships in orbit, then land and secure the facility. Understood?" You nod, and prepare to take off for the <system> system.
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Il capitano <last> guiderà l'attacco." Fa cenno a due capitani delle Free Worlds. "Marco, Emily, li accompagnerete con i vostri Falcon. Distruggete tutte le navi pirata in orbita, poi atterrate e mettete in sicurezza la struttura. Chiaro?" Fai un cenno, e ti prepari a decollare per il sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|dialog|1257|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the battle is not over - you've either failed to kill one of the pirates, or left one of your ships behind in a different system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la battaglia non è finita: o non hai ucciso uno dei pirati, o hai lasciato una delle tue navi in un altro sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|The ships in orbit are eliminated, but there are still the Alphas and their servants here on the ground to take care of. Danforth's ship unloads a squadron of troops in heavy battle suits. The Navy troops move with far more precision and purpose than you have ever seen among the poorly trained Free Worlds soldiers.|1262|0
units.english: The ships in orbit are eliminated, but there are still the Alphas and their servants here on the ground to take care of. Danforth's ship unloads a squadron of troops in heavy battle suits. The Navy troops move with far more precision and purpose than you have ever seen among the poorly trained Free Worlds soldiers.
units.italian: Le navi in orbita sono eliminate, ma a terra restano ancora gli Alphas e i loro servi di cui occuparsi. La nave di Danforth sbarca una squadriglia di truppe in pesanti tute da battaglia. Le truppe della Marina si muovono con una precisione e una determinazione che non hai mai visto fra i soldati delle Free Worlds, addestrati alla bell'e meglio.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	They sweep the city and quickly ascertain that the Alphas are holed up in a large factory. The troops encircle the building and burst through the doors, and soon you hear the sounds of explosions and gunfire within. You wait with Commander Nguyen in an alley facing the building. "I'm with the Humanitarian Corps," he explains. "Killing things is not in my job description."|1263|0
units.english: They sweep the city and quickly ascertain that the Alphas are holed up in a large factory. The troops encircle the building and burst through the doors, and soon you hear the sounds of explosions and gunfire within. You wait with Commander Nguyen in an alley facing the building. "I'm with the Humanitarian Corps," he explains. "Killing things is not in my job description."
units.italian: Passano al setaccio la città e accertano rapidamente che gli Alphas si sono barricati in una grande fabbrica. Le truppe circondano l'edificio e sfondano le porte, e presto senti il suono di esplosioni e spari all'interno. Aspetti con il comandante Nguyen in un vicolo di fronte all'edificio. "Sono del Corpo Umanitario," spiega. "Uccidere non è nella mia descrizione del lavoro."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Just then, one of the second floor windows shatters and a figure comes tumbling out, rolls, and starts running in your direction. Then it does something you would swear no human being is capable of: while still moving in your direction, it begins leaping from one wall of the alley to the other as easily as you would run up a staircase, gaining altitude with each jump so that soon it will pass two or three meters above your heads. Several Navy troops are running after it, but they hold their fire to avoid hitting you and Nguyen.|1264|0
units.english: Just then, one of the second floor windows shatters and a figure comes tumbling out, rolls, and starts running in your direction. Then it does something you would swear no human being is capable of: while still moving in your direction, it begins leaping from one wall of the alley to the other as easily as you would run up a staircase, gaining altitude with each jump so that soon it will pass two or three meters above your heads. Several Navy troops are running after it, but they hold their fire to avoid hitting you and Nguyen.
units.italian: Proprio allora una delle finestre del secondo piano va in frantumi e una figura ne esce rotolando, si rialza e comincia a correre verso di te. Poi fa qualcosa che giureresti nessun essere umano essere capace di fare: senza smettere di avanzare verso di te, comincia a saltare da una parete all'altra del vicolo con la stessa facilità con cui tu saliresti una scala, guadagnando quota a ogni salto, così che presto ti passerà due o tre metri sopra la testa. Diverse truppe della Marina gli corrono dietro, ma trattengono il fuoco per non colpire te e Nguyen.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	(Try to shoot it.)|1266|0
units.english: (Try to shoot it.)
units.italian: (Prova a sparargli.)

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	(Try to grab it.)|1268|0
units.english: (Try to grab it.)
units.italian: (Prova ad afferrarlo.)

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	You open fire, but it is leaping back and forth so fast that it is almost impossible to hit. But then you see Commander Nguyen climb onto a nearby dumpster and leap into the air, managing to grab the creature by the leg as it flies by.|1271|0
units.english: You open fire, but it is leaping back and forth so fast that it is almost impossible to hit. But then you see Commander Nguyen climb onto a nearby dumpster and leap into the air, managing to grab the creature by the leg as it flies by.
units.italian: Apri il fuoco, ma salta avanti e indietro così in fretta che è quasi impossibile colpirlo. Poi però vedi il comandante Nguyen salire su un cassonetto lì vicino e lanciarsi in aria, riuscendo ad afferrare la creatura per una gamba mentre gli passa accanto.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Unfortunately, by now the creature is far outside your reach. But then you see Commander Nguyen climb onto a nearby dumpster and leap into the air, managing to grab the creature by the leg as it flies by.|1274|0
units.english: Unfortunately, by now the creature is far outside your reach. But then you see Commander Nguyen climb onto a nearby dumpster and leap into the air, managing to grab the creature by the leg as it flies by.
units.italian: Purtroppo ormai la creatura è fuori dalla tua portata. Poi però vedi il comandante Nguyen salire su un cassonetto lì vicino e lanciarsi in aria, riuscendo ad afferrare la creatura per una gamba mentre gli passa accanto.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	The two of them fall to the ground and roll over and over in a jumble of limbs. You and the Navy troops run after them, afraid to shoot for fear of hitting Nguyen. But somehow Nguyen gets the upper hand, pinning the creature in a full nelson hold, with his legs wrapped around its body to keep it from kicking him. "Kill it!" he shouts.|1277|0
units.english: The two of them fall to the ground and roll over and over in a jumble of limbs. You and the Navy troops run after them, afraid to shoot for fear of hitting Nguyen. But somehow Nguyen gets the upper hand, pinning the creature in a full nelson hold, with his legs wrapped around its body to keep it from kicking him. "Kill it!" he shouts.
units.italian: I due cadono a terra e rotolano più e più volte in un groviglio di arti. Tu e le truppe della Marina correte dietro a loro, timorosi di sparare per paura di colpire Nguyen. Ma in qualche modo Nguyen prende il sopravvento, bloccando la creatura con una presa completa, con le gambe avvolte intorno al corpo per impedirle di scalciare. "Uccidila!" grida.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	(Kill it.)|1279|0
units.english: (Kill it.)
units.italian: (Uccidila.)

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	(Let the Navy troops deal with this.)|1281|0
units.english: (Let the Navy troops deal with this.)
units.italian: (Lascia che se ne occupino le truppe della Marina.)

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	While Nguyen holds the creature still, you put a gun to its head and pull the trigger. Not even an Alpha can survive that; the creature goes limp. Now that you can get a good look at it, you can see that it does indeed have green skin.|1284|0
units.english: While Nguyen holds the creature still, you put a gun to its head and pull the trigger. Not even an Alpha can survive that; the creature goes limp. Now that you can get a good look at it, you can see that it does indeed have green skin.
units.italian: Mentre Nguyen tiene ferma la creatura, le metti una pistola alla testa e premi il grilletto. Nemmeno un Alpha può sopravvivere a questo; la creatura si affloscia. Ora che puoi guardarla bene, vedi che ha davvero la pelle verde.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	While Nguyen holds the creature still, one of the Navy troops puts a gun to its head and pulls the trigger. Not even an Alpha can survive that; the creature goes limp. Now that you can get a good look at it, you can see that it does indeed have green skin.|1287|0
units.english: While Nguyen holds the creature still, one of the Navy troops puts a gun to its head and pulls the trigger. Not even an Alpha can survive that; the creature goes limp. Now that you can get a good look at it, you can see that it does indeed have green skin.
units.italian: Mentre Nguyen tiene ferma la creatura, un soldato della Marina le mette una pistola alla testa e preme il grilletto. Nemmeno un Alpha può sopravvivere a questo; la creatura si affloscia. Ora che puoi guardarla bene, vedi che ha davvero la pelle verde.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1|	Nguyen gets shakily to his feet; he looks stunned and very pale. "Thank you," he says. The sounds of gunfire within the factory eventually die down. "We'll continue to patrol the city," says Nguyen, "in case there are more of them. Then I'll meet you in the spaceport." He heads off back into the city.|1290|0
units.english: Nguyen gets shakily to his feet; he looks stunned and very pale. "Thank you," he says. The sounds of gunfire within the factory eventually die down. "We'll continue to patrol the city," says Nguyen, "in case there are more of them. Then I'll meet you in the spaceport." He heads off back into the city.
units.italian: Nguyen si alza a fatica, tremante; ha l'aria sconvolta e molto pallida. "Grazie," dice. I suoni degli spari dentro la fabbrica alla fine si spengono. "Continueremo a pattugliare la città," dice Nguyen, "nel caso ce ne siano altri. Poi ci vediamo allo spazioporto." Si allontana verso la città.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|name|1296|0
units.english: Liberate Poisonwood
units.italian: Libera Poisonwood

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|description|1297|0
units.english: Destroy any pirate ships in orbit around <planet>, then land and eliminate the Alphas and their servants who have occupied the city.
units.italian: Distruggi tutte le navi pirata in orbita intorno a <planet>, poi atterra ed elimina gli Alphas e i loro servi che hanno occupato la città.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|log|1308|0
units.english: The Republic world of Poisonwood in the South has apparently been taken over by Alpha warlords. Hopefully the Free Worlds will be able to liberate the planet and capture or kill the Alpha leaders.
units.italian: Il mondo della Repubblica di Poisonwood, a sud, è apparentemente stato conquistato da signori della guerra Alpha. Speriamo che le Free Worlds riescano a liberare il pianeta e a catturare o uccidere i capi Alpha.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|You land the convoy safely on <origin>, but everyone seems to be busy with whatever new crisis it is that Alondo alluded to; no one approaches you to help unload the ships. Eventually you track down Alondo and ask what is going on. "We just received word that Poisonwood has been captured by pirates, while all of our fleets were busy elsewhere," says Alondo. You recall that Poisonwood has remained loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside Free Worlds territory.|1311|0
units.english: You land the convoy safely on <origin>, but everyone seems to be busy with whatever new crisis it is that Alondo alluded to; no one approaches you to help unload the ships. Eventually you track down Alondo and ask what is going on. "We just received word that Poisonwood has been captured by pirates, while all of our fleets were busy elsewhere," says Alondo. You recall that Poisonwood has remained loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside Free Worlds territory.
units.italian: Fai atterrare il convoglio su <origin> in sicurezza, ma tutti sembrano impegnati con qualunque nuova crisi avesse accennato Alondo; nessuno ti si avvicina per aiutare a scaricare le navi. Alla fine trovi Alondo e gli chiedi che cosa succede. "Abbiamo appena saputo che Poisonwood è stata conquistata dai pirati, mentre tutte le nostre flotte erano impegnate altrove," dice Alondo. Ricordi che Poisonwood è rimasto leale alla Repubblica, anche se si trova nel cuore del territorio delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"If we liberate them, will they switch their loyalty to our side?"|1313|0
units.english: "If we liberate them, will they switch their loyalty to our side?"
units.italian: "Se li liberiamo, passeranno dalla nostra parte?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"If they're not one of our worlds, why should we help them?"|1315|0
units.english: "If they're not one of our worlds, why should we help them?"
units.italian: "Se non è uno dei nostri mondi, perché dovremmo aiutarli?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"Possibly," says Alondo. "But that's not what is important. Before they were overrun by pirate troops, one of the colonists managed to take a photo of the pirate leader."|1318|0
units.english: "Possibly," says Alondo. "But that's not what is important. Before they were overrun by pirate troops, one of the colonists managed to take a photo of the pirate leader."
units.italian: "Forse," dice Alondo. "Ma non è questo l'importante. Prima che venissero travolti dalle truppe pirata, uno dei coloni è riuscito a fotografare il capo dei pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"Because one of the colonists took a picture of the leader of the pirates who attacked them," says Alondo.|1321|0
units.english: "Because one of the colonists took a picture of the leader of the pirates who attacked them," says Alondo.
units.italian: "Perché uno dei coloni ha fatto una foto al capo dei pirati che li hanno attaccati," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	He hands you a small printout of a photograph. It is a somewhat blurry picture of a group of armed pirates running down a street in a desert town. What grabs your attention immediately is that several of the pirates appear to have green skin. You recognize that as the mark of the Alphas, the sociopathic, genetically engineered super-humans who enslaved entire planets during the Alpha Wars, five centuries ago.|1324|0
units.english: He hands you a small printout of a photograph. It is a somewhat blurry picture of a group of armed pirates running down a street in a desert town. What grabs your attention immediately is that several of the pirates appear to have green skin. You recognize that as the mark of the Alphas, the sociopathic, genetically engineered super-humans who enslaved entire planets during the Alpha Wars, five centuries ago.
units.italian: Ti porge una piccola stampa fotografica. È un'immagine un po' sfocata di un gruppo di pirati armati che corre lungo una strada in una città del deserto. Quello che ti colpisce subito è che diversi pirati sembrano avere la pelle verde. Riconosci quel segno: sono gli Alphas, i superuomini sociopatici e geneticamente modificati che cinque secoli fa, durante le Guerre Alpha, ridussero in schiavitù interi pianeti.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"It must be a trick. There can't still be Alphas around. Maybe the pirates dyed their skin green to make people fear them."|1326|0
units.english: "It must be a trick. There can't still be Alphas around. Maybe the pirates dyed their skin green to make people fear them."
units.italian: "Dev'essere un trucco. Non possono esserci ancora degli Alphas in giro. Magari i pirati si sono tinti la pelle di verde per farsi temere."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	"How is it possible that some of the Alphas are still alive?"|1327|0
units.english: "How is it possible that some of the Alphas are still alive?"
units.italian: "Come è possibile che alcuni Alphas siano ancora vivi?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|	Alondo says, "This may be a trick, but we can't afford to take that risk. The Alphas were the greatest threat humanity has ever faced. We have very few people trained in ground combat, but I've gathered some of our best and loaded them onto a fleet that will be accompanying you. Destroy any pirate ships in orbit, then land and secure the facility. Understood? And don't let any of your escorts die; they're carrying the troops you'll need for the ground battle." You nod, and prepare to take off for the <system> system.|1328|0
units.english: Alondo says, "This may be a trick, but we can't afford to take that risk. The Alphas were the greatest threat humanity has ever faced. We have very few people trained in ground combat, but I've gathered some of our best and loaded them onto a fleet that will be accompanying you. Destroy any pirate ships in orbit, then land and secure the facility. Understood? And don't let any of your escorts die; they're carrying the troops you'll need for the ground battle." You nod, and prepare to take off for the <system> system.
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Potrebbe essere un trucco, ma non possiamo permetterci quel rischio. Gli Alphas sono stati la più grande minaccia che l'umanità abbia mai affrontato.
