Abbiamo pochissima gente addestrata al combattimento a terra, ma ho radunato alcuni dei nostri migliori e li ho caricati su una flotta che ti accompagnerà. Distruggi tutte le navi pirata in orbita, poi atterra e metti in sicurezza la struttura. Chiaro? E non lasciar morire nessuna delle tue scorte: trasportano le truppe che ti serviranno per la battaglia a terra." Fai un cenno, e ti prepari a decollare per il sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2|dialog|1349|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the battle is not over - you've either failed to kill one of the pirates, or left one of your ships behind in a different system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la battaglia non è finita: o non hai ucciso uno dei pirati, o hai lasciato una delle tue navi in un altro sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|name|1354|0
units.english: Danforth to <planet>
units.italian: Danforth per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|description|1355|0
units.english: Escort Admiral Danforth's ship to <destination> so that he can leave Free space without being accidentally attacked.
units.italian: Scorta la nave dell'ammiraglio Danforth fino a <destination>, perché possa lasciare lo spazio delle Free Worlds senza essere attaccato per errore.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|log|1374|0
units.english: With the help of the Oathkeepers, liberated Poisonwood from the Alpha invaders.
units.italian: Con l'aiuto degli Oathkeepers, hai liberato Poisonwood dagli invasori Alpha.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|When you meet up with Nguyen, he still looks very worried. "We think we killed them all," he says, "but we can't be sure. Also, we recovered some instruments for genetic manipulation from the factory. The Alphas can't breed normally, because if their offspring inherit some of the Alpha mutations but not others, the result is rarely viable, and even those that live long enough to be born don't have all the Alpha traits. So, they rely on artificial insemination instead."|1377|0
units.english: When you meet up with Nguyen, he still looks very worried. "We think we killed them all," he says, "but we can't be sure. Also, we recovered some instruments for genetic manipulation from the factory. The Alphas can't breed normally, because if their offspring inherit some of the Alpha mutations but not others, the result is rarely viable, and even those that live long enough to be born don't have all the Alpha traits. So, they rely on artificial insemination instead."
units.italian: Quando incontri Nguyen, sembra ancora molto preoccupato. "Crediamo di averli uccisi tutti," dice, "ma non possiamo esserne certi. Inoltre abbiamo recuperato dalla fabbrica alcuni strumenti per la manipolazione genetica. Gli Alphas non possono riprodursi normalmente, perché se la prole eredita alcune mutazioni Alpha ma non altre, il risultato è raramente vitale, e anche quelli che vivono abbastanza da nascere non hanno tutti i tratti Alpha. Quindi si affidano all'inseminazione artificiale."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"Well, it's good news that you recovered those instruments, then."|1379|0
units.english: "Well, it's good news that you recovered those instruments, then."
units.italian: "Beh, allora è una buona notizia che abbiate recuperato quegli strumenti."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"It would be," says Nguyen, "except that we also discovered that several dozen of the women who were taken as slaves... are now pregnant. We'll have to ask them to terminate their pregnancies. It's the only safe decision, but I still don't like it." He sighs. "I'm a Buddhist, you know. Committed to doing harm to no living thing. That's why I joined the Humanitarian Corps. They promised me I'd never be asked to take a life."|1380|0
units.english: "It would be," says Nguyen, "except that we also discovered that several dozen of the women who were taken as slaves... are now pregnant. We'll have to ask them to terminate their pregnancies. It's the only safe decision, but I still don't like it." He sighs. "I'm a Buddhist, you know. Committed to doing harm to no living thing. That's why I joined the Humanitarian Corps. They promised me I'd never be asked to take a life."
units.italian: "Lo sarebbe," dice Nguyen, "se non avessimo anche scoperto che diverse decine delle donne prese come schiave... sono ora incinte. Dovremo chiedere loro di interrompere le gravidanze. È l'unica decisione sicura, ma continua a non piacermi." Sospira. "Sono buddista, sai. Impegnato a non fare del male a nessun essere vivente. Per questo mi sono unito al Corpo Umanitario. Mi avevano promesso che non mi sarebbe mai stato chiesto di togliere una vita."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"Is that why you didn't kill that Alpha yourself, on the street?"|1382|0
units.english: "Is that why you didn't kill that Alpha yourself, on the street?"
units.italian: "È per questo che non hai ucciso tu quell'Alpha, per strada?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"That doesn't seem like a moral dilemma to me. We know those children will grow up to be monsters."|1384|0
units.english: "That doesn't seem like a moral dilemma to me. We know those children will grow up to be monsters."
units.italian: "Questo non mi sembra un dilemma morale. Sappiamo che quei bambini diventeranno dei mostri."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"Couldn't we let the children be born, if that's what the women want, then imprison them or something if they do turn out to be Alphas?"|1386|0
units.english: "Couldn't we let the children be born, if that's what the women want, then imprison them or something if they do turn out to be Alphas?"
units.italian: "Non potremmo lasciar nascere i bambini, se è quello che vogliono le donne, e poi imprigionarli o qualcosa del genere se si rivelano davvero degli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"Yes," he says. "Silly, isn't it? Anyway, this is my job to deal with; you need to go find Danforth."|1389|0
units.english: "Yes," he says. "Silly, isn't it? Anyway, this is my job to deal with; you need to go find Danforth."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Sciocco, vero? Comunque, è compito mio occuparmene; tu devi andare a trovare Danforth."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"Well," he says, "I envy you for living in a universe where decisions like this are easy. But to me it's still a painful choice to make. Anyway, that's my problem to deal with, not yours; you need to go find Danforth."|1392|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "I envy you for living in a universe where decisions like this are easy. But to me it's still a painful choice to make. Anyway, that's my problem to deal with, not yours; you need to go find Danforth."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "ti invidio per vivere in un universo dove decisioni così sono facili. Per me resta una scelta dolorosa. Comunque, è un problema mio, non tuo; tu devi andare a trovare Danforth."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"The Alphas were originally bred to be super-soldiers," he says, "a weapon in the hands of a despotic government. As much as I hate to admit it, there are certain branches of the Republic who would love to get their hands on a small army of impressionable Alpha children. Far better for them to die than for that to happen. Anyway, that's my job to deal with; you need to go find Danforth."|1395|0
units.english: "The Alphas were originally bred to be super-soldiers," he says, "a weapon in the hands of a despotic government. As much as I hate to admit it, there are certain branches of the Republic who would love to get their hands on a small army of impressionable Alpha children. Far better for them to die than for that to happen. Anyway, that's my job to deal with; you need to go find Danforth."
units.italian: "Gli Alphas sono stati allevati originariamente come supersoldati," dice, "un'arma nelle mani di un governo dispotico. Per quanto mi dispiaccia ammetterlo, ci sono certi ambienti della Repubblica che sarebbero felicissimi di mettere le mani su un piccolo esercito di bambini Alpha impressionabili. Molto meglio che muoiano, piuttosto che accada questo. Comunque, è compito mio occuparmene; tu devi andare a trovare Danforth."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	He leaves, and you return to Danforth's ship. Danforth says, "Hello there, temporary ally. It was an honor to fight alongside you, while it lasted."|1398|0
units.english: He leaves, and you return to Danforth's ship. Danforth says, "Hello there, temporary ally. It was an honor to fight alongside you, while it lasted."
units.italian: Se ne va, e tu torni alla nave di Danforth. Danforth dice: "Salve, alleato temporaneo. È stato un onore combattere al tuo fianco, finché è durato."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"You too. I wish we could bring this war to an end."|1400|0
units.english: "You too. I wish we could bring this war to an end."
units.italian: "Altrettanto. Vorrei che potessimo porre fine a questa guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"If the Republic would just leave us alone, we wouldn't need to be enemies."|1401|0
units.english: "If the Republic would just leave us alone, we wouldn't need to be enemies."
units.italian: "Se la Repubblica ci lasciasse semplicemente in pace, non avremmo bisogno di essere nemici."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.1A|	"I know," he says. "But for now, I need to return to my fleet. Which means I'll be needing an escort out of your territory, just to make sure no one attacks me. Maybe you could take us by way of New Tibet? I'm sure Commander Nguyen would appreciate one last visit to the Buddhist monasteries there before that world becomes closed off to us completely." You agree, and he begins preparing his ship for takeoff.|1402|0
units.english: "I know," he says. "But for now, I need to return to my fleet. Which means I'll be needing an escort out of your territory, just to make sure no one attacks me. Maybe you could take us by way of New Tibet? I'm sure Commander Nguyen would appreciate one last visit to the Buddhist monasteries there before that world becomes closed off to us completely." You agree, and he begins preparing his ship for takeoff.
units.italian: "Lo so," dice. "Ma per ora devo tornare alla mia flotta. Il che significa che avrò bisogno di una scorta per uscire dal vostro territorio, giusto per assicurarmi che nessuno mi attacchi. Magari potresti portarci passando per New Tibet? Sono sicuro che il comandante Nguyen apprezzerebbe un'ultima visita ai monasteri buddisti di là, prima che quel mondo ci sia completamente chiuso." Sei d'accordo, e lui comincia a preparare la sua nave al decollo.

units.id: mission:FW Death of Nguyen|Soon after landing on <origin>, you receive an encoded message from Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers. "Captain <last>," he says, "I would like to thank you once again for allowing us to assist you on Poisonwood. Unfortunately, I have bad news that may concern you. Commander Nguyen, who was with you when one of the Alphas was apprehended, has been assassinated, shot in the head at point blank range. His attacker has not been found. We fear that this may be retribution for his part in the action on Poisonwood, and we urge you and your crew to be cautious. With deepest regards - Danforth."|1419|0
units.english: Soon after landing on <origin>, you receive an encoded message from Admiral Danforth, the leader of the Oathkeepers. "Captain <last>," he says, "I would like to thank you once again for allowing us to assist you on Poisonwood. Unfortunately, I have bad news that may concern you. Commander Nguyen, who was with you when one of the Alphas was apprehended, has been assassinated, shot in the head at point blank range. His attacker has not been found. We fear that this may be retribution for his part in the action on Poisonwood, and we urge you and your crew to be cautious. With deepest regards - Danforth."
units.italian: Poco dopo essere atterrato su <origin>, ricevi un messaggio in codice dall'ammiraglio Danforth, il capo degli Oathkeepers. "Capitano <last>," dice, "vorrei ringraziarti ancora una volta per averci permesso di aiutarvi su Poisonwood. Purtroppo ho una brutta notizia che potrebbe riguardarti. Il comandante Nguyen, che era con te quando uno degli Alphas è stato catturato, è stato assassinato, ucciso con un colpo alla testa a bruciapelo. Il suo aggressore non è stato trovato. Temiamo che possa essere una rappresaglia per la sua parte nell'azione su Poisonwood, e ti esortiamo, insieme al tuo equipaggio, alla massima prudenza. Con la massima stima, Danforth."

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|name|1426|0
units.english: Return to the Front
units.italian: Ritorno al fronte

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|description|1427|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to bolster the defenses there.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per rinforzare le difese.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|log|1436|0
units.english: Liberated Poisonwood from the Alpha invaders. Had to bombard them from orbit, and many civilians were killed in the process, but at least the planet is free again.
units.italian: Hai liberato Poisonwood dagli invasori Alpha. Si è dovuto bombardarli dall'orbita, e molti civili sono morti nel processo, ma almeno il pianeta è di nuovo libero.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|The ships in orbit are eliminated, but there are still the Alphas and their servants here on the ground to take care of. Your escorts unload the troops, who spread throughout the city and quickly determine that, as far as the locals know, the Alphas are all holed up in a large factory on the outskirts of town. The locals also inform you that the Alphas have taken dozens of prisoners and are holding them in the factory.|1439|0
units.english: The ships in orbit are eliminated, but there are still the Alphas and their servants here on the ground to take care of. Your escorts unload the troops, who spread throughout the city and quickly determine that, as far as the locals know, the Alphas are all holed up in a large factory on the outskirts of town. The locals also inform you that the Alphas have taken dozens of prisoners and are holding them in the factory.
units.italian: Le navi in orbita sono eliminate, ma a terra restano ancora gli Alphas e i loro servi di cui occuparsi. Le tue scorte sbarcano le truppe, che si diffondono per la città e stabiliscono rapidamente che, per quanto ne sanno gli abitanti, gli Alphas si sono tutti barricati in una grande fabbrica alla periferia. Gli abitanti ti informano anche che gli Alphas hanno preso diverse decine di prigionieri e li tengono dentro la fabbrica.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|	As you are trying to prepare the Free Worlds troops to storm the building, suddenly one of your escorts, the Starry Warrior, takes off. You radio the captain, who responds, "Sorry, Captain, but I'm following orders. Alondo suspected you wouldn't like this." Then he opens fire on the factory, destroying everything within several blocks with blaster fire and torpedoes. He does not stop firing until there is nothing left but smoldering rubble in that entire section of the city.|1440|0
units.english: As you are trying to prepare the Free Worlds troops to storm the building, suddenly one of your escorts, the Starry Warrior, takes off. You radio the captain, who responds, "Sorry, Captain, but I'm following orders. Alondo suspected you wouldn't like this." Then he opens fire on the factory, destroying everything within several blocks with blaster fire and torpedoes. He does not stop firing until there is nothing left but smoldering rubble in that entire section of the city.
units.italian: Mentre stai cercando di preparare le truppe delle Free Worlds all'assalto dell'edificio, all'improvviso una delle tue scorte, la Starry Warrior, decolla. Chiami via radio il capitano, che risponde: "Scusa, Capitano, ma seguo gli ordini. Alondo sospettava che non ti sarebbe piaciuto." Poi apre il fuoco sulla fabbrica, distruggendo tutto nel raggio di diversi isolati con colpi di blaster e siluri. Non smette di sparare finché in tutta quella zona della città non resta altro che macerie fumanti.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|	The Alphas are presumably dead. So are their prisoners, and any of the locals who were unlucky enough to be close to the factory when it was destroyed. The governor of Poisonwood, unable to conceal her anger, asks you to take your troops and your ships and leave her world immediately.|1441|0
units.english: The Alphas are presumably dead. So are their prisoners, and any of the locals who were unlucky enough to be close to the factory when it was destroyed. The governor of Poisonwood, unable to conceal her anger, asks you to take your troops and your ships and leave her world immediately.
units.italian: Presumibilmente gli Alphas sono morti. Lo sono anche i loro prigionieri, e tutti gli abitanti che hanno avuto la sfortuna di trovarsi vicino alla fabbrica quando è stata distrutta. Il governatore di Poisonwood, incapace di nascondere la rabbia, ti chiede di prendere le tue truppe e le tue navi e di lasciare immediatamente il suo mondo.

units.id: mission:FW Alphas 1.2A|	You send a message to the Council asking what you should do, and they tell you to leave the planet and join Alondo on <planet>, to help bolster the defenses there. You leave <origin> with a heavy heart, glad that the Alphas are gone but wishing things here on <origin> had ended differently.|1442|0
units.english: You send a message to the Council asking what you should do, and they tell you to leave the planet and join Alondo on <planet>, to help bolster the defenses there. You leave <origin> with a heavy heart, glad that the Alphas are gone but wishing things here on <origin> had ended differently.
units.italian: Mandi un messaggio al Consiglio per chiedere che cosa fare, e ti dicono di lasciare il pianeta e di raggiungere Alondo su <planet>, per aiutare a rinforzare le difese. Lasci <origin> con il cuore pesante, contento che gli Alphas se ne siano andati ma desiderando che le cose qui su <origin> fossero finite diversamente.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|name|1452|0
units.english: Alondo to <planet>
units.italian: Alondo per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|description|1453|0
units.english: Bring Alondo to <planet> to try to convince the locals to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Porta Alondo su <planet> per cercare di convincere la gente del posto a unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|clearance|1456|0
units.english: Alondo manages to convince the spaceport to let you land "free of charge."
units.italian: Alondo riesce a convincere lo spazioporto a lasciarvi atterrare "gratis".

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|blocked|1460|0
units.english: Alondo contacts you and asks, "Do you have a bunk ready for me?" You do not, so you will need to free one up to continue this mission.
units.italian: Alondo ti contatta e chiede: "Hai una cuccetta pronta per me?" Non ce l'hai, quindi dovrai liberarne una per continuare questa missione.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|You report in to Alondo, who listens to your description of the battle for Poisonwood with a grim expression on his face. "It's not the end, of course," he says. "It seems like no matter how many times we win a battle against the Alphas, there are more of them out there. But I'm glad that the immediate crisis has been dealt with."|1466|0
units.english: You report in to Alondo, who listens to your description of the battle for Poisonwood with a grim expression on his face. "It's not the end, of course," he says. "It seems like no matter how many times we win a battle against the Alphas, there are more of them out there. But I'm glad that the immediate crisis has been dealt with."
units.italian: Riferisci ad Alondo, che ascolta la tua descrizione della battaglia per Poisonwood con un'espressione cupa. "Non è la fine, naturalmente," dice. "Sembra che, per quante battaglie vinciamo contro gli Alphas, ce ne siano sempre altri là fuori. Ma sono contento che la crisi immediata sia stata gestita."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"Isn't there any way we can track down the rest of the Alphas?"|1468|0
units.english: "Isn't there any way we can track down the rest of the Alphas?"
units.italian: "Non c'è proprio modo di rintracciare il resto degli Alphas?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"What is our next mission now?"|1469|0
units.english: "What is our next mission now?"
units.italian: "Qual è la nostra prossima missione adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"Not really," he says. "There are probably small enclaves throughout human space, and perhaps beyond our space as well. All we can do is make it harder for them to grow powerful."|1471|0
units.english: "Not really," he says. "There are probably small enclaves throughout human space, and perhaps beyond our space as well. All we can do is make it harder for them to grow powerful."
units.italian: "Non davvero," dice. "Probabilmente ci sono piccole enclavi in tutto lo spazio umano, e forse anche oltre i nostri confini. Tutto quello che possiamo fare è rendere loro più difficile diventare potenti."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"And how do we do that?" you ask.|1472|0
units.english: "And how do we do that?" you ask.
units.italian: "E come lo facciamo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"The Senate has authorized a diplomatic mission to Bloodsea," he says. "It's the smallest of the pirate worlds, and we're going to see what we need to offer them to get them to join the Free Worlds. The official settlements there only amount to a few thousand people, so it shouldn't be too hard to convince them that joining us is better than resisting us."|1474|0
units.english: "The Senate has authorized a diplomatic mission to Bloodsea," he says. "It's the smallest of the pirate worlds, and we're going to see what we need to offer them to get them to join the Free Worlds. The official settlements there only amount to a few thousand people, so it shouldn't be too hard to convince them that joining us is better than resisting us."
units.italian: "Il Senato ha autorizzato una missione diplomatica su Bloodsea," dice. "È il più piccolo dei mondi pirata, e andremo a vedere che cosa dobbiamo offrire per convincerli a unirsi alle Free Worlds. Gli insediamenti ufficiali laggiù contano solo qualche migliaio di persone, quindi non dovrebbe essere troppo difficile convincerli che unirsi a noi è meglio che resisterci."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"Okay, sounds like fun!"|1476|0
units.english: "Okay, sounds like fun!"
units.italian: "Va bene, sembra divertente!"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	"Wait, didn't things go south rather quickly the last time we attempted this?"|1478|0
units.english: "Wait, didn't things go south rather quickly the last time we attempted this?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, l'ultima volta che ci abbiamo provato le cose non sono andate storte piuttosto in fretta?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|	Alondo grins. "Yes, but the Free Worlds are in a much stronger position now, and the pirate worlds know it's only a matter of time before they are forced to become civilized. And, the incident on Poisonwood proved that we can't afford to fight a war on two fronts. We need to eliminate the pirate threat, and a diplomatic solution with them is the only sort that will last. So, let's get going!"|1479|0
units.english: Alondo grins. "Yes, but the Free Worlds are in a much stronger position now, and the pirate worlds know it's only a matter of time before they are forced to become civilized. And, the incident on Poisonwood proved that we can't afford to fight a war on two fronts. We need to eliminate the pirate threat, and a diplomatic solution with them is the only sort that will last. So, let's get going!"
units.italian: Alondo sorride. "Sì, ma le Free Worlds adesso sono in una posizione molto più forte, e i mondi pirata sanno che è solo questione di tempo prima che siano costretti a civilizzarsi. E l'incidente di Poisonwood ha dimostrato che non possiamo permetterci una guerra su due fronti. Dobbiamo eliminare la minaccia pirata, e una soluzione diplomatica è l'unica che durerà. Quindi, andiamo!"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1|dialog|1482|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|name|1488|0
units.english: Ships from <planet>
units.italian: Navi da <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|description|1489|0
units.english: In order to work toward a peace treaty with Bloodsea, meet up with a convoy of heavily armed merchant ships on <planet>.
units.italian: Per lavorare a un trattato di pace con Bloodsea, incontra un convoglio di navi mercantili pesantemente armate su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|log|1500|0
units.english: The local leaders on the lawless world of Bloodsea have said that they will join the Free Worlds, and stop supporting piracy, in exchange for the equipment to build a more modern spaceport. However, they may just be trying to steal the construction materials; it might be simpler to just attack and conquer them.
units.italian: I capi locali del mondo senza legge di Bloodsea hanno detto che si uniranno alle Free Worlds e smetteranno di sostenere la pirateria, in cambio dell'equipaggiamento per costruire uno spazioporto più moderno. Potrebbero però stare solo cercando di rubare i materiali da costruzione; forse sarebbe più semplice attaccarli e conquistarli.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|The local leaders are unwilling to meet aboard your ship, and Alondo is afraid you will be ambushed if you venture too far away from it, so eventually they agree to set up a tent on the landing pad next to yours and meet there. Outside, a storm is raging, the rain mixing with salt spray from the blood-red ocean nearby.|1502|0
units.english: The local leaders are unwilling to meet aboard your ship, and Alondo is afraid you will be ambushed if you venture too far away from it, so eventually they agree to set up a tent on the landing pad next to yours and meet there. Outside, a storm is raging, the rain mixing with salt spray from the blood-red ocean nearby.
units.italian: I capi locali non vogliono incontrarvi a bordo della tua nave, e Alondo teme che finireste in un'imboscata se vi allontanaste troppo, quindi alla fine accettano di montare una tenda sulla piazzola di atterraggio accanto alla tua e di incontrarvi lì. Fuori infuria una tempesta, e la pioggia si mescola agli spruzzi salati del mare rosso sangue lì vicino.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	Most of the leaders grimace at the sight of you. "What is the invader doing here?" one of them asks to Alondo.|1505|0
units.english: Most of the leaders grimace at the sight of you. "What is the invader doing here?" one of them asks to Alondo.
units.italian: Ai capi locali basta vederti per fare una smorfia. "Che cosa ci fa qui l'invasore?" chiede uno di loro ad Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"Captain <last> was only following orders, but the officer responsible for giving those orders has been justly punished," Alondo says. "We come in peace this time." The leaders don't seem convinced with that answer, but they agree to continue.|1506|0
units.english: "Captain <last> was only following orders, but the officer responsible for giving those orders has been justly punished," Alondo says. "We come in peace this time." The leaders don't seem convinced with that answer, but they agree to continue.
units.italian: "Il capitano <last> stava solo eseguendo gli ordini, ma l'ufficiale responsabile di quegli ordini è stato giustamente punito," dice Alondo. "Questa volta veniamo in pace." I capi non sembrano convinti da quella risposta, ma accettano di continuare.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	As you talk, it becomes clear that the inhabitants of Bloodsea are ashamed of how destitute and undeveloped their world is. Several of them have visited the island spaceport on Deep, and after dancing around the issue for a while, they make a request: if the Free Worlds builds them a real, modern island spaceport, they will join the Free Worlds.|1508|0
units.english: As you talk, it becomes clear that the inhabitants of Bloodsea are ashamed of how destitute and undeveloped their world is. Several of them have visited the island spaceport on Deep, and after dancing around the issue for a while, they make a request: if the Free Worlds builds them a real, modern island spaceport, they will join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Mentre parlate, diventa chiaro che gli abitanti di Bloodsea si vergognano di quanto sia misero e arretrato il loro mondo. Diversi di loro hanno visitato lo spazioporto sull'isola di Deep e, dopo aver girato intorno alla questione per un po', avanzano una richiesta: se le Free Worlds costruiranno per loro un vero spazioporto moderno sull'isola, si uniranno alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	One of them lays out a detailed list of amenities the port must have: concrete seawalls, raised landing pads, floating docks, sturdy hangars and warehouses, and various defense systems "for when the others learn that we've decided to join you." Also, the deal is off if you show up in orbit with a fleet that "looks like an invasion fleet rather than a construction fleet."|1509|0
units.english: One of them lays out a detailed list of amenities the port must have: concrete seawalls, raised landing pads, floating docks, sturdy hangars and warehouses, and various defense systems "for when the others learn that we've decided to join you." Also, the deal is off if you show up in orbit with a fleet that "looks like an invasion fleet rather than a construction fleet."
units.italian: Uno di loro elenca una lista dettagliata delle dotazioni che il porto deve avere: frangiflutti in cemento, piazzole di atterraggio rialzate, darsene galleggianti, hangar e magazzini solidi, e vari sistemi di difesa "per quando gli altri scopriranno che abbiamo deciso di unirci a voi". Inoltre l'accordo salta se vi presentate in orbita con una flotta che "sembra una flotta d'invasione invece di una flotta di costruzione".

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	You thank them and return to your ship. Alondo asks, "What do you think?"|1510|0
units.english: You thank them and return to your ship. Alondo asks, "What do you think?"
units.italian: Li ringrazi e torni alla tua nave. Alondo chiede: "Che cosa ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"Well, building a spaceport is probably cheaper than fighting a major battle."|1512|0
units.english: "Well, building a spaceport is probably cheaper than fighting a major battle."
units.italian: "Beh, costruire uno spazioporto costa probabilmente meno di una grande battaglia."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"They're asking a lot. Why don't we just invade them?"|1514|0
units.english: "They're asking a lot. Why don't we just invade them?"
units.italian: "Chiedono molto. Perché non li invadiamo e basta?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"Yes," he says, "except that I can almost guarantee that when we show up on their doorstep with everything they asked for, some local warlord will attack our ships, steal our supplies, enslave our workers, and build himself a nice cozy island fortress."|1517|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "except that I can almost guarantee that when we show up on their doorstep with everything they asked for, some local warlord will attack our ships, steal our supplies, enslave our workers, and build himself a nice cozy island fortress."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "solo che ti posso quasi garantire che, quando ci presenteremo alla loro porta con tutto quello che hanno chiesto, qualche signore della guerra locale attaccherà le nostre navi, ruberà i nostri rifornimenti, ridurrà in schiavitù i nostri operai e si costruirà una bella fortezza sull'isola."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"So, we attack them?" you ask.|1518|0
units.english: "So, we attack them?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quindi li attacchiamo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"They didn't seem very happy about you doing that the first time. But..." Alondo pauses for a moment.|1522|0
units.english: "They didn't seem very happy about you doing that the first time. But..." Alondo pauses for a moment.
units.italian: "Non erano molto contenti che lo facessi la prima volta. Ma..." Alondo si ferma un momento.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"That's certainly the simpler option," he says. "Tomek may have been punished for disobeying the Senate's orders, but we're in a different situation now. Our numbers have swelled because of our victories and new territory, and we now have the Dreadnoughts at our disposal, so occupying Bloodsea is now a viable option.|1524|0
units.english: "That's certainly the simpler option," he says. "Tomek may have been punished for disobeying the Senate's orders, but we're in a different situation now. Our numbers have swelled because of our victories and new territory, and we now have the Dreadnoughts at our disposal, so occupying Bloodsea is now a viable option.
units.italian: "È certamente l'opzione più semplice," dice. "Tomek è stato punito per aver disubbidito agli ordini del Senato, ma ora la situazione è diversa. I nostri numeri sono cresciuti grazie alle vittorie e al nuovo territorio, e ora abbiamo i Dreadnought a disposizione, quindi occupare Bloodsea è un'opzione praticabile.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|	"You're on the Council now," he says. "I'll leave it up to you. Option one is, we bring them the supplies and workers, in merchant ships, but use very heavily armed merchant ships in case they double cross us. Option two is, we go to Dancer and see if JJ can lend us an invasion fleet while I convince the Senate that attacking Bloodsea is the better decision."|1525|0
units.english: "You're on the Council now," he says. "I'll leave it up to you. Option one is, we bring them the supplies and workers, in merchant ships, but use very heavily armed merchant ships in case they double cross us. Option two is, we go to Dancer and see if JJ can lend us an invasion fleet while I convince the Senate that attacking Bloodsea is the better decision."
units.italian: "Ora sei tu nel Consiglio," dice. "Lascio decidere a te. Opzione uno: portiamo loro i rifornimenti e gli operai, su navi mercantili, ma usando navi mercantili pesantemente armate nel caso ci tradiscano. Opzione due: andiamo su Dancer e vediamo se JJ può prestarci una flotta d'invasione, mentre io convinco il Senato che attaccare Bloodsea è la decisione migliore."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1|dialog|1528|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|name|1534|0
units.english: Supplies from <planet>
units.italian: Rifornimenti da <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|description|1535|0
units.english: Stop on <planet> so that the ships you are escorting can pick up more supplies and workers, then bring them to Bloodsea to help build a new spaceport.
units.italian: Fermati su <planet> perché le navi che stai scortando possano caricare altri rifornimenti e operai, poi portale su Bloodsea per aiutare a costruire un nuovo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|Waiting for you in the spaceport on <origin> are two Behemoth heavy freighters, which will be carrying the equipment and workers to Bloodsea. You can't help notice that nearly a third of their cargo space has been converted into extra outfit space, and both ships have a pair of Plasma Turrets mounted on them, and what looks like Torpedo Launchers as well.|1547|0
units.english: Waiting for you in the spaceport on <origin> are two Behemoth heavy freighters, which will be carrying the equipment and workers to Bloodsea. You can't help notice that nearly a third of their cargo space has been converted into extra outfit space, and both ships have a pair of Plasma Turrets mounted on them, and what looks like Torpedo Launchers as well.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto di <origin> ti aspettano due Behemoth, mercantili pesanti che trasporteranno l'attrezzatura e gli operai su Bloodsea. Non puoi fare a meno di notare che quasi un terzo del loro spazio di carico è stato convertito in spazio per gli equipaggiamenti, e che entrambe le navi montano una coppia di torrette al plasma, e quello che sembra essere anche dei lanciatori di siluri.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|	While you are on Zug, you and Alondo meet up with Freya and ask how the Dreadnought production is going. "We're nearly there," she says, "just one or two kinks left to work out. They've produced another two prototypes, but not enough to start selling them yet. I know, you're itching to pilot one of your own. Believe me, we're working as fast as possible."|1548|0
units.english: While you are on Zug, you and Alondo meet up with Freya and ask how the Dreadnought production is going. "We're nearly there," she says, "just one or two kinks left to work out. They've produced another two prototypes, but not enough to start selling them yet. I know, you're itching to pilot one of your own. Believe me, we're working as fast as possible."
units.italian: Mentre sei su Zug, tu e Alondo incontrate Freya e le chiedete come va la produzione dei Dreadnought. "Ci siamo quasi," dice, "resta solo un problema o due da risolvere. Hanno prodotto altri due prototipi, ma non abbastanza per cominciare a venderli. Lo so, non vedi l'ora di pilotarne uno tuo. Credimi, stiamo lavorando il più in fretta possibile."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|	Your next stop is to pick up more workers and construction supplies on <destination>.|1549|0
units.english: Your next stop is to pick up more workers and construction supplies on <destination>.
units.italian: La tua prossima tappa è su <destination>, per caricare altri operai e materiali da costruzione.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1A|dialog|1559|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left the freighters behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro i mercantili! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|name|1565|0
units.english: Supplies to <planet>
units.italian: Rifornimenti per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|description|1566|0
units.english: Escort these two freighters to <destination> to help build a new spaceport. This may just be an excuse for pirates to attack you.
units.italian: Scorta questi due mercantili fino a <destination> per aiutare a costruire un nuovo spazioporto. Potrebbe essere solo un pretesto perché i pirati ti attacchino.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|You stop on <origin>, and wait as more supplies are loaded onto the two Behemoths you are escorting. Your final stop is <planet>. Alondo thought it likely that some pirates would try to intercept your convoy and steal its cargo, but as long as both freighters land on the planet without being captured or destroyed, you will be able to begin the construction project and thus meet the demands of the people on <planet> to convince them to join the Free Worlds.|1579|0
units.english: You stop on <origin>, and wait as more supplies are loaded onto the two Behemoths you are escorting. Your final stop is <planet>. Alondo thought it likely that some pirates would try to intercept your convoy and steal its cargo, but as long as both freighters land on the planet without being captured or destroyed, you will be able to begin the construction project and thus meet the demands of the people on <planet> to convince them to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Ti fermi su <origin>, e aspetti che altri rifornimenti vengano caricati sui due Behemoth che stai scortando. La tua ultima tappa è <planet>. Alondo pensava probabile che alcuni pirati cercassero di intercettare il convoglio e rubarne il carico, ma finché entrambi i mercantili atterrano sul pianeta senza essere catturati né distrutti, potrai cominciare il progetto di costruzione e soddisfare così le richieste degli abitanti di <planet>, convincendoli a unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|dialog|1589|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left the freighters behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro i mercantili! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|log|1609|0
units.english: Brought the construction supplies that the people of Bloodsea requested, and they have agreed to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai portato i materiali da costruzione che la gente di Bloodsea aveva chiesto, e hanno accettato di unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|A few of the locals on Bloodsea appear surprised that you actually brought the supplies for a new spaceport, and that you arrived with all the supplies intact. But after meeting up with Alondo, they agree to hold their side of the bargain: from now on, Bloodsea will be a part of the Free Worlds, with all the rights and responsibilities that implies. And that means that they will refuse to knowingly harbor any pirate fleets or other known criminals.|1611|0
units.english: A few of the locals on Bloodsea appear surprised that you actually brought the supplies for a new spaceport, and that you arrived with all the supplies intact. But after meeting up with Alondo, they agree to hold their side of the bargain: from now on, Bloodsea will be a part of the Free Worlds, with all the rights and responsibilities that implies. And that means that they will refuse to knowingly harbor any pirate fleets or other known criminals.
units.italian: Alcuni degli abitanti di Bloodsea sembrano sorpresi che abbiate davvero portato i rifornimenti per un nuovo spazioporto, e che siate arrivati con tutto il carico intatto. Ma dopo essersi incontrati con Alondo, accettano di mantenere la loro parte dell'accordo: da ora in poi Bloodsea farà parte delle Free Worlds, con tutti i diritti e le responsabilità che questo comporta. Il che significa che si rifiuteranno di ospitare consapevolmente flotte pirata o altri criminali noti.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.1B|	Alondo tells you that he will catch a ride back with the freighters when they return. "But, you'll probably want to head out sooner," he says, "because I've got some good news for you. Freya just contacted me, to say that they're now ready to start selling Dreadnoughts to certain select members of the Free Worlds, including you. That also means she's done with her work on Zug, so she'll need you to give her a lift from there."|1612|0
units.english: Alondo tells you that he will catch a ride back with the freighters when they return. "But, you'll probably want to head out sooner," he says, "because I've got some good news for you. Freya just contacted me, to say that they're now ready to start selling Dreadnoughts to certain select members of the Free Worlds, including you. That also means she's done with her work on Zug, so she'll need you to give her a lift from there."
units.italian: Alondo ti dice che tornerà con i mercantili quando ripartiranno. "Ma probabilmente vorrai andartene prima," dice, "perché ho una buona notizia per te. Freya mi ha appena contattato per dire che ora sono pronti a cominciare a vendere i Dreadnought ad alcuni membri scelti delle Free Worlds, te compreso. Il che significa anche che ha finito il suo lavoro su Zug, quindi avrà bisogno che tu la vada a prendere."

units.id: mission:Ijs catches another ride|Ijs approaches you with his duffel as you're stepping off the <ship>.|1626|0
units.english: Ijs approaches you with his duffel as you're stepping off the <ship>.
units.italian: Ijs ti si avvicina con il suo borsone mentre scendi dalla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Ijs catches another ride|	"Thanks for getting me this close, but I really need to get to Winter as soon as possible. I hope you don't take offense that I've booked passage on another transport. Here's <payment> for getting me this far, anyway. I hope to see you again soon, Captain <last>."|1627|0
units.english: "Thanks for getting me this close, but I really need to get to Winter as soon as possible. I hope you don't take offense that I've booked passage on another transport. Here's <payment> for getting me this far, anyway. I hope to see you again soon, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi portato fin qui, ma devo davvero arrivare su Winter il prima possibile. Spero che non ti offenda se ho prenotato un passaggio su un altro trasporto. Ecco <payment> per avermi portato fin qua, comunque. Spero di rivederti presto, capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2|name|1635|0
units.english: Invasion Fleet
units.italian: Flotta d'invasione

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2|description|1636|0
units.english: Rather than pursuing a diplomatic agreement, meet up with JJ on <planet> and gather a fleet to invade and subjugate Bloodsea.
units.italian: Invece di cercare un accordo diplomatico, incontra JJ su <planet> e raduna una flotta per invadere e sottomettere Bloodsea.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|name|1648|0
units.english: Capture Bloodsea
units.italian: Cattura Bloodsea

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|description|1649|0
units.english: Take a Free Worlds fleet to invade the <system> system and eliminate any pirate resistance, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Porta una flotta delle Free Worlds a invadere il sistema <system> ed eliminare qualsiasi resistenza pirata, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|When you meet up with JJ, Alondo explains that you're in need of an invasion fleet for Bloodsea. JJ looks confused at the request. "What? Whatever happened to diplomacy? I only heard that the Senate approved a diplomatic mission. Didn't Tomek get punished for this exact stunt?"|1662|0
units.english: When you meet up with JJ, Alondo explains that you're in need of an invasion fleet for Bloodsea. JJ looks confused at the request. "What? Whatever happened to diplomacy? I only heard that the Senate approved a diplomatic mission. Didn't Tomek get punished for this exact stunt?"
units.italian: Quando incontrate JJ, Alondo spiega che avete bisogno di una flotta d'invasione per Bloodsea. JJ sembra confuso dalla richiesta. "Come? Che fine ha fatto la diplomazia? Avevo solo sentito che il Senato aveva approvato una missione diplomatica. Tomek non è stato punito proprio per questo tipo di trovata?"

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	"Alondo convinced me that the Bloodsea natives were just planning to betray us."|1664|0
units.english: "Alondo convinced me that the Bloodsea natives were just planning to betray us."
units.italian: "Alondo mi ha convinto che gli abitanti di Bloodsea stavano solo progettando di tradirci."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	"I don't think the pirates will understand any language except overwhelming force."|1665|0
units.english: "I don't think the pirates will understand any language except overwhelming force."
units.italian: "Non credo che i pirati capiranno altro linguaggio che la forza schiacciante."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	"You're starting to sound a lot like Tomek," JJ remarks.|1666|0
units.english: "You're starting to sound a lot like Tomek," JJ remarks.
units.italian: "Stai cominciando a somigliare parecchio a Tomek," osserva JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	"I also contacted the Senate on the way here," Alondo says, "and they approved the invasion. We're much more powerful now than before, making invasion a viable option."|1667|0
units.english: "I also contacted the Senate on the way here," Alondo says, "and they approved the invasion. We're much more powerful now than before, making invasion a viable option."
units.italian: "Ho anche contattato il Senato mentre venivo qui," dice Alondo, "e hanno approvato l'invasione. Siamo molto più forti di prima, il che rende l'invasione un'opzione praticabile."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	"Perhaps," says JJ. "I'll provide you with some ships, but I'm not happy about this. I need to keep most of my fleet here, to defend against the Navy, but I'll select a few of the strongest ships to accompany you to Bloodsea. Make sure they make it home safe, though. We'll need every ship we can get for when the Navy attacks. Good luck, Captain."|1668|0
units.english: "Perhaps," says JJ. "I'll provide you with some ships, but I'm not happy about this. I need to keep most of my fleet here, to defend against the Navy, but I'll select a few of the strongest ships to accompany you to Bloodsea. Make sure they make it home safe, though. We'll need every ship we can get for when the Navy attacks. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: "Forse," dice JJ. "Ti darò qualche nave, ma la cosa non mi piace. Devo tenere qui la maggior parte della mia flotta, per difenderci dalla Marina, ma sceglierò alcune delle navi più forti perché ti accompagnino su Bloodsea. Assicurati però che tornino a casa sane e salve. Avremo bisogno di ogni nave che riusciremo a mettere insieme quando la Marina attaccherà. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|dialog|1695|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still pirates defending the system. All pirates in the system must be eliminated before <planet> can be taken.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora pirati che difendono il sistema. Tutti i pirati nel sistema devono essere eliminati prima che <planet> possa essere preso.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|log|1697|0
units.english: Conquered Bloodsea in the name of the Free Worlds. With enough militia ships patrolling their star system, they ought to think twice before returning to piracy.
units.italian: Hai conquistato Bloodsea in nome delle Free Worlds. Con abbastanza navi della milizia a pattugliare il loro sistema stellare, dovrebbero pensarci due volte prima di tornare alla pirateria.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|You land at the main spaceport on Bloodsea with Free Worlds ships circling overhead, ready to bombard the locals if they show any sign of resistance. It is a tense atmosphere, and the leaders sullenly agree to give the Free Worlds access to their planet and to avoid knowingly supporting piracy or other criminal activity. You have won this world, but you have clearly not won the hearts of the locals.|1703|0
units.english: You land at the main spaceport on Bloodsea with Free Worlds ships circling overhead, ready to bombard the locals if they show any sign of resistance. It is a tense atmosphere, and the leaders sullenly agree to give the Free Worlds access to their planet and to avoid knowingly supporting piracy or other criminal activity. You have won this world, but you have clearly not won the hearts of the locals.
units.italian: Atterri allo spazioporto principale di Bloodsea con le navi delle Free Worlds che girano in orbita, pronte a bombardare la gente del posto al minimo segno di resistenza. L'atmosfera è tesa, e i capi accettano di malavoglia di dare alle Free Worlds accesso al loro pianeta e di evitare consapevolmente di sostenere la pirateria o altre attività criminali. Hai vinto questo mondo, ma chiaramente non hai conquistato il cuore degli abitanti.

units.id: mission:FW Bloodsea 1.2A|	A while later, you receive new orders from Alondo. "I've got some good news for you," he says. "Freya just contacted me, to say that they're now ready to start selling Dreadnoughts to certain select members of the Free Worlds, including you. That also means she's done with her work on Zug, so she'll need you to give her a lift from there."|1704|0
units.english: A while later, you receive new orders from Alondo. "I've got some good news for you," he says. "Freya just contacted me, to say that they're now ready to start selling Dreadnoughts to certain select members of the Free Worlds, including you. That also means she's done with her work on Zug, so she'll need you to give her a lift from there."
units.italian: Un po' più tardi ricevi nuovi ordini da Alondo. "Ho una buona notizia per te," dice. "Freya mi ha appena contattato per dire che ora sono pronti a cominciare a vendere i Dreadnought ad alcuni membri scelti delle Free Worlds, te compreso. Il che significa anche che ha finito il suo lavoro su Zug, quindi avrà bisogno che tu la vada a prendere."

units.id: mission:FW Dreadnoughts Ready|name|1736|0
units.english: Meet Freya on <planet>
units.italian: Incontra Freya su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Dreadnoughts Ready|description|1737|0
units.english: Freya is done overseeing the initial production run of Dreadnoughts in the shipyard on Zug. Meet up with her there, to give her a ride to wherever she is assigned next.
units.italian: Freya ha finito di sovrintendere al primo ciclo di produzione dei Dreadnought nel cantiere su Zug. Raggiungila lì, per darle un passaggio dove sarà assegnata dopo.

units.id: mission:FW Dreadnoughts Ready|log|1745|0
units.english: Freya has announced that Dreadnoughts are now for sale on Zug. Finally the Free Worlds have a warship that can stand up to Navy capital ships.
units.italian: Freya ha annunciato che i Dreadnought sono ora in vendita su Zug. Finalmente le Free Worlds hanno una nave da guerra capace di reggere il confronto con le navi capitali della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|name|1751|0
units.english: Freya to <planet>
units.italian: Freya per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|description|1752|0
units.english: Bring Freya to <planet> to meet up with JJ and make plans for convincing Albatross to give up piracy and join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Porta Freya su <planet> per incontrarti con JJ e fare piani per convincere Albatross a rinunciare alla pirateria e unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|Freya comes to your ship soon after you land. She is beaming, and looks more relaxed than you have seen her in months. "Southbound Shipyards is churning out Dreadnoughts now!" she says. "Still only at a rate of one a week or so, but for a ship this big that's quite impressive. And it means you can now buy one of your own, if you've got enough savings. Seriously, even if you can't afford one yet, be sure to stop by the shipyard and check them out." She is clearly very proud.|1764|0
units.english: Freya comes to your ship soon after you land. She is beaming, and looks more relaxed than you have seen her in months. "Southbound Shipyards is churning out Dreadnoughts now!" she says. "Still only at a rate of one a week or so, but for a ship this big that's quite impressive. And it means you can now buy one of your own, if you've got enough savings. Seriously, even if you can't afford one yet, be sure to stop by the shipyard and check them out." She is clearly very proud.
units.italian: Freya viene alla tua nave poco dopo l'atterraggio. Raiante, sembra più rilassata di quanto tu l'abbia vista in mesi. "I cantieri Southbound stanno sfornando Dreadnought adesso!" dice. "Ancora solo al ritmo di una a settimana circa, ma per una nave di questa dimensione è piuttosto notevole. E significa che ora puoi comprarne una tua, se hai abbastanza risparmi. Davvero, anche se ancora non puoi permettertela, passa dal cantiere a darci un'occhiata." È chiaramente molto fiera.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Great job, Freya! I'm really glad to have a talented engineer on the Council to help get things done."|1766|0
units.english: "Great job, Freya! I'm really glad to have a talented engineer on the Council to help get things done."
units.italian: "Ottimo lavoro, Freya! Sono davvero contento di avere un'ingegnere così brava nel Consiglio che aiuta a far succedere le cose."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Glad to hear it. Now, what is our next action against the pirates?"|1767|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it. Now, what is our next action against the pirates?"
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo. Ora, qual è la nostra prossima mossa contro i pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	She smiles. "Thanks. It was actually really refreshing to be able to tackle a concrete, solvable problem for a change, instead of all this nebulous political stuff. Speaking of which, our next step will be to go visit JJ. He's going to be doing the diplomatic outreach to Albatross."|1769|0
units.english: She smiles. "Thanks. It was actually really refreshing to be able to tackle a concrete, solvable problem for a change, instead of all this nebulous political stuff. Speaking of which, our next step will be to go visit JJ. He's going to be doing the diplomatic outreach to Albatross."
units.italian: Sorride. "Grazie. È stato davvero rinfrescante potermi occupare di un problema concreto e risolvibile, per cambiare, invece di tutta questa roba politica nebulosa. A proposito, il nostro prossimo passo sarà andare a trovare JJ. Sarà lui a occuparsi dell'apertura diplomatica verso Albatross."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Right, right, back to work," she says. "Well, it sounds like the next order of business is for you to transport me to <planet> to take JJ's place there while he makes a diplomatic visit to Albatross."|1772|0
units.english: "Right, right, back to work," she says. "Well, it sounds like the next order of business is for you to transport me to <planet> to take JJ's place there while he makes a diplomatic visit to Albatross."
units.italian: "Giusto, giusto, torniamo al lavoro," dice. "Beh, sembra che il prossimo ordine del giorno sia che tu mi porti su <planet> a prendere il posto di JJ, mentre lui fa una visita diplomatica su Albatross."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	You ask, "Wait, doesn't Alondo usually handle the diplomacy?"|1775|0
units.english: You ask, "Wait, doesn't Alondo usually handle the diplomacy?"
units.italian: Chiedi: "Aspetta, non è Alondo che di solito si occupa della diplomazia?"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Usually, yes," she says. "But the locals on Albatross specifically asked for JJ. They're a very traditional population, and JJ is well-known as both a family man and a brave soldier. Whereas Alondo is... Alondo."|1776|0
units.english: "Usually, yes," she says. "But the locals on Albatross specifically asked for JJ. They're a very traditional population, and JJ is well-known as both a family man and a brave soldier. Whereas Alondo is... Alondo."
units.italian: "Di solito sì," dice. "Ma la gente di Albatross ha chiesto specificamente JJ. Sono una popolazione molto tradizionalista, e JJ è benvoluto sia come padre di famiglia sia come soldato coraggioso. Mentre Alondo è... Alondo."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Fair enough. Let's head to <planet>!"|1778|0
units.english: "Fair enough. Let's head to <planet>!"
units.italian: "Giusto. Andiamo su <planet>!"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Wait, I don't understand. Why don't they like Alondo?"|1780|0
units.english: "Wait, I don't understand. Why don't they like Alondo?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, non capisco. Perché non gli piace Alondo?"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	She looks genuinely surprised that you don't know. "Alondo is gay," she says. "There are few worlds here in the South where that would bother anyone, but Albatross is one of them. So Alondo is taking a break to go visit the Senate, while JJ deals with this particular diplomatic situation."|1781|0
units.english: She looks genuinely surprised that you don't know. "Alondo is gay," she says. "There are few worlds here in the South where that would bother anyone, but Albatross is one of them. So Alondo is taking a break to go visit the Senate, while JJ deals with this particular diplomatic situation."
units.italian: Sembra sinceramente sorpresa che tu non lo sappia. "Alondo è gay," dice. "Qui a sud ci sono pochi mondi in cui questo darebbe fastidio a qualcuno, ma Albatross è uno di quelli. Quindi Alondo si prende una pausa per andare dal Senato, mentre JJ si occupa di questa particolare situazione diplomatica."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Okay, I feel silly for even asking. Let's go meet up with JJ!"|1783|0
units.english: "Okay, I feel silly for even asking. Let's go meet up with JJ!"
units.italian: "Va bene, mi sento sciocco anche solo ad averlo chiesto. Andiamo a incontrare JJ!"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Actually, I'm gay too."|1785|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm gay too."
units.italian: "A dire il vero, sono gay anch'io."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Ah. That certainly explains some things."|1787|0
units.english: "Ah. That certainly explains some things."
units.italian: "Ah. Questo spiega certamente alcune cose."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"It seems crazy that anyone would be bothered by that in this day and age."|1788|0
units.english: "It seems crazy that anyone would be bothered by that in this day and age."
units.italian: "Mi sembra assurdo che qualcuno possa darsi fastidio per questo oggigiorno."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	"Yes," she says. "Yes, it does. Now, let's go meet up with JJ."|1789|0
units.english: "Yes," she says. "Yes, it does. Now, let's go meet up with JJ."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Sì, è assurdo. Ora andiamo a incontrare JJ."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|label|1791|0
units.english: me too
units.italian: me too

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|	Freya raises an eyebrow. "I hadn't heard. We don't have time to find someone else for this mission, so you'll need to be the one to transport JJ. Stay safe."|1794|0
units.english: Freya raises an eyebrow. "I hadn't heard. We don't have time to find someone else for this mission, so you'll need to be the one to transport JJ. Stay safe."
units.italian: Freya alza un sopracciglio. "Non lo sapevo. Non abbiamo tempo di trovare qualcun altro per questa missione, quindi dovrai essere tu a trasportare JJ. Stai attento."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 1|dialog|1797|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|name|1802|0
units.english: Visit Albatross
units.italian: Visita Albatross

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|description|1803|0
units.english: Bring JJ to Albatross to negotiate with the local leaders and perhaps convince them to join the Free Worlds and give up their support of piracy.
units.italian: Porta JJ su Albatross per negoziare con i capi locali e magari convincerli a unirsi alle Free Worlds e a rinunciare al loro sostegno alla pirateria.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|When you meet up with JJ, he looks exhausted. "Our scouts are reporting that the Navy is building a massive base on New Iceland," he says, "just a few jumps away from here. So every day I look up at the sky and wonder if today is the day when they will invade."|1816|0
units.english: When you meet up with JJ, he looks exhausted. "Our scouts are reporting that the Navy is building a massive base on New Iceland," he says, "just a few jumps away from here. So every day I look up at the sky and wonder if today is the day when they will invade."
units.italian: Quando incontri JJ, sembra esausto. "I nostri esploratori riferiscono che la Marina sta costruendo una base enorme su New Iceland," dice, "a solo qualche salto da qui. Quindi ogni giorno guardo il cielo e mi chiedo se oggi sarà il giorno in cui invaderanno."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|	You talk for a while and agree that despite the threat from the Navy, dealing with the pirates is important. JJ explains that Albatross started out as a sort of farming commune: independent, but not associated with any illegal activity. But they were dominated by pirates, and since then, one pirate overlord after another has held sway over the planet. So in principle at least, the locals ought to welcome the idea of Free Worlds protection.|1817|0
units.english: You talk for a while and agree that despite the threat from the Navy, dealing with the pirates is important. JJ explains that Albatross started out as a sort of farming commune: independent, but not associated with any illegal activity. But they were dominated by pirates, and since then, one pirate overlord after another has held sway over the planet. So in principle at least, the locals ought to welcome the idea of Free Worlds protection.
units.italian: Parlate per un po' e concordate che, nonostante la minaccia della Marina, occuparsi dei pirati è importante. JJ spiega che Albatross è nato come una specie di comune agricola: indipendente, ma non legata ad alcuna attività illegale. Poi però è stata dominata dai pirati, e da allora un signore della guerra pirata dopo l'altro ha tenuto in pugno il pianeta. Quindi, almeno in linea di principio, la gente del posto dovrebbe accogliere con favore l'idea della protezione delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|	While you are traveling with JJ, Freya agrees to stay here and work on a better surveillance network, to give Dancer advance warning if the Navy decides to invade.|1818|0
units.english: While you are traveling with JJ, Freya agrees to stay here and work on a better surveillance network, to give Dancer advance warning if the Navy decides to invade.
units.italian: Mentre viaggi con JJ, Freya accetta di restare qui e lavorare a una rete di sorveglianza migliore, per dare a Dancer un avvertimento anticipato se la Marina decidesse di invadere.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2|dialog|1821|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying JJ hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta JJ non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|name|1833|0
units.english: Hunt Ryk Bartlett
units.italian: Dai la caccia a Ryk Bartlett

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|description|1834|0
units.english: Hunt down the pirate warlord Ryk Bartlett, who has been plundering merchant convoys in the vicinity of Zeta Aquilae. (Only his personal ship, the Dread, must be destroyed.) Then, return to Albatross.
units.italian: Dai la caccia al signore della guerra pirata Ryk Bartlett, che ha saccheggiato convogli mercantili nei dintorni di Zeta Aquilae. (Deve essere distrutta solo la sua nave personale, la Dread.) Poi torna su Albatross.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|JJ puts a hand on your shoulder before leaving the ship. "Freya let me know. For safety reasons only, of course. You can stay here if you aren't comfortable."|1850|0
units.english: JJ puts a hand on your shoulder before leaving the ship. "Freya let me know. For safety reasons only, of course. You can stay here if you aren't comfortable."
units.italian: Prima di lasciare la nave, JJ ti mette una mano sulla spalla. "Freya mi ha informato. Solo per ragioni di sicurezza, naturalmente. Puoi restare qui se non ti senti a tuo agio."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"No, I'll come with you."|1852|0
units.english: "No, I'll come with you."
units.italian: "No, vengo con te."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"Thank you. I'll stay."|1853|0
units.english: "Thank you. I'll stay."
units.italian: "Grazie. Resto io."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|Your meeting with the elders of Albatross happens in secret, by night. They are afraid that if their current pirate overlord, Ryk Bartlett, finds out that they have met with you, they will face retribution. JJ begins by describing the Free Worlds' offer: all the benefits of the mutual defense pact, in exchange for an agreement to uphold human rights and the rule of law, plus offering financial support for the Free Worlds.|1856|0
units.english: Your meeting with the elders of Albatross happens in secret, by night. They are afraid that if their current pirate overlord, Ryk Bartlett, finds out that they have met with you, they will face retribution. JJ begins by describing the Free Worlds' offer: all the benefits of the mutual defense pact, in exchange for an agreement to uphold human rights and the rule of law, plus offering financial support for the Free Worlds.
units.italian: L'incontro con gli anziani di Albatross avviene in segreto, di notte. Temono che, se il loro attuale signore della guerra, Ryk Bartlett, scoprisse che vi hanno incontrato, subirebbero una rappresaglia. JJ comincia descrivendo l'offerta delle Free Worlds: tutti i benefici del patto di difesa reciproca, in cambio dell'impegno a rispettare i diritti umani e lo stato di diritto, più un sostegno finanziario alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"Begging your pardon," says one of the elders, "but what makes you different from any pirate organization that comes in here, demanding our money in return for 'protection'?"|1857|0
units.english: "Begging your pardon," says one of the elders, "but what makes you different from any pirate organization that comes in here, demanding our money in return for 'protection'?"
units.italian: "Con il vostro permesso," dice uno degli anziani, "che cosa vi rende diversi da qualsiasi organizzazione pirata che arriva qui a chiederci soldi in cambio di 'protezione'?"

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	(Let JJ answer that.)|1859|0
units.english: (Let JJ answer that.)
units.italian: (Lascia che risponda JJ.)

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	(Try to give an explanation myself.)|1861|0
units.english: (Try to give an explanation myself.)
units.italian: (Prova a dare una spiegazione io.)

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"We're a representative government," you say, "with open financial records and clear human rights guidelines that we uphold."|1862|0
units.english: "We're a representative government," you say, "with open financial records and clear human rights guidelines that we uphold."
units.italian: "Siamo un governo rappresentativo," dici, "con bilanci pubblici e chiare linee guida sui diritti umani che rispettiamo."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	JJ explains about the Senate, that each world has a say in how the Free Worlds income is spent. "And," he says, "we will not take your children as slaves, or force you to work in factories producing illegal drugs."|1865|0
units.english: JJ explains about the Senate, that each world has a say in how the Free Worlds income is spent. "And," he says, "we will not take your children as slaves, or force you to work in factories producing illegal drugs."
units.italian: JJ spiega come funziona il Senato, che ogni mondo ha voce in capitolo su come vengono spesi i proventi delle Free Worlds. "E," dice, "non prenderemo i vostri figli come schiavi, né vi costringeremo a lavorare in fabbriche che producono droghe illegali."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	The elder who spoke seems unconvinced. "Seems to me that you 'Council' folks are the real rulers, and your 'Senate' is a figurehead," he says. "So I don't call that true democracy."|1867|0
units.english: The elder who spoke seems unconvinced. "Seems to me that you 'Council' folks are the real rulers, and your 'Senate' is a figurehead," he says. "So I don't call that true democracy."
units.italian: L'anziano che ha parlato sembra non convinto. "A me pare che voi del 'Consiglio' siate i veri governanti, e che il vostro 'Senato' sia solo una facciata," dice. "Quindi non la chiamerei vera democrazia."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"Maybe," says another of the elders, "but they're still better than Bartlett. I say, if the Free Worlds can free us from him, we'll at least give their new government a try." A few of the others nod in agreement.|1868|0
units.english: "Maybe," says another of the elders, "but they're still better than Bartlett. I say, if the Free Worlds can free us from him, we'll at least give their new government a try." A few of the others nod in agreement.
units.italian: "Forse," dice un altro degli anziani, "ma sono comunque meglio di Bartlett. Io dico che, se le Free Worlds riescono a liberarci da lui, almeno daremo una possibilità al loro nuovo governo." Qualche altro annuisce.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	They explain that to the best of their knowledge, Bartlett is spending most of his time near the Zeta Aquilae system, plundering merchant convoys of heavy metals coming out of Rand and Oblivion. If you can destroy Bartlett and his flagship, the Dread, his followers will probably disperse.|1869|0
units.english: They explain that to the best of their knowledge, Bartlett is spending most of his time near the Zeta Aquilae system, plundering merchant convoys of heavy metals coming out of Rand and Oblivion. If you can destroy Bartlett and his flagship, the Dread, his followers will probably disperse.
units.italian: Spiegano che, per quanto ne sanno, Bartlett passa la maggior parte del tempo nei pressi del sistema Zeta Aquilae, saccheggiando convogli mercantili di metalli pesanti in uscita da Rand e Oblivion. Se riesci a distruggere Bartlett e la sua ammiraglia, la Dread, i suoi seguaci probabilmente si disperderanno.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	The meeting with the elders of Albatross happens in secret, by night. They are afraid that if their current pirate overlord, Ryk Bartlett, finds out that they have met with you, they will face retribution. You wait in your ship while JJ attempts to convince the elders that they should join the Free Worlds. After some hours, JJ returns.|1872|0
units.english: The meeting with the elders of Albatross happens in secret, by night. They are afraid that if their current pirate overlord, Ryk Bartlett, finds out that they have met with you, they will face retribution. You wait in your ship while JJ attempts to convince the elders that they should join the Free Worlds. After some hours, JJ returns.
units.italian: L'incontro con gli anziani di Albatross avviene in segreto, di notte. Temono che, se il loro attuale signore della guerra, Ryk Bartlett, scoprisse che vi hanno incontrato, subirebbero una rappresaglia. Aspetti nella tua nave mentre JJ cerca di convincere gli anziani a unirsi alle Free Worlds. Dopo qualche ora, JJ torna.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	"They're interested," JJ says to you, "but they want the current warlord dead."|1873|0
units.english: "They're interested," JJ says to you, "but they want the current warlord dead."
units.italian: "Sono interessati," ti dice JJ, "ma vogliono morto l'attuale signore della guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|	They explained that to the best of their knowledge, Bartlett is spending most of his time near the Zeta Aquilae system, plundering merchant convoys of heavy metals coming out of Rand and Oblivion. If you can destroy Bartlett and his flagship, the Dread, his followers will probably disperse.|1874|0
units.english: They explained that to the best of their knowledge, Bartlett is spending most of his time near the Zeta Aquilae system, plundering merchant convoys of heavy metals coming out of Rand and Oblivion. If you can destroy Bartlett and his flagship, the Dread, his followers will probably disperse.
units.italian: Hanno spiegato che, per quanto ne sanno, Bartlett passa la maggior parte del tempo nei pressi del sistema Zeta Aquilae, saccheggiando convogli mercantili di metalli pesanti in uscita da Rand e Oblivion. Se riesci a distruggere Bartlett e la sua ammiraglia, la Dread, i suoi seguaci probabilmente si disperderanno.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|dialog|1877|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that you either haven't destroyed Ryk Bartlett's ship, the Dread, or your escort carrying JJ hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and make sure that you've done everything you need to do to complete this mission.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che o non hai distrutto la nave di Ryk Bartlett, la Dread, o la tua scorta che porta JJ non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e assicurarti di aver fatto tutto quello che serve per completare questa missione.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2A|dialog|1884|0
units.english: You have destroyed Ryk Bartlett's ship. Hopefully now the elders on Albatross will be more inclined to bargain with the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la nave di Ryk Bartlett. Speriamo che ora gli anziani di Albatross siano più disposti a trattare con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|name|1912|0
units.english: Return to Dancer
units.italian: Torna su Dancer

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|description|1913|0
units.english: Return to Dancer with JJ, and meet up with Freya.
units.italian: Torna su Dancer con JJ e incontra Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|log|1925|0
units.english: The people of Albatross, another anarchist world, have agreed to join the Free Worlds in gratitude for having been liberated from Ryk Bartlett, a warlord who was extorting them for protection money.
units.italian: La gente di Albatross, un altro mondo anarchico, ha accettato di unirsi alle Free Worlds in segno di gratitudine per essere stata liberata da Ryk Bartlett, un signore della guerra che la estorceva con il denaro della protezione.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|When the elders on Albatross learn that you have destroyed Ryk Bartlett and freed them from his rule, they grudgingly agree to join the Free Worlds, "at least on a trial basis." You hope that you will be able to live up to the promises you have given them.|1928|0
units.english: When the elders on Albatross learn that you have destroyed Ryk Bartlett and freed them from his rule, they grudgingly agree to join the Free Worlds, "at least on a trial basis." You hope that you will be able to live up to the promises you have given them.
units.italian: Quando gli anziani di Albatross scoprono che hai distrutto Ryk Bartlett e li hai liberati dal suo dominio, accettano di malavoglia di unirsi alle Free Worlds, "almeno in via di prova". Speri di riuscire a mantenere le promesse che hai fatto loro.

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|	After you return to your ship, JJ says, "So far Freya says there have been no hints of a Navy attack against Dancer, and she has a new set of surveillance satellites up and running in Alpha Arae to monitor fleet activity. So, let's go meet up with her and decide what our next steps should be."|1929|0
units.english: After you return to your ship, JJ says, "So far Freya says there have been no hints of a Navy attack against Dancer, and she has a new set of surveillance satellites up and running in Alpha Arae to monitor fleet activity. So, let's go meet up with her and decide what our next steps should be."
units.italian: Dopo che sei tornato alla nave, JJ dice: "Finora Freya dice che non ci sono indizi di un attacco della Marina contro Dancer, e ha messo in funzione una nuova serie di satelliti di sorveglianza ad Alpha Arae per monitorare l'attività delle flotte. Quindi andiamo a incontrarla e decidiamo quali sono i prossimi passi."

units.id: mission:FW Albatross 2B|dialog|1932|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying JJ hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
