units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta JJ non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|name|1943|0
units.english: Occupy Zeta Aquilae
units.italian: Occupa Zeta Aquilae

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|description|1944|0
units.english: Take a Free Worlds fleet to Zeta Aquilae, drive away whatever Navy ships are there, and then land on Rand, which has decided to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Porta una flotta delle Free Worlds a Zeta Aquilae, scaccia le navi della Marina che ci sono, poi atterra su Rand, che ha deciso di unirsi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|blocked|1950|0
units.english: You need a bunk free for Freya (in addition to JJ) to continue this mission.
units.italian: Per continuare questa missione ti serve una cuccetta libera per Freya (oltre a quella di JJ).

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|log|1957|0
units.english: Another two planets, Rand and Oblivion, have expressed an interest in joining the Free Worlds. They are rather far from the rest of Free Worlds territory, however, so JJ is worried that it would create an indefensible tactical position.
units.italian: Altri due pianeti, Rand e Oblivion, hanno espresso l'interesse di unirsi alle Free Worlds. Sono però piuttosto lontani dal resto del territorio delle Free Worlds, quindi JJ teme che creerebbero una posizione tattica indifendibile.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|When you land on Dancer, Freya has just received some exciting news. "It turns out taking out Bartlett had some unexpected side effects," she says. "Bartlett has been hounding the systems on the northeastern fringe of the Dirt Belt for years, and had a lot of enemies. The governments of Rand and Oblivion are so grateful to you for eliminating him that they've reached out to us to begin the process of joining the Free Worlds! And several other worlds in that region are interested now, too."|1960|0
units.english: When you land on Dancer, Freya has just received some exciting news. "It turns out taking out Bartlett had some unexpected side effects," she says. "Bartlett has been hounding the systems on the northeastern fringe of the Dirt Belt for years, and had a lot of enemies. The governments of Rand and Oblivion are so grateful to you for eliminating him that they've reached out to us to begin the process of joining the Free Worlds! And several other worlds in that region are interested now, too."
units.italian: Quando atterri su Dancer, Freya ha appena ricevuto una notizia entusiasmante. "A quanto pare eliminare Bartlett ha avuto effetti collaterali inattesi," dice. "Bartlett perseguitava da anni i sistemi al margine nord-orientale della Fascia di Terra, e aveva molti nemici. I governi di Rand e Oblivion ti sono così grati per averlo eliminato che ci hanno contattato per cominciare la procedura di adesione alle Free Worlds! E anche diversi altri mondi di quella regione ora sono interessati."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	JJ frowns. "That's really awful timing," he says, "and would put us in a really bad tactical position - spread out, and with the Navy right in the middle."|1961|0
units.english: JJ frowns. "That's really awful timing," he says, "and would put us in a really bad tactical position - spread out, and with the Navy right in the middle."
units.italian: JJ aggrotto le sopracciglia. "È davvero un momento pessimo," dice, "e ci metterebbe in una posizione tattica davvero brutta: sparsi, con la Marina proprio in mezzo."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"Are you saying we shouldn't let them join, even though they want to?"|1963|0
units.english: "Are you saying we shouldn't let them join, even though they want to?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che non dovremmo lasciarli entrare, anche se vogliono?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"Well, I say, if they want to join us, we should let them. Who knows if they'll be this enthusiastic about the Free Worlds later if we let them down now."|1964|0
units.english: "Well, I say, if they want to join us, we should let them. Who knows if they'll be this enthusiastic about the Free Worlds later if we let them down now."
units.italian: "Beh, io dico che, se vogliono unirsi a noi, dovremmo lasciarglielo fare. Chissà se saranno ancora così entusiasti delle Free Worlds più avanti, se li deludiamo adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	JJ thinks about that for a moment, then says, "Well, I guess we should let them join. It will mean we may need to launch an assault to drive the Navy off New Iceland. But if we do that, our tactical position shifts from one that's worse than what we have now, to something much better. Freya, did they say if there's any sign that the Navy has gotten word of this?"|1965|0
units.english: JJ thinks about that for a moment, then says, "Well, I guess we should let them join. It will mean we may need to launch an assault to drive the Navy off New Iceland. But if we do that, our tactical position shifts from one that's worse than what we have now, to something much better. Freya, did they say if there's any sign that the Navy has gotten word of this?"
units.italian: JJ ci pensa un momento, poi dice: "Beh, credo che dovremmo lasciarli entrare. Significherà che potremmo dover lanciare un assalto per scacciare la Marina da New Iceland. Ma se lo facciamo, la nostra posizione tattica passa da peggiore di quella attuale a molto migliore. Freya, hanno detto se c'è qualche segno che la Marina ne sia venuta a conoscenza?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"A few Carriers are in orbit around Rand," she says, "so they must suspect something. But the bulk of the Navy fleet is still to the north and east of here."|1966|0
units.english: "A few Carriers are in orbit around Rand," she says, "so they must suspect something. But the bulk of the Navy fleet is still to the north and east of here."
units.italian: "Ci sono alcune portaerei in orbita intorno a Rand," dice, "quindi devono sospettare qualcosa. Ma il grosso della flotta della Marina è ancora a nord e a est da qui."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	JJ says, "Okay Captain, here's what I propose. We'll leave the bulk of our fleet here to defend Dancer and New Portland, but take a few of our best ships to Zeta Aquilae and drive out the Navy. Freya and I will travel with you so that if we need to make any decisions, we'll have most of the Council there in person. How does that sound?"|1967|0
units.english: JJ says, "Okay Captain, here's what I propose. We'll leave the bulk of our fleet here to defend Dancer and New Portland, but take a few of our best ships to Zeta Aquilae and drive out the Navy. Freya and I will travel with you so that if we need to make any decisions, we'll have most of the Council there in person. How does that sound?"
units.italian: JJ dice: "Va bene, Capitano, ecco che cosa propongo. Lasceremo qui il grosso della nostra flotta a difendere Dancer e New Portland, ma porteremo qualche nostra nave migliore a Zeta Aquilae e scacceremo la Marina. Freya e io viaggeremo con te, così se dovremo prendere decisioni avremo la maggior parte del Consiglio lì di persona. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"It sounds like a good plan. Let's do it!"|1969|0
units.english: "It sounds like a good plan. Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra un buon piano. Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"I'm still worried we're over-extending ourselves."|1971|0
units.english: "I'm still worried we're over-extending ourselves."
units.italian: "Resto comunque preoccupato che ci stiamo allungando troppo."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"You may be right," he says. "Freya, what do you think?"|1972|0
units.english: "You may be right," he says. "Freya, what do you think?"
units.italian: "Potresti aver ragione," dice. "Freya, tu che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|	"I think we need to take this opportunity while it's available," she says. "Sorry, Captain, but I'm with JJ on this one." They both board your ship, and you get ready to travel to Zeta Aquilae.|1973|0
units.english: "I think we need to take this opportunity while it's available," she says. "Sorry, Captain, but I'm with JJ on this one." They both board your ship, and you get ready to travel to Zeta Aquilae.
units.italian: "Penso che dobbiamo cogliere questa occasione finché è disponibile," dice. "Scusa, Capitano, ma su questo sto con JJ." Salgono entrambi sulla tua nave, e ti prepari a partire per Zeta Aquilae.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1|dialog|2013|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|name|2021|0
units.english: Regroup at Wayfarer
units.italian: Raggruppati su Wayfarer

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|description|2022|0
units.english: The Free Worlds fleet has been scattered by a Navy invasion. Regroup with the ships that fled to <destination>, and plan your next move.
units.italian: La flotta delle Free Worlds è stata dispersa da un'invasione della Marina. Raggruppati con le navi fuggite su <destination> e pianifica la prossima mossa.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|log|2033|0
units.english: The Navy has invaded Rastaban and Delta Sagittarii, effectively slicing through Free Worlds territory and splitting up the Free Worlds fleet.
units.italian: La Marina ha invaso Rastaban e Delta Sagittarii, tagliando di fatto in due il territorio delle Free Worlds e dividendo la loro flotta.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|You meet up with the governor of Rand, and sign the papers to make her planet a part of the Free Worlds. The nearby systems are reporting no Navy interference: they seem to have been allowed to switch allegiances without any attempt by the Republic to stop them. Of course, that might partly be because these are mining planets, not as necessary to the Republic's survival as the farming worlds on the other end of the Dirt Belt.|2035|0
units.english: You meet up with the governor of Rand, and sign the papers to make her planet a part of the Free Worlds. The nearby systems are reporting no Navy interference: they seem to have been allowed to switch allegiances without any attempt by the Republic to stop them. Of course, that might partly be because these are mining planets, not as necessary to the Republic's survival as the farming worlds on the other end of the Dirt Belt.
units.italian: Incontri il governatore di Rand e firmi i documenti che rendono il suo pianeta parte delle Free Worlds. I sistemi vicini non segnalano interferenze della Marina: sembra che sia stato permesso loro di cambiare schieramento senza che la Repubblica tentasse di fermarle. Naturalmente, questo potrebbe in parte dipendere dal fatto che sono pianeti minerari, meno necessari alla sopravvivenza della Repubblica dei mondi agricoli all'altro capo della Fascia di Terra.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	Freya leaves the meeting to check up on her surveillance network, and rushes back into the room a few minutes later. JJ takes one look at the expression on her face and quickly excuses himself from the table. You join him outside in the hallway, and he asks Freya what's going on.|2036|0
units.english: Freya leaves the meeting to check up on her surveillance network, and rushes back into the room a few minutes later. JJ takes one look at the expression on her face and quickly excuses himself from the table. You join him outside in the hallway, and he asks Freya what's going on.
units.italian: Freya lascia la riunione per controllare la sua rete di sorveglianza, e qualche minuto dopo rientra di corsa nella stanza. JJ le guarda un istante l'espressione e si scusa subito dal tavolo. Lo raggiungi fuori nel corridoio, e lui chiede a Freya che cosa succede.

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"The Navy just invaded Delta Sagittarii and Rastaban," she says. "We're cut off from the rest of Free space. Our defense fleet was woefully outnumbered. Many ships were destroyed, and the rest fled back toward the Rim, or to Tarazed."|2037|0
units.english: "The Navy just invaded Delta Sagittarii and Rastaban," she says. "We're cut off from the rest of Free space. Our defense fleet was woefully outnumbered. Many ships were destroyed, and the rest fled back toward the Rim, or to Tarazed."
units.italian: "La Marina ha appena invaso Delta Sagittarii e Rastaban," dice. "Siamo tagliati fuori dal resto dello spazio delle Free Worlds. La nostra flotta di difesa era tragicamente in inferiorità numerica. Molte navi sono state distrutte, e il resto è fuggito verso il Bordo, o verso Tarazed."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"I was afraid of this," says JJ, "but I didn't think it would happen so quickly. I wonder if they knew that these new worlds were joining us, and deliberately used them as a diversion."|2038|0
units.english: "I was afraid of this," says JJ, "but I didn't think it would happen so quickly. I wonder if they knew that these new worlds were joining us, and deliberately used them as a diversion."
units.italian: "Temevo che sarebbe successo," dice JJ, "ma non pensavo così in fretta. Mi chiedo se sapessero che questi nuovi mondi si stavano unendo a noi, e li abbiano deliberatamente usati come diversivo."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"What do we do now?"|2040|0
units.english: "What do we do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	JJ says, "Freya, you said part of our fleet fled to Tarazed?"|2041|0
units.english: JJ says, "Freya, you said part of our fleet fled to Tarazed?"
units.italian: JJ dice: "Freya, hai detto che una parte della nostra flotta è fuggita verso Tarazed?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"Yes," she says. "Probably not a strong enough fleet to drive them off, though."|2042|0
units.english: "Yes," she says. "Probably not a strong enough fleet to drive them off, though."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Probabilmente però non una flotta abbastanza forte da scacciarli."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"Well, I guess we should regroup with them," he says. "Hopefully then we can plan a coordinated strike. Or if necessary, we can abandon this sector and get our fleet back to the Rim without losing too many ships. Captain <last>, can you take us to <destination>?"|2043|0
units.english: "Well, I guess we should regroup with them," he says. "Hopefully then we can plan a coordinated strike. Or if necessary, we can abandon this sector and get our fleet back to the Rim without losing too many ships. Captain <last>, can you take us to <destination>?"
units.italian: "Beh, credo che dovremmo raggrupparci con loro," dice. "Speriamo di poter poi pianificare un attacco coordinato. O, se necessario, possiamo abbandonare questo settore e riportare la flotta sul Bordo senza perdere troppe navi. Capitano <last>, puoi portarci su <destination>?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"Sure."|2045|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	"What if the Navy follows the fleet to Wayfarer? We're three of the four Council members. Shouldn't we avoid a situation where we could all be killed?"|2047|0
units.english: "What if the Navy follows the fleet to Wayfarer? We're three of the four Council members. Shouldn't we avoid a situation where we could all be killed?"
units.italian: "E se la Marina seguisse la flotta fino a Wayfarer? Siamo tre dei quattro membri del Consiglio. Non dovremmo evitare una situazione in cui potremmo essere uccisi tutti?"

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|	From JJ's expression, it's clear that he doesn't even want to dignify that question with a response. "If we die, the Free Worlds will live on," he says, "and there's no way we're abandoning a whole section of the fleet just to save our own skins. So, let's go to Wayfarer."|2048|0
units.english: From JJ's expression, it's clear that he doesn't even want to dignify that question with a response. "If we die, the Free Worlds will live on," he says, "and there's no way we're abandoning a whole section of the fleet just to save our own skins. So, let's go to Wayfarer."
units.italian: Dall'espressione di JJ è chiaro che non vuole nemmeno degnare quella domanda di una risposta. "Se moriamo, le Free Worlds vivranno lo stesso," dice, "e non abbandoneremo un'intera sezione della flotta solo per salvare la nostra pelle. Quindi andiamo su Wayfarer."

units.id: mission:FW Rand 1B|dialog|2051|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying JJ and Freya hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta JJ e Freya non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: government:Syndicate (Hostile)|display name|2124|0
units.english: Syndicate
units.italian: Sindacato

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|name|2135|0
units.english: The Defector
units.italian: Il disertore

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|description|2136|0
units.english: Travel to New Tibet to question the Syndicate about the defector supposedly carrying vital evidence and information that they are behind the bombings.
units.italian: Recati su New Tibet per interrogare il Sindacato sul disertore che presumibilmente porta prove e informazioni vitali sul fatto che sono stati loro a orchestrare gli attentati.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|log|2146|0
units.english: As a member of the Council, must make the deciding vote on a difficult decision. A defector from the Syndicate is claiming to have proof that the Syndicate was behind the bombings of Martini and Geminus. If that is true, the Republic may agree to make peace with the Free Worlds. But, refusing to return the defector to the Syndicate would certainly earn their enmity.
units.italian: Come membro del Consiglio, devi esprimere il voto decisivo su una decisione difficile. Un disertore del Sindacato sostiene di avere le prove che il Sindacato è dietro gli attentati a Martini e Geminus. Se è vero, la Repubblica potrebbe accettare di fare la pace con le Free Worlds. Ma rifiutarsi di restituire il disertore al Sindacato ci guadagnerebbe certamente la loro inimicizia.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|The fleet in orbit around Wayfarer is pitifully small, surely not enough to take on more than a couple of Navy capital ships. JJ orders one of their communication officers to try to establish a secure link to Bourne or to any Free Worlds post on the other side of the Navy blockade. After about ten minutes, the officer returns and says, "Sir, we've received communications from New Tibet sent earlier today. You need to talk to them."|2148|0
units.english: The fleet in orbit around Wayfarer is pitifully small, surely not enough to take on more than a couple of Navy capital ships. JJ orders one of their communication officers to try to establish a secure link to Bourne or to any Free Worlds post on the other side of the Navy blockade. After about ten minutes, the officer returns and says, "Sir, we've received communications from New Tibet sent earlier today. You need to talk to them."
units.italian: La flotta in orbita intorno a Wayfarer è miserevolmente piccola, di certo non abbastanza per affrontare più di un paio di navi capitali della Marina. JJ ordina a uno dei suoi ufficiali delle comunicazioni di cercare di stabilire un collegamento sicuro con Bourne o con qualsiasi presidio delle Free Worlds dall'altra parte del blocco della Marina. Dopo una decina di minuti, l'ufficiale torna e dice: "Signore, abbiamo ricevuto delle comunicazioni da New Tibet, inviate oggi. Dovete sentirle."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Our fleet is there?" asks JJ.|2149|0
units.english: "Our fleet is there?" asks JJ.
units.italian: "La nostra flotta è là?" chiede JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"No sir, it's the Syndicate. The Syndicate has a war fleet in Alioth."|2150|0
units.english: "No sir, it's the Syndicate. The Syndicate has a war fleet in Alioth."
units.italian: "No, signore, è il Sindacato. Il Sindacato ha una flotta da guerra ad Alioth."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"What?" says JJ. He rushes into the communication room, and you and Freya follow. "Play the communication," JJ says. On the video screen is a Buddhist monk in a maroon robe; behind him, you see other monks rushing about with none of the serenity you would usually expect of them.|2151|0
units.english: "What?" says JJ. He rushes into the communication room, and you and Freya follow. "Play the communication," JJ says. On the video screen is a Buddhist monk in a maroon robe; behind him, you see other monks rushing about with none of the serenity you would usually expect of them.
units.italian: "Come?" dice JJ. Si precipita nella sala delle comunicazioni, e tu e Freya lo seguite. "Riproduci la comunicazione," dice JJ. Sullo schermo video c'è un monaco buddista in tunica color bordeaux; dietro di lui vedi altri monaci che corrono qua e là, senza nulla della serenità che di solito ti aspetteresti da loro.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The monk explains, "I pray that this communication reaches the Council. Yesterday a Syndicate ship landed near our monastery, and the pilot sought refuge with us. He claims to have evidence that the Syndicate, or some faction within the Syndicate, was behind the attacks on Geminus and Martini. Evidence that a certain faction within the Syndicate values economic growth above all else," says the monk, "and incited this war for that reason."|2152|0
units.english: The monk explains, "I pray that this communication reaches the Council. Yesterday a Syndicate ship landed near our monastery, and the pilot sought refuge with us. He claims to have evidence that the Syndicate, or some faction within the Syndicate, was behind the attacks on Geminus and Martini. Evidence that a certain faction within the Syndicate values economic growth above all else," says the monk, "and incited this war for that reason."
units.italian: Il monaco spiega: "Prego che questa comunicazione raggiunga il Consiglio. Ieri una nave del Sindacato è atterrata vicino al nostro monastero, e il pilota ha cercato rifugio da noi. Sostiene di avere le prove che il Sindacato, o una qualche fazione al suo interno, è dietro gli attacchi a Geminus e Martini. Prove che una certa fazione del Sindacato tiene la crescita economica al di sopra di ogni altra cosa," dice il monaco, "e che ha incitato questa guerra proprio per questo."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"That's insane," says Freya.|2153|0
units.english: "That's insane," says Freya.
units.italian: "È assurdo," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"But not completely implausible," says JJ.|2154|0
units.english: "But not completely implausible," says JJ.
units.italian: "Ma non del tutto inverosimile," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	(Continue watching the communication.)|2156|0
units.english: (Continue watching the communication.)
units.italian: (Continua a guardare la comunicazione.)

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The video of the monk continues, "He was unable to show us this evidence, but he made claims of having plans for a nuclear device. After arriving he hid his ship in a cave, just before a Syndicate fleet appeared in orbit. They do not know where the defector landed, so they have begun searching settlement to settlement under the assumption that one is harboring him. They are currently here, wrecking the monastery in their hunt."|2157|0
units.english: The video of the monk continues, "He was unable to show us this evidence, but he made claims of having plans for a nuclear device. After arriving he hid his ship in a cave, just before a Syndicate fleet appeared in orbit. They do not know where the defector landed, so they have begun searching settlement to settlement under the assumption that one is harboring him. They are currently here, wrecking the monastery in their hunt."
units.italian: Il video del monaco prosegue: "Non è stato in grado di mostrarci queste prove, ma ha affermato di avere progetti per un ordigno nucleare. Dopo essere arrivato ha nascosto la sua nave in una grotta, poco prima che una flotta del Sindacato comparisse in orbita. Non sanno dove sia atterrato il disertore, quindi hanno cominciato a perquisire insediamento per insediamento, nel presupposto che qualcuno lo stia ospitando. In questo momento sono qui, e stanno demolendo il monastero durante le ricerche."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	After a moment, JJ says, "If these allegations are true, if we can prove that the Free Worlds were innocent of any involvement in those attacks, the Republic might make peace with us, or at least agree to a ceasefire. I vote that we try to shelter this defector and hear his story."|2158|0
units.english: After a moment, JJ says, "If these allegations are true, if we can prove that the Free Worlds were innocent of any involvement in those attacks, the Republic might make peace with us, or at least agree to a ceasefire. I vote that we try to shelter this defector and hear his story."
units.italian: Dopo un momento, JJ dice: "Se queste accuse sono vere, se riusciamo a dimostrare che le Free Worlds sono innocenti da qualsiasi coinvolgimento in quegli attentati, la Repubblica potrebbe fare la pace con noi, o almeno accettare un cessate il fuoco. Io voto per dare rifugio a questo disertore e ascoltare la sua storia."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"And if it's a lie," says Freya, "and we refuse the Syndicate's request, we lose our only ally. Many more civilians will be killed if we continue to fight without their backing, and we don't even know what this supposed evidence actually is. I care about justice, but trading a definite ally for a slim possibility of peace: that is an unwise investment. I vote that we hand this man over to the Syndicate."|2159|0
units.english: "And if it's a lie," says Freya, "and we refuse the Syndicate's request, we lose our only ally. Many more civilians will be killed if we continue to fight without their backing, and we don't even know what this supposed evidence actually is. I care about justice, but trading a definite ally for a slim possibility of peace: that is an unwise investment. I vote that we hand this man over to the Syndicate."
units.italian: "E se fosse una bugia," dice Freya, "e noi rifiutassimo la richiesta del Sindacato, perderemmo il nostro unico alleato. Molti altri civili moriranno se continuiamo a combattere senza il loro appoggio, e non sappiamo nemmeno che cosa siano davvero queste presunte prove. Mi interessa la giustizia, ma barattare un alleato certo per una magra possibilità di pace è un investimento poco saggio. Io voto per consegnare quest'uomo al Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	(Continue watching the communication.)|2161|0
units.english: (Continue watching the communication.)
units.italian: (Continua a guardare la comunicazione.)

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	You look back at the video screen to see that the monk is gone, replaced by a man in a Syndicated Security uniform. "Greetings, Councilmembers. I'm sorry for the confusion, but please understand. We're hunting a terrorist. This man claiming that we are the ones that caused the bombings is, in fact, the leader of the extremist group that caused them. He developed the nukes with the help of a faction of pirates looking to profit from the instability, and now, when we're finally close to capturing him, he's attempting to frame us for his own crimes against humanity. Allow us to find him, and we'll-"|2162|0
units.english: You look back at the video screen to see that the monk is gone, replaced by a man in a Syndicated Security uniform. "Greetings, Councilmembers. I'm sorry for the confusion, but please understand. We're hunting a terrorist. This man claiming that we are the ones that caused the bombings is, in fact, the leader of the extremist group that caused them. He developed the nukes with the help of a faction of pirates looking to profit from the instability, and now, when we're finally close to capturing him, he's attempting to frame us for his own crimes against humanity. Allow us to find him, and we'll-"
units.italian: Torni a guardare lo schermo video e vedi che il monaco è sparito, sostituito da un uomo in uniforme della Sicurezza del Sindacato. "Salve, membri del Consiglio. Mi scuso per la confusione, ma per favore cercate di capire. Stiamo dando la caccia a un terrorista. Quest'uomo che sostiene che siamo stati noi a causare gli attentati è, in realtà, il capo del gruppo estremista che li ha causati. Ha sviluppato gli ordigni con l'aiuto di una fazione di pirati desiderosa di approfittare dell'instabilità, e ora, quando finalmente siamo vicini a catturarlo, tenta di attribuirci i suoi stessi crimini contro l'umanità. Lasciate che lo troviamo, e noi..."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The feed cuts off. "The message ended there," the communications officer says. The room falls silent.|2163|0
units.english: The feed cuts off. "The message ended there," the communications officer says. The room falls silent.
units.italian: Il collegamento si interrompe. "Il messaggio finiva lì," dice l'ufficiale delle comunicazioni. La stanza cade nel silenzio.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	JJ breaks the silence. "I still say we rescue this defector. The Syndicate could be lying to us. They don't exactly have a reputation for upstanding morality, after all."|2164|0
units.english: JJ breaks the silence. "I still say we rescue this defector. The Syndicate could be lying to us. They don't exactly have a reputation for upstanding morality, after all."
units.italian: JJ rompe il silenzio. "Continuo a dire che dovremmo salvare questo disertore. Il Sindacato potrebbe mentirci. Non è che abbiano proprio una reputazione di moralità integerrima, dopotutto."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Or this 'defector' could easily be the one lying," Freya says. "I say we let them have him while we focus on defending against the Navy. If the Syndicate gets their hands on the true terrorist, their support will surely clear our name. Parliament won't be able to ignore the Syndicate vindicating us."|2165|0
units.english: "Or this 'defector' could easily be the one lying," Freya says. "I say we let them have him while we focus on defending against the Navy. If the Syndicate gets their hands on the true terrorist, their support will surely clear our name. Parliament won't be able to ignore the Syndicate vindicating us."
units.italian: "O questo 'disertore' potrebbe facilmente essere quello che mente," dice Freya. "Io dico di lasciarglielo, mentre ci concentriamo a difenderci dalla Marina. Se il Sindacato mette le mani sul vero terrorista, il loro appoggio ci scagionerà di sicuro. Il Parlamento non potrà ignorare il Sindacato che ci dichiara innocenti."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	As the third Council member present, you have the deciding vote, and the entire course of this war may rest on your decision.|2166|0
units.english: As the third Council member present, you have the deciding vote, and the entire course of this war may rest on your decision.
units.italian: Come terzo membro del Consiglio presente, hai tu il voto decisivo, e l'intero corso di questa guerra potrebbe dipendere dalla tua decisione.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"I say we rescue the defector, even if it means war with the Syndicate."|2168|0
units.english: "I say we rescue the defector, even if it means war with the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Io dico che salviamo il disertore, anche se significa la guerra con il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"I say we let the Syndicate have the terrorist, and focus on winning the battle against the Republic."|2170|0
units.english: "I say we let the Syndicate have the terrorist, and focus on winning the battle against the Republic."
units.italian: "Io dico che lasciamo il terrorista al Sindacato, e concentriamoci a vincere la battaglia contro la Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Are you sure?" asks Freya. "The Syndicate has done a lot for us in the past."|2173|0
units.english: "Are you sure?" asks Freya. "The Syndicate has done a lot for us in the past."
units.italian: "Ne sei sicuro?" chiede Freya. "Il Sindacato ha fatto molto per noi in passato."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Yes, I'm sure. We rescue the defector."|2175|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm sure. We rescue the defector."
units.italian: "Sì, ne sono sicuro. Salviamo il disertore."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Fine, we'll hand him over. But I don't think it's the right thing to do."|2177|0
units.english: "Fine, we'll hand him over. But I don't think it's the right thing to do."
units.italian: "Va bene, glielo consegniamo. Ma non credo sia la cosa giusta da fare."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"If Katya were here," says JJ, "she would tell us to choose justice over political expedience."|2180|0
units.english: "If Katya were here," says JJ, "she would tell us to choose justice over political expedience."
units.italian: "Se Katya fosse qui," dice JJ, "ci direbbe di scegliere la giustizia invece dell'opportunità politica."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Well, she's not here, and I say we can't afford to lose the Syndicate as an ally."|2182|0
units.english: "Well, she's not here, and I say we can't afford to lose the Syndicate as an ally."
units.italian: "Beh, non è qui, e io dico che non possiamo permetterci di perdere il Sindacato come alleato."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"I suppose you're right. Let's mount a rescue operation."|2184|0
units.english: "I suppose you're right. Let's mount a rescue operation."
units.italian: "Immagino che tu abbia ragione. Organizziamo un'operazione di salvataggio."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|label|2187|0
units.english: definitely surrender
units.italian: definitely surrender

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Very well," says JJ. "In that case, we'll need to meet with the fleet captains and figure out how to take on the Navy. Let's meet in the spaceport bar in an hour."|2190|0
units.english: "Very well," says JJ. "In that case, we'll need to meet with the fleet captains and figure out how to take on the Navy. Let's meet in the spaceport bar in an hour."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice JJ. "In tal caso, dovremo incontrare i capitani della flotta e capire come affrontare la Marina. Ci vediamo al bar dello spazioporto fra un'ora."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|label|2193|0
units.english: definitely rescue
units.italian: definitely rescue

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	JJ seems very relieved at your choice. "I think that's the right choice, Captain," he says. "We can take the fleet we have here, sweep up north to avoid the thickest part of the Navy's occupying fleet, and cut over to New Tibet to question the Syndicate in person."|2194|0
units.english: JJ seems very relieved at your choice. "I think that's the right choice, Captain," he says. "We can take the fleet we have here, sweep up north to avoid the thickest part of the Navy's occupying fleet, and cut over to New Tibet to question the Syndicate in person."
units.italian: JJ sembra molto sollevato dalla tua scelta. "Penso che sia la scelta giusta, Capitano," dice. "Possiamo prendere la flotta che abbiamo qui, risalire a nord per evitare la parte più densa della flotta di occupazione della Marina, e puntare su New Tibet per interrogare il Sindacato di persona."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|dialog|2203|0
units.english: You spot the Syndicate fleet orbiting above New Tibet when you enter the system, but to your surprise they begin targeting your ship. They don't seem very interested in answering any questions about the defector.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, avvisti la flotta del Sindacato in orbita sopra New Tibet, ma con tua sorpresa comincia a prendere di mira la tua nave. Non sembrano molto interessati a rispondere a domande sul disertore.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|dialog|2237|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Syndicate ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi del Sindacato che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|log|2243|0
units.english: A defector of the Syndicate who decided to risk his life to stop the war between the Republic and the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Un disertore del Sindacato che ha deciso di rischiare la vita per fermare la guerra tra la Repubblica e le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|It doesn't take long to find the monastery that contacted you earlier; nothing is left of it but the burnt-out shells of buildings. You hurry to land and look around for survivors. You find several corpses dressed in maroon robes, some of them badly burnt, but no sign of the defector or the monk who sent the message.|2245|0
units.english: It doesn't take long to find the monastery that contacted you earlier; nothing is left of it but the burnt-out shells of buildings. You hurry to land and look around for survivors. You find several corpses dressed in maroon robes, some of them badly burnt, but no sign of the defector or the monk who sent the message.
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto a trovare il monastero che vi aveva contattato; non ne resta altro che lo scheletro bruciato degli edifici. Ti affretti ad atterrare e cerchi superstiti. Trovi diversi cadaveri vestiti di tuniche bordeaux, alcuni gravemente bruciati, ma nessuna traccia del disertore né del monaco che aveva inviato il messaggio.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	(Wait to see if anyone approaches now that the Syndicate fleet is gone.)|2247|0
units.english: (Wait to see if anyone approaches now that the Syndicate fleet is gone.)
units.italian: (Aspetta di vedere se qualcuno si avvicina ora che la flotta del Sindacato se n'è andata.)

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	(Give up and contact the rest of the Free Worlds fleet to figure out what to do next.)|2248|0
units.english: (Give up and contact the rest of the Free Worlds fleet to figure out what to do next.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e contatta il resto della flotta delle Free Worlds per capire che cosa fare adesso.)

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	You wait around for a while, but this mountain valley seems to be entirely desolate. Then finally, when you are about to give up hope, Freya spots the distant figures of a few dozen people coming down the side of one of the mountains.|2250|0
units.english: You wait around for a while, but this mountain valley seems to be entirely desolate. Then finally, when you are about to give up hope, Freya spots the distant figures of a few dozen people coming down the side of one of the mountains.
units.italian: Aspetti un po', ma questa valle di montagna sembra del tutto desolata. Poi, alla fine, quando stai per perdere ogni speranza, Freya scorge in lontananza le figure di qualche decina di persone che scendono dal fianco di una delle montagne.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	You are just about to leave when Freya spots something and points. "Look," she says, "someone is coming down the mountain slope toward us." Sure enough, it's a group of several dozen people wearing the distinctive robes of the monks.|2253|0
units.english: You are just about to leave when Freya spots something and points. "Look," she says, "someone is coming down the mountain slope toward us." Sure enough, it's a group of several dozen people wearing the distinctive robes of the monks.
units.italian: Stai per andartene quando Freya nota qualcosa e la indica. "Guarda," dice, "qualcuno sta scendendo dal versante verso di noi." In effetti è un gruppo di diverse decine di persone che indossano le inconfondibili tuniche dei monaci.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	As you wait for them to approach, JJ receives a message from one of the militia crews. "Sir, you have incoming! A scout ship, with Republic markings. Apparently unarmed. Shall we intercept them?"|2255|0
units.english: As you wait for them to approach, JJ receives a message from one of the militia crews. "Sir, you have incoming! A scout ship, with Republic markings. Apparently unarmed. Shall we intercept them?"
units.italian: Mentre aspetti che si avvicinino, JJ riceve un messaggio da uno degli equipaggi della milizia. "Signore, arriva qualcosa verso di voi! Una nave esploratrice, con i contrassegni della Repubblica. Apparentemente disarmata. La intercettiamo?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Oathkeepers?" asks JJ. "Or ordinary Navy? Who are they?"|2256|0
units.english: "Oathkeepers?" asks JJ. "Or ordinary Navy? Who are they?"
units.italian: "Oathkeepers?" chiede JJ. "O Marina normale? Chi sono?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The voice on the other end pauses. "Neither. Navy Intelligence."|2257|0
units.english: The voice on the other end pauses. "Neither. Navy Intelligence."
units.italian: La voce dall'altro capo esita. "Nessuno dei due. Intelligence della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	JJ thinks about that for a second, then says, "Let them land. But follow them down, and if you see so much as a hint of them powering up weapons, blow them out of the sky. Understand?" The officer acknowledges his order and signs off.|2258|0
units.english: JJ thinks about that for a second, then says, "Let them land. But follow them down, and if you see so much as a hint of them powering up weapons, blow them out of the sky. Understand?" The officer acknowledges his order and signs off.
units.italian: JJ ci pensa un secondo, poi dice: "Lasciali atterrare. Ma seguili fino a terra, e se vedi anche solo un accenno che caricano le armi, abbattili. Chiaro?" L'ufficiale conferma l'ordine e chiude.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	As the group of monks approaches from the mountainside, the scout ship comes in for a landing and skids to a halt in the dirt a few dozen meters away. A woman steps off it. She has dark skin, and is dressed entirely in black. Even the whites of her eyes are black: when she gets closer, you can see that it is actually a scleric tattoo, an intricate Celtic knotwork pattern inked into the whites of her eyes. She sees you staring at her, and winks at you with a friendly grin.|2259|0
units.english: As the group of monks approaches from the mountainside, the scout ship comes in for a landing and skids to a halt in the dirt a few dozen meters away. A woman steps off it. She has dark skin, and is dressed entirely in black. Even the whites of her eyes are black: when she gets closer, you can see that it is actually a scleric tattoo, an intricate Celtic knotwork pattern inked into the whites of her eyes. She sees you staring at her, and winks at you with a friendly grin.
units.italian: Mentre il gruppo di monaci si avvicina dal versante, la nave esploratrice si prepara ad atterrare e si ferma sollevando polvere a qualche decina di metri. Ne scende una donna. Ha la pelle scura ed è vestita interamente di nero. Persino il bianco dei suoi occhi è nero: quando si avvicina, vedi che in realtà è un tatuaggio sclerale, un intricato disegno di nodi celtici inciso nel bianco degli occhi. Si accorge che la stai fissando e ti fa l'occhiolino con un sorriso amichevole.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"I'm Captain <last> of the Free Worlds. What is your business here?"|2261|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <last> of the Free Worlds. What is your business here?"
units.italian: "Sono il capitano <last> delle Free Worlds. Che cosa ci fai qui?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Who are you, and what gives you the right to land on our planet?"|2262|0
units.english: "Who are you, and what gives you the right to land on our planet?"
units.italian: "Chi sei, e chi ti dà il diritto di atterrare sul nostro pianeta?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"My name is Raven," she says. "I'm here to question this defector. If he is telling the truth, our war with you will end today." She pauses, then adds, grimly, "And, another war will begin."|2264|0
units.english: "My name is Raven," she says. "I'm here to question this defector. If he is telling the truth, our war with you will end today." She pauses, then adds, grimly, "And, another war will begin."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Raven," dice. "Sono qui per interrogare questo disertore. Se dice la verità, la nostra guerra con voi finirà oggi." Si ferma, poi aggiunge, cupa: "E comincerà un'altra guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	She frowns. "My name is Raven," she says. "I am here to question this defector. If you are interested in knowing the truth, you will allow me to do so."|2267|0
units.english: She frowns. "My name is Raven," she says. "I am here to question this defector. If you are interested in knowing the truth, you will allow me to do so."
units.italian: Aggrotta la fronte. "Mi chiamo Raven," dice. "Sono qui per interrogare questo disertore. Se vi interessa conoscere la verità, mi lascerete farlo."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The monks approach, and you see that among them is a man in more ordinary attire, who must be the defector. "Now," says Raven, "I will question him alone, on my ship."|2269|0
units.english: The monks approach, and you see that among them is a man in more ordinary attire, who must be the defector. "Now," says Raven, "I will question him alone, on my ship."
units.italian: I monaci si avvicinano, e vedi che fra loro c'è un uomo in abiti più comuni, che dev'essere il disertore. "Ora," dice Raven, "lo interrogherò da sola, sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"No, we insist on being present for your interrogation."|2271|0
units.english: "No, we insist on being present for your interrogation."
units.italian: "No, insistiamo per essere presenti al tuo interrogatorio."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Very well, we'll wait outside."|2273|0
units.english: "Very well, we'll wait outside."
units.italian: "Molto bene, aspetteremo fuori."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"No!" says JJ. "We're staying here."|2274|0
units.english: "No!" says JJ. "We're staying here."
units.italian: "No!" dice JJ. "Restiamo qui."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	She hesitates for a long moment. This is probably going against whatever orders she is following. But finally she says, "Very well." The monks step aside. She approaches the defector, and reaches out her hands to him. Hesitantly, he takes her hands. It's an oddly intimate scene, the two of them quietly holding hands and locking eyes - not like any interrogation you have seen before. "Now," she says, "tell me your story."|2276|0
units.english: She hesitates for a long moment. This is probably going against whatever orders she is following. But finally she says, "Very well." The monks step aside. She approaches the defector, and reaches out her hands to him. Hesitantly, he takes her hands. It's an oddly intimate scene, the two of them quietly holding hands and locking eyes - not like any interrogation you have seen before. "Now," she says, "tell me your story."
units.italian: Esita a lungo. Questo probabilmente va contro qualsiasi ordine stia seguendo. Ma alla fine dice: "Va bene." I monaci si fanno da parte. Si avvicina al disertore e gli tende le mani. Lui, esitando, prende le sue. È una scena stranamente intima, i due che si tengono le mani in silenzio e si guardano negli occhi: niente a che vedere con qualsiasi interrogatorio tu abbia mai visto. "Ora," dice lei, "raccontami la tua storia."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"My name is Sawyer," says the man. "I'm a physicist, a Syndicate employee. We had a secret project on Mutiny, a planet in a pirate system. We were developing nuclear weapons." He hesitates, and looks away for a second, then says, "They told me it was for fighting the pirates. I didn't realize otherwise until--"|2277|0
units.english: "My name is Sawyer," says the man. "I'm a physicist, a Syndicate employee. We had a secret project on Mutiny, a planet in a pirate system. We were developing nuclear weapons." He hesitates, and looks away for a second, then says, "They told me it was for fighting the pirates. I didn't realize otherwise until--"
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Sawyer," dice l'uomo. "Sono un fisico, dipendente del Sindacato. Avevamo un progetto segreto su Mutiny, un pianeta in un sistema pirata. Stavamo sviluppando armi nucleari." Esita, e distoglie lo sguardo per un secondo, poi dice: "Mi avevano detto che servivano per combattere i pirati. Non ho capito che era altro finché..."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"That is a lie," says Raven, calmly.|2278|0
units.english: "That is a lie," says Raven, calmly.
units.italian: "Questa è una bugia," dice Raven, con calma.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	He seems flustered. "Okay, they didn't tell me what the weapons were for, and I didn't ask."|2279|0
units.english: He seems flustered. "Okay, they didn't tell me what the weapons were for, and I didn't ask."
units.italian: Sembra confuso. "Va bene, non mi avevano detto a cosa servivano le armi, e io non ho chiesto."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Why would the Syndicate attack the Republic?"|2281|0
units.english: "Why would the Syndicate attack the Republic?"
units.italian: "Perché il Sindacato dovrebbe attaccare la Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"Why did you wait so long to report this?"|2282|0
units.english: "Why did you wait so long to report this?"
units.italian: "Perché hai aspettato tanto a denunciare questa cosa?"

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	They both seem surprised at you asking a question. Sawyer says, "War is good for business, especially if you're in the business of making weapons. The Syndicate's profits have more than doubled since this conflict began."|2284|0
units.english: They both seem surprised at you asking a question. Sawyer says, "War is good for business, especially if you're in the business of making weapons. The Syndicate's profits have more than doubled since this conflict began."
units.italian: Entrambi sembrano sorpresi che tu abbia fatto una domanda. Sawyer dice: "La guerra fa bene agli affari, soprattutto se il tuo business è fabbricare armi. I profitti del Sindacato sono più che raddoppiati da quando è cominciato questo conflitto."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	"What led you to report this?" asks Raven.|2285|0
units.english: "What led you to report this?" asks Raven.
units.italian: "Che cosa ti ha spinto a denunciare questa cosa?" chiede Raven.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	He says, "It was when I heard that there had been another major battle. Up until then I had been telling myself that the worst of the damage was done. But after that battle, I knew that millions more could die because of our crime, and that I had the power to stop it."|2287|0
units.english: He says, "It was when I heard that there had been another major battle. Up until then I had been telling myself that the worst of the damage was done. But after that battle, I knew that millions more could die because of our crime, and that I had the power to stop it."
units.italian: Dice: "È stato quando ho sentito che c'era stata un'altra grande battaglia. Fino a quel momento mi ero detto che il peggio del danno era fatto. Ma dopo quella battaglia ho capito che altri milioni potevano morire a causa del nostro crimine, e che avevo il potere di fermarlo."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	Raven continues to ask questions: who was involved, how the facility was hidden, where the raw materials came from. At one point, JJ pulls you aside and says, "She must be a Questioner. How they operate is a tightly kept secret. I'd always assumed their methods were... a bit more medieval."|2288|0
units.english: Raven continues to ask questions: who was involved, how the facility was hidden, where the raw materials came from. At one point, JJ pulls you aside and says, "She must be a Questioner. How they operate is a tightly kept secret. I'd always assumed their methods were... a bit more medieval."
units.italian: Raven continua a fare domande: chi era coinvolto, come era stato nascosto l'impianto, da dove venivano le materie prime. A un certo punto, JJ ti tira da parte e dice: "Dev'essere una degli Interrogatori. Il loro modo di operare è un segreto ben custodito. Avevo sempre pensato che i loro metodi fossero... un po' più medievali."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	Finally, Raven is satisfied, and radios her ship. "He's telling the truth," she tells them. "Send word to the admirals at once. And, release the captive."|2289|0
units.english: Finally, Raven is satisfied, and radios her ship. "He's telling the truth," she tells them. "Send word to the admirals at once. And, release the captive."
units.italian: Alla fine Raven è soddisfatta, e chiama la sua nave via radio. "Dice la verità," li avverte. "Mandate subito parola agli ammiragli. E liberate il prigioniero."

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	The door of her ship slides open, and another woman steps out - shakily, hesitantly, shielding her eyes against the sunlight. It takes you a few seconds to realize that it's Katya.|2290|0
units.english: The door of her ship slides open, and another woman steps out - shakily, hesitantly, shielding her eyes against the sunlight. It takes you a few seconds to realize that it's Katya.
units.italian: La porta della sua nave scorre e ne esce un'altra donna, tremante, esitante, che si fa schermo con la mano contro la luce del sole. Ti ci vogliono un paio di secondi per capire che è Katya.

units.id: mission:FW Defend New Tibet|	As you all rush over to greet Katya, Raven taps your shoulder and says quietly, "Meet me in the main spaceport in a few hours and we'll figure out what's going to happen next." She returns to her ship.|2291|0
units.english: As you all rush over to greet Katya, Raven taps your shoulder and says quietly, "Meet me in the main spaceport in a few hours and we'll figure out what's going to happen next." She returns to her ship.
units.italian: Mentre vi precipitate tutti a salutare Katya, Raven ti tocca la spalla e dice sottovoce: "Incontrami allo spazioporto principale fra qualche ora e decideremo che cosa succederà adesso." Torna alla sua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|name|2296|0
units.english: Liberate Delta Sagittarii
units.italian: Libera Delta Sagittarii

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|description|2297|0
units.english: Lead a Free Worlds fleet to drive the Navy out of Delta Sagittarii. Another fleet ought to be arriving from the Rim at about the same time.
units.italian: Guida una flotta delle Free Worlds a scacciare la Marina da Delta Sagittarii. Un'altra flotta dovrebbe arrivare dal Bordo più o meno nello stesso momento.

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|When you and Freya enter the spaceport bar, JJ is talking with someone on his communicator. "The code word is 'havoc,'" he says. "Yes, I'm certain. It's the only option we have left. Good luck."|2311|0
units.english: When you and Freya enter the spaceport bar, JJ is talking with someone on his communicator. "The code word is 'havoc,'" he says. "Yes, I'm certain. It's the only option we have left. Good luck."
units.italian: Quando tu e Freya entrate nel bar dello spazioporto, JJ sta parlando con qualcuno al comunicatore. "La parola d'ordine è 'scompiglio'," dice. "Sì, ne sono certo. È l'unica opzione che ci resta. Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"What was that about?" asks Freya.|2312|0
units.english: "What was that about?" asks Freya.
units.italian: "Di che cosa si trattava?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	JJ says, "I was calling in some reinforcements," he says. "A group of ex-militia folks and bounty hunters who want to further the cause of the Free Worlds, but want to do it freelance instead of taking orders from us or the Senate. They call themselves the 'Wolf Pack.' Have you heard of them?"|2313|0
units.english: JJ says, "I was calling in some reinforcements," he says. "A group of ex-militia folks and bounty hunters who want to further the cause of the Free Worlds, but want to do it freelance instead of taking orders from us or the Senate. They call themselves the 'Wolf Pack.' Have you heard of them?"
units.italian: JJ dice: "Stavo chiamando dei rinforzi," spiega. "Un gruppo di ex miliziani e cacciatori di taglie che vogliono sostenere la causa delle Free Worlds, ma farlo da freelance invece di prendere ordini da noi o dal Senato. Si fanno chiamare il 'Branco di Lupi'. Ne hai mai sentito parlare?"

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"No, I haven't."|2317|0
units.english: "No, I haven't."
units.italian: "No, mai sentiti."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"Too bad," says JJ, "they've managed to get their hands on some technology I'd love to have access to. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."|2318|0
units.english: "Too bad," says JJ, "they've managed to get their hands on some technology I'd love to have access to. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."
units.italian: "Peccato," dice JJ, "sono riusciti a mettere le mani su una tecnologia che mi piacerebbe avere. Comunque, hanno accettato di fare un primo attacco mordi e fuggi contro la flotta della Marina per ammorbidirla, prima che arrivi la nostra."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"Yes, I helped them get access to some better ramscoop technology from the Deep."|2322|0
units.english: "Yes, I helped them get access to some better ramscoop technology from the Deep."
units.italian: "Sì, li ho aiutati a procurarsi una tecnologia migliore per i collettori ramscoop da Deep."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"No, I haven't had any dealings with them."|2324|0
units.english: "No, I haven't had any dealings with them."
units.italian: "No, non ho mai avuto a che fare con loro."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"That's odd," says JJ, "I thought they said you helped them to get their hands on the Catalytic Ramscoop. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."|2325|0
units.english: "That's odd," says JJ, "I thought they said you helped them to get their hands on the Catalytic Ramscoop. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."
units.italian: "Strano," dice JJ, "pensavo avessero detto che li avevi aiutati a mettere le mani sul Ramscoop Catalitico. Comunque, hanno accettato di fare un primo attacco mordi e fuggi contro la flotta della Marina per ammorbidirla, prima che arrivi la nostra."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"Ah yes," says JJ, "an excellent piece of corporate espionage. A little shady and underhanded, of course, which is why we let the Wolf Pack handle things like that rather than doing it through official channels. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."|2328|0
units.english: "Ah yes," says JJ, "an excellent piece of corporate espionage. A little shady and underhanded, of course, which is why we let the Wolf Pack handle things like that rather than doing it through official channels. But anyway, they've agreed to make an initial strike and fade attack on the Navy fleet to soften them up, before our own fleet gets there."
units.italian: "Ah già," dice JJ, "un eccellente pezzo di spionaggio industriale. Un po' losco e sottobanco, naturalmente, ed è per questo che lasciamo che il Branco di Lupi si occupi di cose simili invece di farlo per canali ufficiali. Comunque, hanno accettato di fare un primo attacco mordi e fuggi contro la flotta della Marina per ammorbidirla, prima che arrivi la nostra."

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"That'll need to be one hell of a strike for it to make any difference," says Freya.|2331|0
units.english: "That'll need to be one hell of a strike for it to make any difference," says Freya.
units.italian: "Dovrà essere un attacco coi fiocchi perché serva a qualcosa," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii|	"Don't worry," says JJ, "it will be. They've been itching to get into the fray for months now. Captain <last>, we'd like you to fly along with the fleet and help to mop up whatever the Wolf Pack leaves behind in the Delta Sagittarii system. Then we'll land on New Portland and figure out what our next steps are. Freya and I will ride on your ship."|2332|0
units.english: "Don't worry," says JJ, "it will be. They've been itching to get into the fray for months now. Captain <last>, we'd like you to fly along with the fleet and help to mop up whatever the Wolf Pack leaves behind in the Delta Sagittarii system. Then we'll land on New Portland and figure out what our next steps are. Freya and I will ride on your ship."
